$HeOrShe 皱起眉。"你得明白，想象力是有量级的——不，还是叫它【野心】吧——到了某个量级，就会给...创新者和自由思想者带来些不便的后果。"

options.en: How, why? Was it a targeted killing?
options.zh: 怎么死的，为什么？是定点清除？

options.en: I'm going to need more information than that.
options.zh: 这点东西不够，我需要更多。

options.en: Did someone figure out who Jason really is?
options.zh: 是有人查出了 Jason 的真实身份？
所以你现在也算【创新者】了？

options.en: I shall not have you speak ill of Andrada's transcendent philosophy!
options.zh: 我不许你这样诋毁 Andrada 那超凡的思想！

options.en: Did someone figure out who Jason really is?
options.zh: 是有人查出了 Jason 的真实身份？
所以你现在也算【创新者】了？

texts.en: "It does not appear as such." Jove produces a brief, coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不像。"Jove 露出一个短促的、意味深长的笑。

texts.en: "Apparently not. Assuming you're not lying to me, of course." $HeOrShe produces a coy smile.
texts.zh: "看来不是。当然，前提是你没在骗我。"$HeOrShe 露出一个意味深长的笑。

texts.en:
"See, it's funny. Your Jason was a fractious specimen." $HeOrShe eyes the TriPad but does not yet retrieve it.

"In his time on Qaras he scuffled with low-level distributors, contacted aspiring revolutionaries, exploded - figuratively, mind - a prospective 'romantic' encounter, and had to be reminded of 'local custom' by a section enforcer..."

"And yet, I do not detect in any of these frictive events the seed of a killing grudge. Perhaps he encountered the wrong place, the wrong time, the wrong gang. And that's why he caught a stray shot. An accident of circumstance, a quirk of fate."

$HeOrShe shrugs mildly. "He's attrition, in the end. A statistic."
texts.zh:
"你看，有意思的地方就在这儿。你那个 Jason 是个不安分的样本。"$HeOrShe 瞥了眼地上的 TriPad，却没有去捡。

"他在 Qaras 这段时间，跟底层分销商动过手，接触过几个想闹革命的年轻人，还——比喻意义上——炸掉了一场本该成的姻缘，最后得靠片区执法员提醒他什么叫本地规矩..."

"可这些磕磕碰碰里，我看不出哪一件埋着杀机的种子。也许他只是撞上了错的地方、错的时间、错的帮派。于是一发流弹找上了他。时势的意外，命运的捉弄。"

$HeOrShe 无所谓地耸了耸肩。"说到底，他只是损耗。一个数字。"

options.zh: 你是说他是被枪打死的？

options.en: Are you incapable of giving a straight answer?"
options.zh: 你就不能给个痛快的回答？

texts.en:
"It so appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled hit - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your baby Andrada. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts, the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当的活，只是办砸了——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你那位 Andrada 宝贝毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

texts.en:
"So it appears. The shooter was engaged in a legitimate albeit mishandled, attack - sloppy work, shameful incompetence - on a target unrelated to your Jason Korin. A routine matter of emphasizing dutiful repayment of debts; the foundation of civilization itself."

He puts on a look of shallow concern.

"You appear dissatisfied with my information, captain?"
texts.zh:
"看来就是这样。开枪的人接的是一桩正当却办砸了的袭击——手法粗糙，无能得丢人——目标跟你的 Jason Korin 毫无关系。不过是催人还债的老套路，文明本身的基石。"

他摆出一副浅淡的关切神色。

"看来你对我的情报不太满意，舰长？"

options.en: Someone that important to so many doesn't just die.
options.zh: 对这么多人来说这么要紧的一个人，不会就这么死了。

options.en: Jason Korin is a clone of Philip Andrada. His death can't be an accident.
options.zh: Jason Korin 是 Philip Andrada 的克隆体。他的死不可能是意外。

options.en: I believe you. Accidents happen all the time.
I believe you. Accidents happen all the time. (lie)
options.zh: 我信你。意外天天都有。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

His tone darkens. "And for an Andrada? That death was a mercy." Jove leans back, as if bored.

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then the loss is on you. Now I believe we're finished here." The smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

他的语气沉了下来。"而放在一位 Andrada 身上？那样的死是种仁慈。"Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那损失算你的。现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
"That's another funny thing. Your Jason doesn't seem important at all."

$HeOrShe narrows $hisOrHer eyes. "I believe you're holding back, captain."

"If you're unsatisfied with what I could provide with what I was given, then that disappointment is on you."

Jove leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
"还有件有意思的事。你那个 Jason，看着一点也不重要。"

$HeOrShe 眯起 $hisOrHer 的双眼。"我觉得你有所保留，舰长。"

"如果凭我手上这些还满足不了你，那这份失望得你自己兜着。"

Jove 向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en: Silver-eyes appears, apparently unbidden.
texts.zh: 银眼女人现身了，仿佛不请自来。

texts.en:
You step from the hidden lounge into the echelon of dark curtains, a velvety black like deep space. The air is close and warm, like a vacsuit with a bad atmo regulator.

Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh:
你从隐秘的休息室走出来，穿过层层叠叠的黑色帘幕——那黑如天鹅绒，像深空本身。空气闷热，像一件大气调节器坏掉的太空服。

Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

texts.en: Jason Korin, heir to Andrada, is dead. It was a senseless death on a violent world, if the criminal is to be believed.
texts.zh: Jason Korin，Andrada 的继承人，死了。如果那个罪犯的话可信，这不过是这座暴戾星球上一场毫无意义的死亡。

texts.en:
You turn to make a casual scan of the bar to find your view blocked by a heavily augmented woman in a dark coat. Her eyes are silver.

"'Pologies, $playerSirOrMadam." She clears her throat. "The boss... wishes for me to do the favor of extending to you an invitation to partake in the back room and share a word on your, uh, pressing query."

She hides a look of relief at making it through what are clearly someone else's words.
texts.zh:
你转身随意扫了一眼酒吧，视线却被一个身穿深色外套、改造痕迹极重的女人挡住。她的眼睛是银色的。

"抱歉，$playerSirOrMadam。\"她清了清嗓子。\"老板...想让我帮忙给您带个话，请您到后面那间屋里坐坐，聊聊您那桩，呃，要紧的事。"

话说完，她藏起一丝如释重负的神色——那显然不是她自己的措辞。

texts.en:
She nods, then turns to lead you into the shadows at the back of the bar.

Behind a clever echelon of black curtains is a door, and behind that door a small, luxurious lounge slouches moodily.
texts.zh:
她点点头，转身领你走进酒吧后方的阴影里。

层层巧妙错落的黑色帘幕之后是一扇门，门后是一间小巧而奢华的休息室，懒散地沉在暗处。

texts.en:
"Interesting," the $post says, watching you with a wisp of smile. As if assessing you like a prize. "Intriguing, even."

The goon, silver-eyes, disappears.

"I am called K-O Jove. Qaras is my interest. When interesting things happen here, they become my business."
texts.zh:
"有意思。\"$post 说，唇角挂着一丝笑，打量着你，像在估一件奖品。\"甚至可以说，耐人寻味。"

那个银眼睛的打手不见了。

"人们叫我 K-O Jove。Qaras 是我的地盘。这里一旦发生有意思的事，就成了我的事。"

options.en: I suppose you might know where I can find Jason Korin?
options.zh: 我想，你也许知道哪儿能找到 Jason Korin？

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, captain. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，船长。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, $titleHeg. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，$titleHeg。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
He laughs toothily.

"Is that what I said? Have care, $titlePL. I am mindful of my claims."
texts.zh:
他咧嘴一笑。

"我说过这话吗？当心，$titlePL。我对自己的名分一向看得仔细。"

texts.en:
"You're $playerName." He speaks past your question.

A strange expression comes over $hisOrHer face. "You did a very naughty thing, a cruel thing, to Kanta's pet clone."

$HisOrHer eyes dart to meet yours. "It was a beautiful execution. She's not so invincible, is she, Queen Jorien."
texts.zh:
"你是 $playerName。"他没接你的问题。

一种古怪的神情掠过 $hisOrHer 的脸。"你对 Kanta 养的那只克隆体做了件很坏、很残忍的事。"

$HisOrHer 的目光一挑，对上你的眼睛。"那是一场漂亮的处决。她也没那么不可战胜，对吧，Jorien 女王。"

texts.en: "I may," he says, savoring the words.
texts.zh: "也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in this spacer bar.
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把这间太空人酒吧尽数算了进去。

texts.en:
"I may," he says, savoring the words.

"You've been asking around. And not just here," he gives a small wave, taking in the celestial sphere upon which you stand, and its orbits.

"Practically anyone of importance you can bother, it seems. Hardly discreet."
texts.zh:
"也许吧。"他说，把这两个字嚼得有滋有味。

"你一直在四处打听。而且不只在这儿。"他轻一摆手，把你脚下这颗天球连同它的轨道一并算了进去。

"看来凡是有点分量的人，你能烦的都烦了一遍。这可不怎么谨慎。"

options.en: I do what I must to survive.
options.zh: 为了活下去，我只能这么做。

options.en: It was a mistake made in a moment of crisis.
options.zh: 那是危机时刻犯下的错误。

options.en: It's nice to meet a fan of my work.
options.zh: 能遇到欣赏我作品的人，真好。

options.en: The clone was an unholy abomination.
options.zh: 那克隆体是亵渎的孽物。

options.en: So are you going to tell me?
So are you going to tell me about Jason?
options.zh: 那你打算跟我讲 Jason 的事吗？

options.en: So are you going to tell me Jason?
options.zh: 那你打算告诉我 Jason 的事吗？

texts.en: "Don't be so bashful," $heOrShe scolds. "It was an inspired act."
texts.zh: "别这么害臊。\" $heOrShe 责备道。\"那是一记神来之举。"

texts.en: He closes his eyes for a moment. "But that's not why you're here."
texts.zh: 他闭了闭眼。"但你来这儿不是为了这个。"

options.en: We were speaking of Jason Korin. Do you know where I can find him?
options.zh: 我们刚才在说 Jason Korin。你知道哪儿能找到他吗？

texts.en:
"Don't play-act weakness to me," his voice suddenly acid. "It was an inspired act. Possess it, and accept my highest praise."

He closes his eyes, taking a deep breath, then resettles his composure.
texts.zh:
"别在我面前装软弱。\"他的声音骤然转酸。\"那是一记神来之举。认下它，接受我最高的赞誉。"

他闭上眼，深吸一口气，重新整好仪态。

texts.en: He puts his hands together and appears to nod respectfully toward you. It's an uncomfortable but seemingly heartfelt concession.
texts.zh: 他双手合拢，像是郑重地朝你点头致意。这份让步叫人不太舒服，却看上去出自真心。

texts.en:
"Oh." He seems taken a little aback. "I see."

"I give praise to your inspired act." He puts his hands together in an impression of piety and appears to nod respectfully toward you.
texts.zh:
"哦。\"他似乎有些意外。\"我明白了。"

"我为你的神来之举献上赞誉。"他双手合拢，做出一副虔诚的样子，像是郑重地朝你点头。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles, slowly.

"I could be persuaded."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 慢慢笑了。

"我也许能被说动。"

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"I will help you. Because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"我帮你。出于我对你那桩大胆作为的钦佩。"

options.en: Consider me... a fellow corsair, in need of a favor.
options.zh: 就当我是...一个同道的私掠船长，需要你帮个忙。

options.en: This is tedious. Just tell me or don't.
This is tiresome. Cutting the link now. (cut comms)
options.zh: 够了。现在就切断通讯。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
He holds up a hand, the very image of grace.

"No credits. I will help you because of my admiration for your bold deed."
texts.zh:
他抬手一止，举止优雅得像一幅画。

"不必付钱。我帮你，是因为我钦佩你那桩大胆的作为。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Hegemony can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信霸主出得起。"

texts.en:
He leans toward you.

"No."

The hint of a smile flares for a moment.

"15,000 credits, however, would demonstrate your commitment to my thorough and thoughtful response. I'm sure the Persean League can afford it."
texts.zh:
他朝你俯身过来。

"不。"

一丝笑意一闪即灭。

"不过，15,000 星币足以表明你确实希望我认真、周到地作答。我确信英仙座联盟出得起。"

texts.en: "Let's not," he says, an edge in his voice.
texts.zh: "别这样。"他说，声音里带了刃。

texts.en: Jove nods, touching a hand to a data interface device, something on his wrist, without looking.
texts.zh: Jove 点了点头，一只手抚上腕上的数据接口，眼睛都没抬。

texts.en:
The smile hardens.

"You need to learn to take pleasure in this business, captain. You'll find precious little happiness in the dead of space."

He pauses.

"Make it worth my time to give you the man you seek."
texts.zh:
笑意凝住了。

"你得学会从这门生意里尝出点滋味，舰长。在深空里，你能找到的快乐少得可怜。"

他顿了顿。

"想让我交出你要找的人，就拿出点东西来，让我觉得这时间花得值。"

texts.en:
The pirate drops $hisOrHer attention from you as if you were a piece of furniture and returns $hisOrHer attention to a quiet holo of what looks to be some sort of bloodsport.

The augmented goon emerges from the shadows to escort you back to the bar.
texts.zh:
那海盗把 $hisOrHer 的注意力从你身上挪开，仿佛你只是件家具，转而回到 $hisOrHer 面前那幅安静的全息影像上——看上去像某种血腥格斗。

那个改造过的打手从阴影里走出来，送你回酒吧。

texts.en: Jove gives you a look somewhere between disappointed and bored.
texts.zh: Jove 瞥了你一眼，那神情介于失望与无聊之间。

texts.en:
You move to step away, and she steps into your path. From the corner of your eye you see a couple of your bodyguards tense up, ready to act.

"Please," she says, expressionless. "That's my ask. Boss don't like to hear no. Gets in a mood."
texts.zh:
你想侧身走开，她却横跨一步挡在前面。你眼角瞥见两名保镖绷紧了身子，随时准备动手。

"拜托。\"她面无表情。\"这是我要办的事。老板不爱听不行。会闹脾气。"

options.en: Still no. Good luck with your boss.
options.zh: 还是不行。祝你老板那儿好运。

options.en: You got an answer. Now clear off.
options.zh: 你已经得到答复了。现在让开。

texts.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
texts.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

texts.en:
She half-bows apologetically and removes herself from your path.

Your bodyguards relax.
texts.zh:
她带着歉意半鞠一躬，让开了去路。

你的保镖们松了下来。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe is finally left at a loss for words.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his affect. "Fascinating."

"I daresay, for an Andrada such a quick death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Just a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished here." That smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 终于哑口无言。

当然，不会太久。

"Andrada。\"尽管他端着那副神情，$HeOrShe 仍显得心神不宁。\"有意思。"

"要我说，对一位 Andrada 而言，死得这么快反倒是种仁慈。这话不是出于私怨，我不过是个现实主义者。"

$PersonName 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe is finally at a loss for words. Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." $HeOrShe seems unsettled, despite his unflappable affect. "Fascinating."

"For an Andrada that death was a mercy. I don't say this out of personal hatred, mind. Jut a realist."

$PersonName leans back, as if bored.

"Now I believe we're finished." That smile again. "For now."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 终于哑口无言。当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。\"尽管他端着那副不动的神色，$HeOrShe 仍显得心神不宁。\"有意思。"

"对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。这话不是出于私怨，我不过是个现实主义者。"

$PersonName 向后一靠，像是在犯困。

"现在，我想我们这边谈完了。\"又是那个笑。\"暂时。"

texts.en:
He frowns very reasonably. "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
他皱起眉，一副通情达理的样子。"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
He nods, frowning reasonably. "Tragic," $heOrShe says. His tone darkens, "But for an Andrada, that death was a mercy."

He leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
他点点头，眉头皱着，显得很讲道理。"真惨。"$heOrShe 说。语气随即沉下来，"但对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。"

他向后退靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe frowns very reasonably. "One grows to accept the mercurial hand of fate. All else is madness."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 皱起眉，一副通情达理的样子。"人会慢慢学会接受命运那只反复无常的手。除此之外都是疯念。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods, frowning reasonably. "Tragic," $heOrShe says. Then $hisOrHer tone darkens, "But for an Andrada, that death was a mercy."

Then leans back, as if bored. "I believe we're finished here. You'll have my comms ID."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe 点点头，眉头皱着，显得很讲道理。"真惨。"$heOrShe 说。随后 $hisOrHer 的语气沉了下来，"但对一位 Andrada 来说，那样的死是种仁慈。"

然后向后一靠，像是在犯困。"我想我们这边谈完了。你会拿到我的通讯 ID。"

texts.en:
"Yes."

$HeOrShe flashes a genuine smile. An alien look.
texts.zh:
"是。"

$HeOrShe 绽出一个真诚的笑。那表情陌生得不像他。

texts.en: "Patience, my dear, patience," he says.
texts.zh: "耐心，亲爱的，耐心。"他说。

texts.en: Instead of an answer, $heOrShe gives you a brief, insincere smile.
texts.zh: $heOrShe 没有作答，只给了你一个短促而毫无诚意的笑。

texts.en: Jove raises an eyebrow, then produces a coy smile. "Please accept my most sincere apologies."
texts.zh: Jove 挑起一边眉毛，随即露出一个意味深长的笑。"请接受我最诚挚的歉意。"

texts.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at an uncharacteristic loss for words.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He says the name carefully, like holding an armed grenade. "Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, you say?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 罕见地像是无话可说。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。\"这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。\"有意思。你是说，有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

texts.en:
For a moment, Jove appears to be at a loss for words, his look perplexed.

Not for long, of course.

"Andrada." He does a double-glance at you, seeing how you react to hear him say the name. And he says it carefully, like holding an armed grenade.

"Fascinating. Gone a bit rogue, it seems?"

An unsteady grin, then he whispers something into his wrist-comms.
texts.zh:
有那么一瞬，Jove 像是找不出话来，满脸困惑。

当然，只一瞬。

"Andrada。"他朝你连看了两眼，想看出你听到这名字时的反应。这名字他说得极小心，像捧着一枚拔了保险的手雷。

"有意思。看来是有点脱了缰？"

他咧嘴一笑，笑意不太稳，随即对着腕上的通讯器低声说了几句。

texts.en:
Jove looks, if anything, both surprised and offended. His mouth hangs slightly open as you cut the comms.

He's clearly working some self-interested angle.

And you've got a lead to follow: the goon's boss, the gang leader who was paid by an Askonian to rough you up.
texts.zh:
真要说的话，Jove 看上去既吃惊又觉得受了冒犯。你切断通讯时，他的嘴还微微张着。

他显然在打自己的算盘。

而你手上还有条线索要追：那个打手的老大，那个被某个 Askonia 人出钱雇来教训你的帮派头目。

texts.en: "You must make time for pleasantries, captain. There's precious little pleasure in the cold of space; we must make our own where it is to be found."
texts.zh: "舰长，寒暄这种事也得腾出时间。太空的寒冷里，可享受的东西少得可怜；哪儿能找到乐趣，我们就得自己在哪儿造出来。"

texts.en: "Hardly," $heOrShe answers with a look of the mildest disgust. "I'm hurt that you would suggest my methods were so unsophisticated."
texts.zh: "差得远。\"$heOrShe答道，脸上一丝极轻的嫌恶。\"你竟说我的手法这么不上台面，这话挺伤我。"

texts.en:
The hint of a smile haunts his lips.

"You certainly have."
texts.zh:
一丝笑意在他唇边徘徊。

"你确实过得挺有意思。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks aside. "He wasn't mine, by the way. The one who showed you the gun."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe移开目光。"顺带说一句，拿枪给你看的那个不是我的人。"

options.en: In the bar. It was you who sent silver-eyes.
options.zh: 酒吧里。银眼女人是你派来的。

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: It is done.
texts.zh: 办妥了。

texts.en: "What's that suppo-"
texts.zh: "那算是什么意——"

texts.en: "Shut yer hatch, I'm askin' th-"
texts.zh: "闭上你的嘴，老子在问——"

texts.en:
She closes her eyes, takes a breath, and begins.

"I got paid to give you a message, and that's, um, that 'he' had a microsat at the jump-point that tagged your fleet, which is why 'he' isn't here."

Eyes open now.

"I was told to say 'Jove says it'll take more time', and this is a uh, something about fainting? So that 'he' can't find more credits?"
texts.zh:
她闭上眼，吸了口气，然后开口。

"有人付钱让我给你带个话，内容是，呃，'他'在跃迁点布了一颗微型卫星，标记了你的舰队，所以'他'才没在这儿。"

她睁开眼。

"他们让我带话说'Jove 说还得再花些时间'，还有什么，呃，'装晕'之类的？这样'他'就找不来更多星币了？"

options.en: A 'feint', yes. I suppose that makes sense.
options.zh: 一次'虚晃'，对。我想这说得通。
所以他是在浪费我的时间？

texts.en: "That's all I was told," she says nervously.
texts.zh: "他们只跟我说了这些，"她紧张地说。

texts.en:
"That's all I was told," she says, looking nervous.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
texts.zh:
"他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，神色紧张。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

texts.en: The young spacer looks relieved, though still scared. One of your bodyguards forwards her to your purser.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员松了口气，可脸上仍带着惧色。你的一名保镖把她领到了你的事务长那里。

texts.en: The young spacer does just as you say, doing her best to hide a look of disappointment.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员照你说的做了，竭力掩住脸上的失望。

texts.en: The young spacer performs a passable salute, then scurries off before anything she says displeases you any more.
texts.zh: 年轻的太空船员敬了个勉强像样的礼，随即匆匆退开，生怕再说出什么惹你不快的话。

texts.en: "I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told."
texts.zh: "我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些。"

texts.en:
"I... sorry, I don't know. That's all I was told," she says, distressed.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Are you... do I still have that job?"
texts.zh:
"我...对不起，我不知道。他们只跟我说了这些，"她说着，满脸惶恐。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。那个...我那份活还在吗？"

texts.en: "No? I mean, maybe? I didn't get a name, they just-"
texts.zh: "不是？我是说，也许？他们没告诉我名字，只是——"

texts.en: "Oh! No, I mean, that isn't why... I'll just-"
texts.zh: "哦！不，我是说，不是为了那个...我就是——"

texts.en: "Oh! Fantastic, thank you $playerSirOrMadam! But, that isn't why... I'll just-"
texts.zh: "哦！太好了，谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam！可、可我不是为这个来的...我就是——"

texts.en:
Your comms officer pings you unexpectedly.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I received an unusual communication which- I thought it should be brought to your attention."
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官突然向你发出通知。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我收到了一份特别的通讯，我认为您应当关注它。"

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Someone who claims to work for a man named 'Virens' commed to invite you to a meeting. I did not... at first think to bring it to your attention until the details could be verified."

"Well, ah," they twitch nervously. "We verified the details."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。有个自称是 'Virens' 手底下的人发来了通讯，邀请您参加一个会议。我没有...立即向您汇报此事，我本想等到我们能够确认那些细节之后再讲。"

"呃，对，" 对方紧张地说。"我们核实了相关细节。"

texts.en:
And indeed, as your comms officer explains, it turns out that one Nile Virens figures prominently in Mazalot as the leader (alleged) of the local branch of the Luddic Path, though none of the mainstream media or data outlets state this apparently unspoken-by-agreement fact. Virens legally runs a number of charities; Pather fronts (allegedly), and owns properties in most of the significant Luddic-majority settlements on Mazalot.

It's not difficult to read between the lines. Just dangerous.

Unless you are someone who employs top-credit bodyguards and operates a private battlefleet.
texts.zh:
确实，正如你的通讯军官所说，Nile Virens 在 Mazalot 上扮演的一个重要角色其实是 卢德左径 当地分支的领导者 (据传)，尽管没有任何主流媒体或小道消息点明过这一不言而喻的事实。Virens 合法经营着数个慈善机构，其实都是掩护左径组织的前台 (据传)，且在 Mazalot 大多数重要的卢德聚集地中持有地产。

这很危险。听懂这个弦外之意应该不难。

除非能有个雇佣了顶级保镖，并坐拥一支私人作战舰队的家伙。

texts.en:
It's almost shocking that Virens hasn't been arrested already, but his status is a political minefield for the Mazalot Unification Authority. To crack down might instigate another uprising. To not crack down allows Pather influence to simmer just under the boiling point.

And now, Nile Virens has invited you for tea.

Your officers, of course, have rapidly assembled a tactical report on Virens' holdings for your review.
texts.zh:
Virens 至今未被捕，这令人感到难以置信。毕竟他的地位对 Mazalot 统一政权而言，犹如一颗政治地雷。对他采取强硬措施可能激起新的暴动，而不采取行动则会使左径分子的影响力在沸点之下持续酝酿。

而现在，Nile Virens 正邀请你共享下午茶。

自然，你的幕僚们已迅速编制了一份关于 Virens 势力范围的战术报告供你审查。

texts.en:
The Mammonite chuckles darkly, shaking his head. "Captain $playerFirstName. This is Chalcedon; everyone maybe has joined the Path. You must be more specific, much more."

At your hesitation, he continues, "You must trust me, just a little, yes? If you don't tell me what you need, then I cannot provide."
texts.zh:
玛门之仆微微笑了笑，摇了摇头。" $playerFirstName 舰长。这里是 Chalcedon，也许每个人都是左径信徒。你必须描述得更详细些，非常详细。"

在你犹豫的时候，他继续说，"你必须相信我，哪怕一点点，好吗？如果你不告诉我你需要什么，我就无法提供任何信息。"

texts.en:
"Looking for." He raises his eyebrows. "There are many ways of looking for a person, you know. Some look to talk; some to deal."

He pours another dram of a foul black market distillate into a teacup. The fumes shimmer as they evaporate.

"Some look to kill." He eyes you for a moment, holding the teacup, then pours it down his throat, coughs, and slams the cup back on the table. "I mention because that? That would cost more."
texts.zh:
"找人..." 他扬起眉毛。"你要知道，找一个人可以有很多种目的。比如为了交流、为了交易..."

他又往茶杯里倒了一杯某种私酒，蒸发的烟雾闪闪发光。

"抑或是为了杀戮。" 他看了你一会儿，拿起茶杯一饮而尽，咳嗽了一声，把杯子重重地放在桌子上。"知道我为什么说这个吗？因为那得加钱。"

options.en: I'm after information, not killing. It's just talk.
options.zh: 我是来打探消息的，没打算杀人。这只是一次谈话罢了。

options.en: I'm searching for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
options.zh: 我在找一个叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人。

texts.en:
"Jethro Bornanew," the Mammonite repeats as if writing it to permanent memory.

"A name is good. Very specific. I can make inquiries." He smiles, then holds up a finger for the proprietor's attention - another round - then points it at you - you're paying.

"I will set up a meeting with a... friend." He gives you a look, "Not a good friend, not too close. Just a talking friend. Good business, you know."

"5,000 credits. You're a big captain, with a big $shipOrFleet. It's nothing, yes?"
texts.zh:
"Jethro Bornanew。" 玛门之仆重复着，让自己的记忆更深刻。

"一个名字。很好，很具体，我可以去打听打听。" 他微笑着，然后举起一根手指引起店主的注意 —— 再来一杯 —— 然后指指你 —— 由你付钱。

"我会安排一场会面...和一个朋友。" 他看了你一眼，"不是什么好朋友，联系也不怎么紧密，也就随便聊聊天。好生意，你懂的。"

"5,000 星币。你是位有名的舰长，有个大$shipOrFleet。这对你来说不算什么，对吧？"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

options.zh: 只是谈谈罢了，1,000 怎么样？

texts.en:
"Good, good!" the Mammonite laughs and holds up a finger for the proprietor's attention - another round - then points it at you - you're paying.

"I can set up a meeting, you and... a friend." He gives you a look, "Not a good friend, not too close. Just a talking friend. Good business, you know."

"5,000 credits. You're a big captain, with a big $shipOrFleet. It's nothing, yes?"
texts.zh:
"很好，很好！" 玛门之仆笑了，举起一根手指引起店主的注意 —— 再来一杯 —— 然后指指你 —— 由你付钱。

"我会安排一场会面...和一个朋友。" 他看了你一眼，"不是什么好朋友，联系也不怎么紧密，也就随便聊聊天。好生意，你懂的。"

"5,000 星币。你可是有名的舰长，有个大$shipOrFleet。不算什么，对吧？"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

options.zh: 只是谈谈罢了，1,000 怎么样？

texts.en:
The Mammonite laughs, then stands up to shout for the whole teahouse, "This one, tough negotiator! Watch out, credits are hidden behind Fortress Shield. No one gets in!"

Other spacers stare, some murmuring disapproval, others laughing.

He sits, rattling the tea-set, and grins at you. "3,000 credits. Is spacelane robbery, but I like you."
texts.zh:
玛门之仆笑了起来，站起来朝着整个茶馆喊到，"这家伙，可不好惹！小心，他把星币藏在堡垒护盾后面。谁都拿不走！"

其他宇宙民看了过来，一些人喃喃地表达不满，另一些人则大笑。

他坐下，晃动着茶具，冲你咧嘴笑道，"3,000 星币。你像个太空劫匪，但我欣赏你。"

texts.en: The Mammonite laughs, and calls out to you, almost pleading. "Wait, wait! 2,000 credits. Final offer. It is charity, almost! Very Luddic!"
texts.zh: 玛门之仆大笑起来，几乎是恳求地冲你喊道："等等，等等！{2,000 星币}。最终报价。这简直是慈善了！非常有卢德精神！"

texts.en:
The Mammonite laughs, and calls out to you. "Wait, wait," and stands up to shout for the whole teahouse, "This one, tough negotiator! Watch out, credits are hidden behind Fortress Shield. No one gets in!"

Other spaces stare, some murmuring disapproval, others laughing.

The Mammonite sits, rattling the tea-set, and grins at you. "2,000 credits. Is spacelane robbery, but I like you."
texts.zh:
玛门之仆笑了起来，对你说："等等，等等！" 他站起来朝着整个茶馆喊道："这家伙，砍价一把好手！小心，他把星币藏在堡垒护盾后面。谁都拿不走！"

其他宇宙民看了过来，一些人喃喃地表达不满，另一些人则大笑。

他坐下，晃动着茶具，冲你咧嘴笑道："{2,000 星币}。简直是拦路抢劫，但我欣赏你。"

texts.en: You transfer the credits to the sticky datapad offered by your new friend.
texts.zh: 你将星币转账到你这新朋友递过来的那个黏糊糊的数据平板上。

texts.en: You transfer the credits to the sticky datapad offered by your new friend.
texts.zh: 你将星币转账到你这新朋友递过来的那个黏糊糊的数据平板上。

texts.en: You sit back down and transfer the credits.
texts.zh: 你坐了回去并且转账了星币。

texts.en:
"I will make inquiries, and you will wait and come back after one day for a good answer."

He pounds a drumroll on the table and laughs as a pot of 'tea' arrives. "Tonight, we drink and celebrate!"
texts.zh:
"我去问问，你先等等，一天以后回来听我的好消息就行了。"

他把桌子敲出了鼓点，直到一罐 '茶水' 端上来才笑出了声。"今晚，咱们就喝一杯庆祝庆祝！"

texts.en:
You drink with the Mammonite, who indeed makes for a good drinking partner. He has many stories, and matches you for tales of scrapes with irate Pathers, pirates, and patrols.

The Mammonite raises a hand to summon the proprietor again. Another pot of 'tea'?
texts.zh:
你正和一位玛门之仆对饮，他简直是为了成为一名好酒友而生的。他似乎有着说不完的故事，无论是你与左径分子、海盗还是巡逻队之间的 "小摩擦"，他总能接上。

这位玛门之仆又一次抬手招来店家。要不就再来一壶 "茶"？

texts.en:
One pot turns into two, then three.

The night spins. A blur of sound and the light - another drink, bottoms of! - teahouse lanterns, doubling, tripling.
texts.zh:
一杯，两杯，三杯，觥筹交错。

斗转星移，卜夜卜昼。视线已然模糊，所听恍然朦胧 ——"再来一杯！干杯！"—— 直到茶馆的灯笼也重重叠叠了起来。

texts.en:
You're wrapping up your visit to the charmingly quaint facilities when you are grabbed from behind, a dark hood pulled over your head.

You're dragged through a doorway, somewhere with dank; close air; then out into cold night. There's a thrum of raindrops on awnings.
texts.zh:
对这迷人且古雅的设施的访问快要结束时，你被从后面抓住，头上被套了一个黑色的袋子。

你被拖过一扇门，在某个潮湿沉闷的地方；然后进入寒冷的夜晚。雨篷上落下一串雨滴。

texts.en:
Sharp, low words are exchanged between your kidnappers - and muffled cursing from beside you. Sounds like the Mammonite.

You're pretty sure you're not as worse for the drink as he is. Pretty sure. Hard to tell with your head in a bag.
texts.zh:
你的绑架者们之间交换着尖锐、低沉的话语 —— 还有从你身边传来的低沉的咒骂声。听起来像是玛门之仆。

你很确定你不会像他一样喝得那么醉。非常确定。不过头被套在布袋里，实在是不好判断。

options.en: Draw your sarm. Side-arm, tha'sit. Draw your sidearm.
options.zh: 拔仓，啊对，木仓，拔出你的佩枪。

texts.en: You fumble for your sidearm, and find your holster empty. They must have grabbed it.
texts.zh: 你摸索着你的随身武器，发现枪套是空的。一定是被他们拿走了。

texts.en:
A gunshot, barely muffled by the sack on your head, claps your eardrums.

You don't hear the Mammonite cursing anymore. The cold shock of dread sobers you.
texts.zh:
一声枪响，几乎被你头上的布袋掩盖，击中了你的耳膜。

你再也听不到玛门之仆的咒骂了，冰冷的恐惧使你战栗。

texts.en:
More low talking. You're dragged a short distance, then lifted to your feet.

"We should speak, face to face. You- let the good $playerBrotherOrSister see."

The hood comes off.
texts.zh:
更多的低语声。你被拖拽了一小段距离，然后被架着站了起来。

"我们应该面对面谈谈。你 —— 摘了这位好$playerBrotherOrSister的头套。"

头套被摘下了。

texts.en:
"Been told you've been asking questions," the man says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge." He graciously waves a hand to show you the dismal alley you find yourself in, toward the slumped form sitting in a puddle of its own blood. "Welcome to my Path."
texts.zh:
"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他优雅地挥挥手，向你展示了一下身处的这条阴暗小巷，和一个倒在自己血泊中的尸体，"欢迎走上我的道途。"

texts.en:
It's the next day. You see the Mammonite as you walk in and he greets you from the bar - a little worse for the wear after a night of drinking, it seems.

"Yes, hello captain! You must come meet my friend!"

He stands - unsteadily - and leads you through a door in the back of the bar.
texts.zh:
现在是第二天。你走进门时看见玛门之仆在吧台后面招呼着你 —— 喝了一夜之后看起来有些糟糕。

"你好啊舰长！你必须来见见我们的朋友！"

他站了起来 —— 晃晃悠悠的 —— 带着你进了吧台后面的门。

texts.en:
You step into a storage room. Broken furniture is stacked in a corner. Dim light from a stick-on glowplate has decayed into a sickly yellow-green gradient.

"He's just through here. Come, come," the Mammonite says, beckoning, and steps through a door to the outside.
texts.zh:
你走进一间储藏室。破损的家具堆放在角落里。贴在墙上的荧光板已经褪色成病态的昏暗黄绿色。

"他就在这儿。来，来。" 玛门之仆招着手，又穿过一扇门走向外面。

texts.en:
You step into a storage room. Broken furniture is stacked in a corner. Dim light from a stick-on glowplate has decayed into a sickly yellow-green gradient.

"He's just through here. Come, come," the Mammonite says, beckoning, and steps through a door to the outside.
texts.zh:
你走进一间储藏室。破损的家具堆放在角落里。贴在墙上的荧光板已经褪色成病态的昏暗黄绿色。

"他就在这儿。来，来。" 玛门之仆招着手，又穿过一扇门走向外面。

texts.en: You unholster your sidearm, check its status, and hold it close but readied.
texts.zh: 你拔出了你的随身武器，检查了其状态，并将其紧握身边，随时警惕着。

texts.en: You give a quiet order to your bodyguards to circle around to your position, confident in their ability to take control of the situation with their specialized training and equipment.
texts.zh: 你悄悄地命令你的保镖围绕你散开，相信他们的专业训练和装备让他们有能力控制局面。

texts.en:
You step through the door.

Daylight, a rare gap in the storms, washes our your vision for a moment.
texts.zh:
你走出了门。

阳光，风暴间难得的间隙，使你的视野暂时清晰开阔。

texts.en: A gunshot claps your eardrums.
texts.zh: 一声震耳欲聋的枪声响起。

texts.en:
Almost without thinking, you fall to the side to remove yourself from a potential sweep of fire. Tactical chatter whispers in your ear; calm tones. No one is aiming a weapon at you, but your bodyguards can drop anyone nearby at a word.

The closest shape is a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming anything at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh:
你几乎本能地扑倒向一旁来躲避可能的扫射。耳旁响起战术口令，非常冷静的口吻。没有人用武器瞄准着你，但只要你一声令下保镖就可以干掉在场的任何人。

离你最近的形状的是一个影子；一个身影；一个男人。他没有用任何东西瞄准着你。他看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en: Almost without thinking, you fall to the side with your sidearm raised and ready at the closest shape - a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh: 几乎没有思考，你扑倒在一旁，举起随身武器对准了最近的身影 —— 一个影子；一个轮廓；一个男人。他没有拿武器对着你，而是看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en: Almost without thinking, you fall to the side to remove yourself from a potential sweep of fire. The closest shape before you is a shadow; a figure; a man. Not aiming at you. Looking at you, hands open and raised part-way.
texts.zh: 几乎没有思考，你扑倒在一旁来躲避可能的射击。离你最近的身影的是一个影子；一个轮廓；一个男人。他没有拿武器对着你，而是看着你，打开的双手半举着。

texts.en:
"Been told you've been asking questions," the man says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge." He graciously waves a hand to show you the dismal alley you find yourself in, toward the slumped Mammonite sitting in a puddle of their own blood. "Welcome to my Path."
texts.zh:
"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他优雅地挥挥手，向你展示了一下身处的这条阴暗小巷，和玛门之仆倒在自己血泊中的身影，"欢迎走上我的道途。"

texts.en:
You seat yourself. A simple, steaming tea is placed before you with a subtle hint from the proprietor that you need but ask and something much stronger will arrive in a teapot.

Before you can make a proper assessment of the colorful figures who tend to populate a spacer bar, a man sits next to you with casual self-assurance, grabs your cup of tea, and downs the entire cup in one go.
texts.zh:
你找地方坐了下来，一杯冒着热气的茶放在了你面前。店主微妙地暗示你，你只需要示意一下，茶壶里就会有更强劲的东西。

在你对这个太空佬酒吧里形形色色的人做出适当的评价前，一个男人自信且放松的坐在了你旁边，拿过你的茶，一口气喝完。

texts.en:
You would have thought the tea to be uncomfortably hot, but the man seems unfazed as he swishes it around his mouth and swallows.

"Been told you've been asking questions," he says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge," he says.
texts.zh:
你觉得茶有些太烫了，但是这个男人似乎并不在乎，他咕噜咕噜地把茶喝了下去。

"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他说。

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You understand nothing. Mammon and Moloch live in your heart and in your mind."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path. The true Path ends in Heaven. Faith reveals this."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"蒙昧无知。恶魔玛门和摩洛克存于你心中，存于你思想之中。"

"公义与否不取决于其施行手段，而取决于行善还是行恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道。这道途真实，通向应许的天堂。信的人便明白。"

texts.en:
Sedge nods. "I have what they do not: faith in the Path. I follow where it leads without fear, without question. Faith alone reveals the righteous Path.

"True faith terrifies the faithless." He leans back, his look softening. He is not boastful, but absolutely earnest. "You see how these little spacers, the Hegemony, the Church-liars, all of them; how they fear us."
texts.zh:
Sedge 点点头。"我有他们没有的东西：对卢德之道的信仰。我遵循此道的指引，既无恐惧，也无疑虑。唯此信仰可揭示正义之道。"

"真正信仰将使不信者惧怕。"他向后靠了靠，神情变得柔和了。他不是在自夸，但却十分真诚。"你看看这些小船员，霸主，教会的骗子们，他们所有人；看他们是多么惧怕我们。"

texts.en: "It is a good thing you are not God," Sedge cracks a new smile, "Because then I would be in big trouble."
texts.zh: "幸好你不是神。" Sedge 又露出一个微笑，"因为那样我就有大麻烦了。"

texts.en:
"Sense is not faith," Sedge says, correcting you. "But maybe you are still finding the Path."

He pauses, then adds, "Maybe we talk more someday, $playerBrotherOrSister, after your business with me."
texts.zh:
"理性不是信仰。" Sedge 纠正道，"但也许你仍在探寻圣道。"

他停顿了一下，然后补充道，"也许我们下次再聊，$playerBrotherOrSister，在这单生意之后。"

texts.en: Sedge's eyes narrow at you. "You say, to kill a man is not righteous? You don't know that Mammonite. I do. But," Sedge grunts, "I need not explain my path to you. God will judge."
texts.zh: Sedge 眯起眼睛看着你。"你说，杀人是不正义的？你不了解那个玛门之仆。我了解。但是，" Sedge咕哝道，"我无需向你解释我的道途。神会审判我。"

options.en: I expect some worldly authority will judge you, and not well.
options.zh: 我希望某些世俗权威会审判你，并且不会有好的结果。

options.en: How much blood must you spill to be allowed into Heaven?
options.zh: 你要流多少血才能被允许进入天堂？

options.en: What good deeds of yours outweigh such casual murder?
options.zh: 你有什么善举能抵消这种随意的谋杀？

options.en: You killed an evil man? Then I spoke too soon.
options.zh: 你杀了一个邪恶的人？那我话讲早了。

texts.en: Sedge shrugs. "My path will end. Not today, I think."
texts.zh: Sedge 耸了耸肩。"我的道途将会走到尽头，但不是今天，我想。"

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You don't understand. You think that way? It shows you worship Mammon and Moloch in your heart and you don't know it."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path, not because I think I can buy-," he pauses to spit toward the slumped corpse, "-my way into Heaven."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"你不明白。你是这样想的吗？这说明你在心中崇尚着恶魔玛门和摩洛克而不自知。"

"公义不可被衡量，行善业可拒邪恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道，而不是我觉得我能买到 ——" 他停顿了一下，向倒在地上的尸体啐了一口，"—— 买到通往天堂的路。"

texts.en: Sedge nods. "My Path crossed his, and his was to end."
texts.zh: Sedge 点点头。"我道途与他的交错，而他的道途走到了尽头。"

texts.en: "Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over, turning your cup - his now - over and over in his hands. "No, I do not recall a Jethro."
texts.zh: "嗯。" Sedge 看向远方，做出努力回想的样子，把你的杯子 —— 现在是他的了 —— 拿在手里翻来覆去。"不，我不记得任何叫 Jethro 的人。"

texts.en:
"Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over. "No, do not recall a Jethro."

The pooling blood is caught by a small stream of run-off and begins to wash a red streak down the alley.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Sedge 转过头，像是在想这事。"不，没想到哪个叫 Jethro 的。"

血泊汇聚成小股径流，在巷子里流淌出红色的纹路。

texts.en:
He makes an expression of mock confusion. "I just said. I am Sedge."

He drops the look. "But you want to know who I am to the Path. Who I am to this world, to people who might come here. Who I am to you. Who am I to what you are looking for."

He corrects himself, holding up a finger, "Whom you are looking for."
texts.zh:
他困惑的表情带着点嘲讽。"我刚才已经说过了。我就是 Sedge。"

他收起那副表情。"但你想知道我对于左径来说是谁。对于这个世界，对于将要来到这里的人们来说是谁。对你来说是谁。对你正在找的东西来说是谁。"

他竖起一根手指，自我纠正道，"是你正在寻找的人。"

texts.en:
"People find me. Those who seek the Path," he looks at you, the mask of casual ease drawing away to show you the ice-cold, self-assured fervor in his eyes.

"I judge if their path leads true. If it does," he shrugs. Merely the casual business of building an interstellar terrorism network.
texts.zh:
"那些希望加入左径的人会来找我。" 他看着你，脸上随意轻松的面具被揭下，显露出他眼中冰冷的、自信的狂热。

"我负责判断他们的意图是否真实。如果确实如此的话..." 他耸了耸肩，仿佛自己只是在处理组建星际恐怖主义网络这等寻常事务。

texts.en:
"Is that what I am?" He pauses a moment, then nods, "It is more, people find me. Those who seek the Path."

The mask of casual ease draws away to show you the ice-cold, self-assured fervor in his eyes. "I judge if their path leads true. If it does," he shrugs; merely the casual business of building an interstellar network of terrorism.
texts.zh:
"这就是我的身份吗？" 他顿了顿，然后点点头，"不止如此，那些希望加入左径的人会来找我。"

他脸上随意轻松的面具被揭下，显露出他眼中冰冷的、自信的狂热。"我负责判断他们的意图是否真实。如果确实如此的话..." 他耸了耸肩，仿佛自己只是在处理组建星际恐怖主义网络这等寻常事务。

texts.en:
"Why say such a thing? It is done," Sedge says.

"Maybe you want it back?" He smiles.
texts.zh:
"为何说这种话？这事早过去了。" Sedge 说道。

"也许你想我把茶吐出来？" 他露出微笑。

texts.en:
"I can because I do," he says. The smile sublimes away like ice in vacuum.

"I see you don't understand, spacer."

He keeps his gaze pinned on you as he swipes his hand across the table, sending cup and teapot flying to smash against a neighboring drinking-party. They raise a shout of offense.
texts.zh:
"我能，因为我正在这么做，" 他说道，脸上的笑容如同真空中的冰一般升华消散了。

"我看你是不明白，太空佬。"

他一边将目光死死锁在你身上，一边挥手扫过桌面，将茶杯和茶壶扫飞，砸在了邻近的几个酒徒桌上。他们发出愤怒的喊叫声。

texts.en:
A scrape of chairs on floor, and the shouts are quickly hushed by the outraged party's companions. Conversation dies in the room, and everyone at nearby tables takes in the situation. Upon seeing Sedge, they start to quietly file out of the teahouse.

Soon, you are left nearly alone.

Sedge moves his hand through a slow arc, a mockery of blessing, to indicate those who left the room, "They understand."

Another pot of tea and two new cups appear, the proprietor quickly retreating with a crunch of ceramic underfoot.
texts.zh:
在一阵椅子与地板的摩擦声后，那伙怒汉的喊叫声很快就被他们的同伴制止了。房间里顿时没了声音，附近桌子上的每个人都在打量着这一切。在看到 Sedge 后，他们开始一声不吭地涌出了茶馆。

很快，你几乎被独自一人地留在了这里。

Sedge 的手缓缓划过一道弧线，模仿着做出祝福的样子，指向那些离开的人，"而他们明白。"

又一壶茶和两个新杯子被端了上来，店主随即踩着陶瓷碎片迅速退了下去。

texts.en:
You signal the proprietor, who glances at the back of Sedge's head with a questioning look- really? With him right there? You confirm your order with a firm nod.

Soon enough the teapot arrives, smelling of liquor. Two cups are almost dropped and the proprietor retreats.

Sedge watches the whole procedure with his crooked smile, sets the two cups in place, fills them from the pot. He lifts his cup and looks at you expectantly.
texts.zh:
你向老板示意，他用询问的眼神瞥了一眼 Sedge 的后脑勺 —— 真的吗？他就在那里？你肯定地点了点头，确认了要点的东西。

很快，一壶茶就被端上来了，散发着酒香。两只杯子几乎是被扔到了吧台上，老板随即退了下去。

Sedge 歪着头微笑着看着整个过程，他把两个杯子放好，把它们倒满了茶。他举起杯子，期待地看着你。

options.en: Are you allowed to drink this?

texts.en:
"And may we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he adds, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en: "God will forgive me," he says, giving the cup a waggle.
texts.zh: "主会恕我的罪。" 他摇晃着杯子说。

texts.en:
"May we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he says, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en:
"That?" Sedge looks down, as if at a stone on the ground.

"That got careless. That forgot that one does not speak easily of the Path. The Path is sacred. It does not belong in the mouth of a decadent heathen."

His eyes flick downward again, "Like that."
texts.zh:
"他？" Sedge 垂下眼睛，像在看地上的石块。

"他没有谨言慎行。他忘了他不可妄言圣道。卢德之道如此圣洁，怎可出于堕落异端之口。"

他的眼睛又向下撇了一下，"就像他。"

texts.en: "No." He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: "不。" 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: You draw out your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en: You slowly draw your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你谨慎地掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en:
Sedge leans over to examine it.

"Ah." He speaks without hesitation, "Yes, I remember now. He went to Mazalot."
texts.zh:
Sedge 探身过来查看。

"啊。" 他毫不犹疑地说道，"对，我现在想起来了，他去了 Mazalot。"

texts.en:
Sedge considers his words for a moment. Sucking spittle through his tooth-gap.

"That man, his faith is true." Sedge swishes again. "But he... did not know his Path."
texts.zh:
Sedge 斟酌了一会，从牙缝里吸着气。

"那个男人，他的信仰坚定虔诚。" Sedge 低声说道，"但是他...没有领悟到他的道途。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands back suddenly, looking away down the alley.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him he had no place with us."

He speaks without meeting your eyes, "I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot."

"I hope they see what I saw, too. That... he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然后退一步，看向小巷另一边。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

他说话时没有看你的眼睛，"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。"

"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。就是...他不合适。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands, suddenly, a look of concern on his face.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him, he had no place with us."

"I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot," he says. "I hope they see what I saw, too. That he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然站了起来，脸上多了一丝关切的神色。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。" 他说，"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。他不合适。"

texts.en:
You would swear that Sedge is upset.

"No more questions," he spits. "We are done."

He walks away.
texts.zh:
你发誓，Sedge 分明是生气了。

"别再问了，" 他啐道，"我们到此为止。"

他转身走开了。

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

There are shouts and screams from patrons. Chaos, and flight. The room empties out, the proprietor ducks behind the bar.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

顾客们发出尖叫声。一片混乱，人们纷纷逃离。房间里空荡荡的，老板躲在吧台后面。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

The proprietor ducks behind the bar and scrabbles out some back door.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

老板翻身躲进吧台，从后门爬了出去。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the alley, a sharp crack.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

Silence follows the echoing shot, broken only by retreating footsteps as his thugs flee the scene.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。尖锐的枪声在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

回响之后，唯有他手下逃离的脚步声打破了沉默。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
You speak a sharp word into your comms and within seconds an echoing crack shoots down the alley.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

His thugs disappear. Tactical chatter from your guards - equipped with the best - tracks their flight from the spot.
texts.zh:
你对着通讯器说了个词，数秒后，一声巨响在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

他的手下消失了。你装备精良的保镖们说着战术术语，追踪着他们的逃跑路线。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a paper lantern slowly spinning in the rafters, casting a warm and murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼盯着一个在屋檐上慢慢旋转的纸灯笼，倒映着温暖而朦胧的光。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a translucent awning, rain spatter distorting a murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼凝视着半透明的雨篷，雨点扭曲了模糊的光线。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
You leave his body to return to your $shipOrFleet. The Path will know what to do with it.

They are sure to come after you, if they weren't before.
texts.zh:
你丢下了他的尸体，径直返回了你的$shipOrFleet。左径自然知道该怎么处理。

他们肯定会来追寻你的下落了，即便他们此前还没动手的话。

texts.en:
The proprietor, who was pretending to polish a samovar, releases an audible sigh of relief before giving you an accusing look. You suspect service will not be enthusiastic for you in this establishment in the future.

You have a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
之前一直在假装擦洗茶具的店主这时发出了一声如释重负的叹息，并用责备的眼神瞪了你一眼。你估计以后再也没法在这享受到什么热情的服务了。

不过你有了条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
Sedge disappears down a side-alley, and his thugs with him. You are left in the dripping alley with a corpse.

And a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
Sedge 消失在小巷另一头，他的手下和他一起走了，留下你和一具尸体。

还有一条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
The commlink opens with a shudder, error codes flashing from ancient protocols begrudgingly converted to current standards.

The Pather captain stares you down. "$playername," $heOrShe begins.
texts.zh:
伴着抖动和卡顿，通讯链接联通了。古老的通讯协议被强行转换符合现行规范，产生了一堆在不断闪烁的错误代码。

左径舰长盯着你。"$playername，" $heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
"You are known to us. You have spoken in support of the Path that is necessary and righteous to faithful walkers," $heOrShe smiles grimly for a moment, then drops it.

"So if you truly wish to serve the Path, cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
texts.zh:
"我们知道你。你曾发言支持左径，支持那条对忠实的求道者而言必要且正义的卢德之道。" $heOrShe狞笑了一会，然后收起表情。

"那么如果你真的希望侍奉于左径，就停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

texts.en:
"You are known to us. You shed blood for the Faith on Jangala by the Hegemony's cruel hand." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "Yes, we know of you."

$HeOrShe drops the smile, and continues. "Serve the Path again: cease your search. Do not pry into our operations, do not ask after one or another 'missing' recruit."
texts.zh:
"我们知道你。在 Jangala，你在 霸主 残酷的手上为信仰流过血。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"对，我们知道你的事。"

$HeOrShe收起笑容，继续说道，"再次侍奉左径吧：停止你的追寻。不要窥探我们的行动，不要探问无论哪个 '失踪' 的新成员。"

texts.en:
"I was told to cut you from the sky, to burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "But then I received a message. Brother Cotton believes that Providence has sung of your role in the final battle."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, dropping the smile. "I know not what to make of this. Nonetheless, I... ask... that you cease your search for this 'missing' recruit." $HeOrShe sighs, recognizing how pathetic this sounds.

"Ask yourself," $heOrShe pleads, "Who do you serve by this action? What lies at the end of this Path?"
texts.zh:
"有人叫我将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"但我之后收到一条消息。Cotton 修士相信上天认可你在最终之战里的贡献。"

$HeOrShe摇着头，收起笑容。"我不知道该怎么做。不管怎样，我...请求...你不要再寻找这个 '失踪' 的新成员了。" $HeOrShe叹道，意识到这听起来多么可悲。

"问问你自己，" $heOrShe恳求道，"在这个行动中你为谁服务？在这条道途的尽头有什么？"

texts.en: "You tread a dangerous path, $playerBrotherOrSister. I was sent here to cut you from the sky and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum. I pray that this shall not be necessary."
texts.zh: "你踏上了一条危险的道路，$playerBrotherOrSister。我被派来将你从天空斩落，将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。我希望我没有必要这么做。"

texts.en: "I will cut you from the sky, burn your fleet and scatter your ashes to the blessed vacuum." $HeOrShe smiles grimly, "This is where your path ends, for you have asked forbidden questions and searched for forbidden things."
texts.zh: "我会将你从天空斩落，燃尽你的舰队然后将你的骨灰撒入这神圣的虚空。" $HeOrShe狞笑着，"你既然问寻禁忌，那这便是你的终结。"

options.en: I'm not going to stop my search.
If that is what the Path demands, I will cease. (lie)
options.zh: 若是卢德之道所需，那我会就此停手。 (说谎)

options.en: I serve the Faith, and I search for a servant of the Faith. What would battle serve?
options.zh: 我为信仰服务，我在寻找信仰的仆从。战斗又有什么用呢？

options.en: I wish to serve the Path; finding Bornanew will serve the cause we share.
options.zh: 我愿奉卢德之道； 找到 Bornanew 对我们共同的事业是有益处的。

options.en: Finding Bornanew will serve the Path. Have faith.
options.zh: 找到 Bornanew 既是侍奉卢德之道。坚定你的信仰。

options.en: What else did Brother Cotton say? Is that all?
options.zh: Cotton 修士还说了什么？就这些么？

options.en: I need to contact Brother Cotton. I have something for him.
options.zh: 我需要联系 Cotton 修士。我有些东西给他。

options.en: You demand what your puny fleet cannot impose. Flee now.
options.zh: 你那弱小的舰队可给不了你底气。现在快逃吧。

options.en: You talk a lot. Sure you're up for this?
options.zh: 废话还挺多。你确定你准备好了么？

options.en: Stand down, $brotherOrSister. I am following the orders of Livewell Cotton.
options.zh: 停下，$brotherOrSister。我正在听从 Livewell Cotton 的命令。

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says, almost perplexed. "I shall attack if you do not desist."
texts.zh: "但你必须如此，" $heOrShe几乎是困惑不解地说出这些话，"你再不停下，我就要动武了。"

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says unhappily.
texts.zh: "但你必须那样，" $heOrShe不高兴地说。

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith, if not our Path, but that is enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，也许不是同行于圣道，但也够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith and a Path, and that must be enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，同行于道途，这就够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"I pray that I could believe you," $HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together for a moment, "But you are not of the Faith, nor of the Path. What value is the word of one who so denies the light of Ludd?"

$HeOrShe lets $hisOrHer hands drop. "Nothing. It is worth nothing. Even the truth, if indeed it is truth, is a lie in your heretic's mouth."
texts.zh:
"我祈愿我可以相信你，" $HeOrShe握住$hisOrHer的双手，"但你既无信仰，又不奉行卢德之道。一个否认卢德之光的人，他的言语又有何价值？"

$HeOrShe让$hisOrHer的手垂下。"没有。毫无价值。即使是真的，假使的确是真的，也是从你这异端之口中说出的谎言。"

texts.en:
"You too must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow Path we tread, and easily lost by those who pervert the teachings of Ludd and name their heresy Truth."

"Let me speak truth to you; I wish not to battle you. The strength of the Faithful is wasted when we fight amongst ourselves; and the devil-spawn of the Domain laugh as they watch. They think we're misguided fools, you know."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚的关心着你。"我们所行的圣道如此狭窄，极易为那些信奉异端邪说，扭曲卢德教导之人所迷惑。"

"让我来告诉你真相：我不想与你战斗。当我们自相残杀时，信徒的力量就被虚耗；而那些 人之领 的恶魔之子会看着我们大笑。你知道的，他们觉得我们是被误导的蠢货。"

options.en: We are no fools. Save your strength, $brotherOrSister.
options.zh: 我们不是蠢货。省省力气吧，$brotherOrSister。

options.en: You would be a fool, and a heretic besides, to stand in my way.
options.zh: 如果你挡了我的路，那你就是个蠢货，而且还是个异端。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe stares hard into your eyes, at least the holo-image of them, then brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."

After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe直视着你的眼睛，至少是全息影像上的眼睛，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

过了一会，$personName 张开$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes go hard. "It is as I fear. The false Church has corrupted you. It was said that the Adversary would cloak their lies in the sacrament, and here it is before me."

"May God's holy vacuum purify you," $heOrShe hisses.
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer双眼紧盯着你。"这就是我害怕的。你已经被那虚假的教会腐化。据说大敌会用圣礼掩盖谎言，正如我现在所见。"

"愿神圣的虚空将你净化。" $heOrShe嘶哑地说。

texts.en:
"You must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow and perilous Path we tread, beset by the false teachings of the Church on one side, and by the devil-spawn of the Domain on the other."

$HeOrShe sighs, and brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚地关心着你，"我们所行的圣道狭窄而崎岖，被虚伪谎言的异端教会所困，又被 人之领 的恶魔之子所围。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

texts.en:
After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
texts.zh:
过了一会，$personName 张开了$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

texts.en:
"I did not speak with Brother Cotton directly. A message was relayed," $heOrShe looks at you with curiosity and concern as $heOrShe speaks.

"My Path is to obey, so I obey."
texts.zh:
"我并没有直接同 Cotton 修士谈过。信息是被转达的。" $heOrShe说道，一边用着好奇而关切的目光看着你。

"我的道途是遵从，所以我便遵从。"

texts.en: "I... it is not my place." $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer forehead nervously. "I will... report your words to my superior. I can promise nothing."
texts.zh: "我... 我不负责这个。" $HeOrShe紧张的点了点$hisOrHer的脑袋。"我会... 向我的上级转达你的要求。我也不能给出任何保证。"

texts.en:
"I but asked," $heOrShe says, distressed. "And I shall not disobey Brother Cotton's orders. If you will not listen to my words, then I beg you pray. Pray! And listen for the song of the angels, because you will hear no more from me."

$HeOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"我只是问问。" $heOrShe苦恼的说，"我也不会违背 Cotton 修士的命令。如果你不想听我的话，那我请求你祈祷吧。祈祷吧！以听天使之颂歌，因你将不会听见我的言语。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"In that, you are mistaken. I prayed that our Paths would align, and a fellow $playerBrotherOrSister could walk with me. But here it ends for you- in God's holy vacuum."

The comms are cut.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"在这一点上，你错了。我祈祷你我的道途将要并行，一位 $playerBrotherOrSister 可以与我同行。但你的道途将在这里走向尽头 —— 在这神圣虚空之中。"

通讯被切断了。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"I obey, and I obey unto a righteous death in God's holy vacuum."

That said, $heOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"我遵从，我遵从直到在神圣虚空之中为公义而献身。"

这么说着，$heOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en: "Brother Cotton spoke to you?" $HisOrHer eyes narrow.
texts.zh: "Cotton 修士和你说话了？" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯起。

options.en: Yes, over tea. Would that we all could serve the Path with such grace and charm.
options.zh: 是的，边喝茶边谈。愿我们都能以如此的优雅和魅力侍奉于卢德之道。

texts.en:
"Would that we could indeed," $heOrShe says, perhaps thinking to some slight or misstep $heOrShe observed in the fellow Faithful.

"It is said that Brother Cotton hears the song of the angels, the whisper of pneuma itself. It is not for human ears, they say." $HeOrShe looks away wistfully, "He is like a prophet of old; touched by the divine."

Aware of how this sounds, $heOrShe quickly adds, "Not like Ludd, of course. The Word, that is another matter. What I mean to say is that, truly, it must be blessedly glorious."
texts.zh:
"要是我们能这样就好了，" $heOrShe说道，或许是想起了$heOrShe在一众信徒中曾经观察到的一些怠慢或是错误的行为。

"据说 Cotton 修士能听到天使的歌声，也就是圣灵的低语。他们说，这不是人类能听到的。" $HeOrShe深情地望着远方。"他就像古代的先知，被神灵所点化。"

意识到这听起来有些不妥当，$heOrShe连忙补充到，"当然了，不是像卢德那样。圣言中所述的，那是另一回事了。我实际上想说的是，那一定是无上光荣的。"

options.en: It must; truly we are blessed to walk aside him.
options.zh: 必须如此。我们能与他同行真是蒙了神的祝福。

texts.en:
"Truly! Oh, I am overcome- forgive me, I must pray."

Putting $hisOrHer hands together, the Pather goes on for some time about how wonderful Brother Cotton is, and how we should all follow his example and be so blessed.

And so on; you put your hands together and mumble something to keep up the act. Soon enough, the show is over, and persuade the Pather that $heOrShe may close the comms without yet another blessing.
texts.zh:
"真的！哦，我太激动了 —— 原谅我，我必须祈祷。"

将$hisOrHer的手合拢之后，左径分子滔滔不绝地赞颂 Cotton 修士是多么耀目，以及我等应当如何效仿他，才能以此蒙受赐福。

如此这般；你将双手合拢，含糊地念叨几句以跟上这出好戏。很快，表演拉下了帷幕，你也说服左径分子关闭了通讯，免得$heOrShe再来一轮祝颂。

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says, almost perplexed. "I shall attack if you do not desist."
texts.zh: "但你必须如此，" $heOrShe几乎是困惑不解地说出这些话，"你再不停下，我就要动武了。"

texts.en: "But you must," $heOrShe says unhappily.
texts.zh: "但你必须那样，" $heOrShe不高兴地说。

texts.en:
"I did not speak with Brother Cotton directly. A message was relayed," $heOrShe looks at you with curiosity and concern as $heOrShe speaks.

"My Path is to obey, so I obey."
texts.zh:
"我并没有直接同 Cotton 修士谈过。信息是被转达的。" $heOrShe说道，一边用着好奇而关切的目光看着你。

"我的道途是遵从，所以我便遵从。"

texts.en: "I... it is not my place." $HeOrShe rubs $hisOrHer forehead nervously. "I will... report your words to my superior. I can promise nothing."
texts.zh: "我... 我不负责这个。" $HeOrShe紧张的点了点$hisOrHer的脑袋。"我会... 向我的上级转达你的要求。我也不能给出任何保证。"

texts.en:
"I but asked," $heOrShe says, distressed. "And I shall not disobey Brother Cotton's orders. If you will not listen to my words, then I beg you pray. Pray! And listen for the song of the angels, because you will hear no more from me."

$HeOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"我只是问问。" $heOrShe苦恼的说，"我也不会违背 Cotton 修士的命令。如果你不想听我的话，那我请求你祈祷吧。祈祷吧！以听天使之颂歌，因你将不会听见我的言语。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"In that, you are mistaken. I prayed that our Paths would align, and a fellow $playerBrotherOrSister could walk with me. But here it ends for you- in God's holy vacuum."

The comms are cut.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"在这一点上，你错了。我祈祷你我的道途将要并行，一位 $playerBrotherOrSister 可以与我同行。但你的道途将在这里走向尽头 —— 在这神圣虚空之中。"

通讯被切断了。

texts.en:
The Pather shakes $hisOrHer head; grim, determined.

"I obey, and I obey unto a righteous death in God's holy vacuum."

That said, $heOrShe cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
左径摇了摇$hisOrHer的头；冷酷，坚定。

"我遵从，我遵从直到在神圣虚空之中为公义而献身。"

这么说着，$heOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith, if not our Path, but that is enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，也许不是同行于圣道，但也够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"Well decided, $playerBrotherOrSister. We share Faith and a Path, and that must be enough. We must do all in our worldly and spiritual power to halt that so-called church's perversion of Ludd's teachings."

$HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together, "Blessed be this day; may your Path lead you to righteous glory."
texts.zh:
"好决定，$playerBrotherOrSister。我们拥有同样的信仰，同行于道途，这就够了。我们需竭尽世俗和灵性之力，去阻止那所谓的教会扭曲卢德的教导。"

$HeOrShe紧握$hisOrHer的双手，"愿今日蒙福；愿你的道途引领你得公义的荣耀。"

texts.en:
"I pray that I could believe you," $HeOrShe holds $hisOrHer hands together for a moment, "But you are not of the Faith, nor of the Path. What value is the word of one who so denies the light of Ludd?"

$HeOrShe lets $hisOrHer hands drop. "Nothing. It is worth nothing. Even the truth, if indeed it is truth, is a lie in your heretic's mouth."
texts.zh:
"我祈愿我可以相信你，" $HeOrShe握住$hisOrHer的双手，"但你既无信仰，又不奉行卢德之道。一个否认卢德之光的人，他的言语又有何价值？"

$HeOrShe让$hisOrHer的手垂下。"没有。毫无价值。即使是真的，假使的确是真的，也是从你这异端之口中说出的谎言。"

texts.en:
"You too must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow Path we tread, and easily lost by those who pervert the teachings of Ludd and name their heresy Truth."

"Let me speak truth to you; I wish not to battle you. The strength of the Faithful is wasted when we fight amongst ourselves; and the devil-spawn of the Domain laugh as they watch. They think we're misguided fools, you know."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚的关心着你。"我们所行的圣道如此狭窄，极易为那些信奉异端邪说，扭曲卢德教导之人所迷惑。"

"让我来告诉你真相：我不想与你战斗。当我们自相残杀时，信徒的力量就被虚耗；而那些 人之领 的恶魔之子会看着我们大笑。你知道的，他们觉得我们是被误导的蠢货。"

options.en: We are no fools. Save your strength, $brotherOrSister.
options.zh: 我们不是蠢货。省省力气吧，$brotherOrSister。

options.en: You would be a fool, and a heretic besides, to stand in my way.
options.zh: 如果你挡了我的路，那你就是个蠢货，而且还是个异端。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe stares hard into your eyes, at least the holo-image of them, then brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."

After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe直视着你的眼睛，至少是全息影像上的眼睛，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

过了一会，$personName 张开$hisOrHer的眼睛。

"让我直说吧：我愿相信你的道途。无论此道引你去何方，别忘了我们为何而战。"

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes go hard. "It is as I fear. The false Church has corrupted you. It was said that the Adversary would cloak their lies in the sacrament, and here it is before me."

"May God's holy vacuum purify you," $heOrShe hisses.
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer双眼紧盯着你。"这就是我害怕的。你已经被那虚假的教会腐化。据说大敌会用圣礼掩盖谎言，正如我现在所见。"

"愿神圣的虚空将你净化。" $heOrShe嘶哑地说。

texts.en:
"You must pray on this, $playerBrotherOrSister," $heOrShe says with genuine concern. "It is a narrow and perilous Path we tread, beset by the false teachings of the Church on one side, and by the devil-spawn of the Domain on the other."

$HeOrShe sighs, and brings $hisOrHer hands together. "May Providence show me the way; by the stars and the pneuma and the revelation."
texts.zh:
"你需为此祈祷，$playerBrotherOrSister。" $heOrShe真诚地关心着你，"我们所行的圣道狭窄而崎岖，被虚伪谎言的异端教会所困，又被 人之领 的恶魔之子所围。"

$HeOrShe叹了口气，然后将$hisOrHer的手合起。"愿上天示我前路；以星辰、圣灵和启示。"

After a moment, $personName opens $hisOrHer eyes.

"Let me speak plainly now: I shall trust your Path. Wherever it leads you, remember what we fight for."

options.zh: 测试 Bornanew 那端的通讯状况

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link after exchanging a few pleasantries.
texts.zh: 你在寒暄了几句后切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link after exchanging a few pleasantries.
texts.zh: 你在寒暄了几句后切断了通讯链接。

options.en: Your administrator, Dardan Kato, seems to have a low opinion of 'Luddies'.
options.zh: 你们的管理员，Dardan Kato，好像对 '卢德佬' 们的评价很低。

texts.en:
You see $personName wince at the mention of 'Luddies'. $HeOrShe takes a moment. Composing diplomatic words, perhaps.

"It cannot be denied. I pray that he would not be so casual with his scorn. It is... unseemly. If the Mazalot Unification Authority is to be seen as serious about its purpose..."

"Um," $heOrShe is momentarily self-conscious, "But this is no time to talk politics. So. Are you having any trouble with commercial logistics on Mazalot?"
texts.zh:
你发现 $personName 在听到 '卢德佬' 一词时皱起了眉头。$HeOrShe停顿了一会，也许是在构思外交辞令。

"这是不可否认的，我祈祷他不要如此随意地表达自己的蔑视。这是...不体面的。如果 Mazalot 统一政权被视为对其目的很认真的话..."

"嗯，" $heOrShe有些不安，"但现在不是谈论政治的时候。所以，你在 Mazalot 的商业物流方面有什么问题吗？"
