texts.zh:
"谈到这里 —— 我很忙。还请祝你离开时航行无阻，太空佬。"

通讯中断了

texts.en: The line blinks a standby message for several minutes. There is no acknowledgement of your comms request.
texts.zh: 几分钟过去，通讯界面一直保持着待机状态。你的通讯请求没有回应。

texts.en: The line blinks a standby message for several minutes. There is no acknowledgement of your comms request.
texts.zh: 几分钟过去，通讯界面一直保持着待机状态。你的通讯请求没有回应。

texts.en:
You watch Dardan Kato's face stiffen; emotions - anger, annoyance, fear - erupt and crystalize.

"The Church." The words escape from his mouth like an inconvenient prisoner he'd rather everyone forgot. "Here."
texts.zh:
你看到 Dardan Kato 的脸变得僵硬，愤懑、恼怒、恐惧五味杂陈地凸显在他的脸上。

"教会。" 他像不愿意让别人听到一样吐出这句话，"到这里来了。"

options.en: Yes, I am searching for an agent of the Church. He came here.
options.zh: 是的，我正在搜寻一个隶属于教会的特工，他来过这里。

texts.en:
"No, you're not," he snaps. "You're not here. You're not welcome here. And we're not having this conversation."

The comms-link abruptly terminates.
texts.zh:
"不，你没有，" 他咆哮道，"别来这里。这里不欢迎你。我们也没有说过话。"

通信突然中断了。

texts.en:
You ask around about someone who might have connections with the Path, keeping your language indirect.

Spacers know that following local planetary rules and regulations is only really a game to be kept up, so you are only politely rebuffed and, in turn, politely turn down unwanted counter-offers about irrelevant opportunities.

Finally, you hit upon someone who seems to give the right responses. You slide over an "extra" drink you were given to start the procedure off on the right foot.
texts.zh:
你四下打听可能与 卢德左径 有联系的人，同时留意着别说得太直截了当。

宇宙民都知道遵守行星当地的规章制度实际上只是些不得不逢场作戏的东西，所以你只会被礼貌地拒绝。相对的，你也礼貌地拒绝了回过来的那些无关紧要的邀约。

最后，你终于碰到了一个似乎能给出正确答案的家伙。你拿了一份别人 "额外送的" 饮料过去凑近乎，让事情一下子就迈上了正轨。

options.en: I'm looking for someone. Having trouble finding the right path.
options.zh: 我在找人。但有些循不着正确的行径。

texts.en:
He nods, and deliberately lifts your drink, holds it up toward you in a subtle toast, then takes a sip.

"You may not be as lost as you think," he says. "I'm in information technology. Less the tech, more the sales, you know? Distribution of... useful information."

He makes a show of examining the drink you gave him. "This is nice to wet your throat. But I got a mighty thirst."
texts.zh:
他点点头，故意端起你的酒，朝你微微一敬，然后喝了一口。

"你可能没有想象中那么迷茫。"他说，"我是搞信息技术的。不在于技术，更多在于销售，你知道吗？分发...有用的信息。"

他做了一个检查你给他的饮料的动作。"用来润喉不错。但我非常口渴"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

options.en: Just info? Let's call it 1,000 credits.
options.zh: 只要一些消息？那就 1,000 星币吧。

options.en: I'm in a hurry, how's 3,000 credits?
options.zh: 我有些急事，3,000 星币怎么样？
抱歉，我的朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en: "1,000 credits and I will put you in contact with the Luddic Path," he says to confirm the substance of the deal, and pokes a datapad from under his sleeve for your transfer confirmation.
texts.zh: "1,000 星币，我会帮你联系到 卢德左径 。" 他确认了交易的内容，并从袖子下拿出一个数据平板，让你确认转账。

options.zh: 不好意思，朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en:
You touch the datapad and its screen flashes to a badge of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security. The agent gives you a little smile.

"Captain $playerName, by the power of the Mazalot Unification Authority, you are charged with criminal conspiracy under the Interstellar Terrorism Statute of-"

He drones on in legalese, relishing the act.

You consider your options: you suspect reprisals for dodging out of this entrapment scheme will be token at best - it feels like a credit-rustling op to scam naive spacers more than any kind of serious investigation.
texts.zh:
你接过数据平板，屏幕上随即闪现出 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的徽章。伪装的特工向你微微一笑。

"$playerName 舰长，根据 Mazalot 统一政权授予的权力，你被指控违反星际恐怖主义法 ——"

他得意地拖着长腔，一边念着法律术语，似乎很享受这个过程。

你在考虑自己的选择：你怀疑，就算摆脱了这场钓鱼执法，当局的报复行动充其量也只会是象征性的 —— 这感觉更像是一场欺骗天真宇宙民的星币诈骗，而不是什么严肃的调查。

options.en: Before we continue, allow me to show you my diplomatic credentials from Gens Yaribay.
options.zh: 在我们继续之前，请允许我向你展示我从 Yaribay 氏族那里得到的外交证书。

options.en: Agent, you should know that I am a commissioned privateer of the Persean League Fleet.
options.zh: 特工，你应该知道我是 英仙座联盟 舰队的一名授权私掠者。

options.en: Agent, I am acting on behalf of an archcurate of the Church of Galactic Redemption.
options.zh: 特工，我是 银河救赎教会 一名大祭司的代表。

options.en: My name is Finlay Siyavong of Fleet Intelligence and I have questions for you.
options.zh: 我是舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong，我有问题要问你。

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 给 MUA 特工的脸来上一拳，然后迅速逃跑

texts.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, and looks at you. You've already got your TriPad out, credentials displayed. He quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and yours. Hoping, perhaps, that these aren't what you claim they are.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the insincere smile off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. Gens Yaribay is a respected operator which the MUA, naturally, welcomes within the local commercial volume. If MuniSec can be of any assistance in your, ah, business..."
texts.zh:
特工在讲话的过程中突然停住，直勾勾地看着你。你已经拿出了 TriPad 并展示出身份验证信息。他迅速地敲了几下数据平板，拿它和你的 TriPad 反复对比。也许他希望那些信息并不如你所说的那样一致。

"舰长。" 特工挺了挺身子，把数据平板塞回去，撤掉了脸上那虚伪的笑容。"恐怕我们之间有些误会。Yaribay 氏族备受尊敬，MUA 自然也欢迎他们在当地进行商业活动。如果地方安全部能够，呃，在商业方面提供帮助..."

options.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
options.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

texts.en:
Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Effectively runs the Path on Mazalot.

"You need to watch out for that one," the agent stows his datapad and stands. "Slippery customer, he is. Can't nail him on one thing or another, always some young Luddie will come to confess in his place." The agent looks at you with comradely bonhomie, "Glad they finally called in the big guns. You gonna..." he makes a finger pistol motion, and winks.

"Not that you could tell me, I suppose."
texts.zh:
不久之后，对方就将当地左径头目 Nile Virens 的档案转移到了你的数据平板上。联系方式、地址和不完整的生物信息。在所有的主要卢德教徒聚居地都有驻地。在 Mazalot 上有效地指挥左径活动。

"你需要提防那个人，" 特工收起数据平板并站了起来。"他确实是个狡猾的人。在哪一点上都没法定他的罪，总有些年轻的卢德佬会替他顶罪。" 特工用一种同志般和蔼的眼神看着你，"很高兴他们终于呼叫了大炮。你要..." 他比了一个枪的手势，眨了眨眼睛。

"我猜你也不会告诉我。"

options.en: Your assistance will be noted in the after action report.
options.zh: 你的帮助会记录在行动后的报告内。

texts.en: The agent's eyes light up at this, and their mouth opens to speak more - but you've already turned away.
texts.zh: 特工眼睛一亮，正准备开口说些什么 —— 但你已经转身离开了。

texts.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, looks at you - yes, you mean it - then quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and you.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the smile wiped off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. The MUA, naturally, fully supports the League Fleet," his eyes meet yours, and he makes a comradely nod, "-and the commissioned privateers who bolster our forces."

"On behalf of Mazalot MuniSec, allow me to render any required assistance with, ah, Fleet operations..."
texts.zh:
这个特工话说到一半戛然而止，看向了你 —— 是的，你没在开玩笑 —— 然后在数据平板上飞快地敲了几下，目光在你和平板之间来回对照。

"这位舰长，" 数据平板被收到了一边，这个特工站的笔直，脸上抹去了笑容，"之前恐怕有一些误解。MUA 组织，理所当然地，全力以赴地，支持着联盟舰队，" 他与你目光交接，亲切地点头，"—— 以及让我们的部队如虎添翼的签约私掠者们。"

"请允许我代表 Mazalot 地方安全部，为，呃，舰队行动，提供一切必要的协助..."

options.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
options.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

texts.en:
"Yeah? Well good for Ludd." The agent holds up his datapad, which blinks a flash at you for a quick holo to register your 'crime'.

"Maybe you can pay your fine with all those tithes you Luddies collect from little old grannies. And it is," another couple taps, "5,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"哦？那卢德可真好。" 特工举起数据平板，随着一阵闪烁，他迅速地给你拍了一张全息影像，好用来登记你的 '罪行'。

"或许你可以掏出你们这些卢德佬从可怜的老奶奶们那里收来的什一税，来支付你的罚金。而这个数额是，" 他又在平板上敲了几下，"5,000 星币。"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

options.en: I'm not sure this aligns with Administrator Kato's policies. Perhaps we should comms him and ask?
options.zh: 我不确定这是否符合 Kato 管理员的政策。也许我们应该联系他？

options.en: (raise your voice) "I would think that the MUA would cooperate with a Church investigation into Pather activity."
options.zh: (提高声音) "我认为 MUA 会配合教会对左径分子活动的调查。"

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 给 MUA 特工的脸来上一拳，然后迅速逃跑

texts.en: The agent freezes, hunched over the datapad with the spurious 'fine' transaction request blinking. His eyes stare unblinking at you, expression grim. Deciding if you're serious.
texts.zh: 特工僵住了，弯腰盯着数据平板，上面闪烁着伪造的 '罚款' 交易请求。他的眼睛一眨不眨地看着你，表情严峻，判断你是否是认真的。

texts.en: You stared down the Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus. A munisec officer from Mazalot? He's nothing. A bilge-roach before the Dragon of Orion.
texts.zh: 你傲视着 Hesperus 的行星教卫。区区 Mazalot 来的地方安全部官员？不值一提。在伟大的猎户座之龙面前，他不过是一只舱底的蟑螂罢了。

texts.en:
His eyes stare with the dumb authority of a machine set to an aggression routine. There is no human connection, no empathy. You can only imagine this as the look given by a gamma AI stripped of its theory of mind in some dim Tri-Tachyon blacksite.

"The fine," he says, "Is 5,000 credits."
texts.zh:
他的眼神死板而权威，就像一台设定了攻击程序的机器。没有人与人之间的联系，没有同理心。在你的想像中，只有一个身处速子科技秘密空间站，被剥夺了情感模块的 Gamma 级 AI 才能有此等表情。

"罚款，" 他说，"5,000 星币。"

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

texts.en: Your gaze sears like plasma, it tears the munisec bully apart like a graviton beam cannon flashing across the blood-and-ash flecked volume of space battle; you've seen things he wouldn't believe. Unimaginable vastnesses, vacuum most terrible and cruel.
texts.zh: 你的目光像等离子体一样灼热，它撕裂了这个地方安全部的恶霸，就像引力子束在遍布血与灰的太空战场中闪耀；你看到了他不会相信的事情。难以想象的浩瀚，最可怕和残酷的真空。

texts.en:
He drops his eyes to his silly parking-warden's datapad. Bashfully, he tucks it into a pocket while mumbling something about a misunderstanding, and shuffles away.

You stand alone.
texts.zh:
他的目光落在了他愚蠢的泊位管理员数据平板上。他害羞地把平板塞进口袋，嘴里嘟囔着误会，拖着脚步走开了。

你独自站着。

texts.en:
A solid blow sends the security officer toppling back into a table which obediently flips, spilling glassware and tipsy spacers across the bar.

The MuniSec undercovers that were watching you the whole time from the bar leap to their feet, drawing stun prods.

You manage to avoid them thanks to the shouting, chaos, and your bodyguards' admirable job of running interference without appearing to be associated with you.
texts.zh:
重重的一击使安保人员摔倒在桌子上，桌子乖乖地翻了过来，让玻璃器皿和醉鬼洒落在酒吧里。

一直监视着你的地方安全部便衣站了起来，抽出电击器。

你成功地避开了他们，这要归功于喊叫、混乱，以及你的保镖在没有暴露和你关系的前提下进行的令人钦佩的干扰。

texts.en:
As you slip out of the bar, leaving the sound of breaking glass and shouting behind, you reflect that the MuniSec goons were definitely running holo-rec, so it's not a clean getaway.

But it's also probably not worth the real authorities making too much a fuss about, either. You wouldn't be the first spacer to run from a brawl, not on Mazalot, not anywhere, and allowances must be made for the commerce your type brings to these worlds.

Someone will remember, however.
texts.zh:
你溜出酒吧，玻璃破碎和呐喊起哄的声音抛在身后。这时你忽然回想到那些地方安全部的蠢货们肯定都开着全息记录仪，因此这并不是一次完美的逃亡。

但这或许也不是什么值得当局大惊小怪的事。毕竟你又不是第一个干架之后跑路的太空佬，这种事无论在 Mazalot 还是在其他的什么地方都不可能没发生过。而考虑到你们这种人能带来的商业价值，一些忍让肯定还是会被做出的。

不过嘛，某个人肯定会记得的。

texts.en:
You pay the fine.

"Stay safe, citizen." The MUA agent produces a perfunctory forge-duplicated smile, "This place is crawling with terrorist sympathizers."

He leaves.
texts.zh:
你交了罚款。

"注意安全，公民。" MUA 特工露出敷衍、虚伪的微笑，"这个地方挤满了恐怖分子的同情者。"

他离开了。

texts.en:
Heads turn. The party at a neighboring table does a double-take and decides now is a good time to pay the tab.

The agent fixes you with his eyes, and smirks coldly. "I see what you're trying. The Church doesn't run this polity, the League does."

He stares unblinking at you. Assessing.
texts.zh:
你瞬间化为目光焦点。邻桌聚会的人又仔细打量了一下，决定趁现在这个好时机赶紧付账走人。

特工的目光锁定了你，脸上挂着冰冷的假笑。"我知道你在试探些什么。教会不是这个国家的主事者，联盟才是。"

他目不转睛地凝视着你，揣摩不定。

texts.en:
This cop is local munisec, and a corrupt bottom-feeder at that. You know that such a bully is easily bullied if they believe you're higher-ranking. And the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service is an elite among the League, filled with Gens-heirs.

"Officer." You affect the aristocratic accent of Kazeron and its self-assured authority, "Think very carefully before you respond."
texts.zh:
这条子隶属地方安全部，一个腐败的底层混混。你知道如果这样的恶霸相信你的地位更高，他们很容易屈服。而英仙座联盟舰队情报部是联盟中的精英，里面都是氏族子弟。

"警官。" 你带着 Kazeron 的贵族口音，还有自信和优越感，"回答前好好想想。"

texts.en:
"I didn't want to come to this Luddie-infested backwater of a failed terraforming experiment to hunt Pathers, but Intel smelled rot. Do you know what that means? - Don't answer. We have heard reports - disturbing reports - about the accounts of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security branch."

The officer is on his back heel, sweating. Nearby tables are carefully pretending not to listen to your tirade.

"'Riddled with Pather credits' is what I've heard. And as you well know per the League's Interstellar Terrorism Statute - which you so helpfully quoted for me - that means that central oversight is empowered to intervene in local affairs."
texts.zh:
"我本来也不想到这个地貌改造失败的穷乡僻壤，在到处滋生的卢德佬里面追猎左径分子，但情报中透露出一股不妙的气息。你知道那意味着什么吗？—— 不用回答。我收到一些令人不安的报告，与 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的账目有关。"

这个军官立正站直，汗水涔涔而下。附近几桌人小心翼翼地装作没听到你的长篇大论。

"关于左径分子资金来源的流言，已经充斥了我的耳朵。而正如你所熟知的那样，根据联盟的星际恐怖主义法 —— 就是你之前帮我引用的那个 —— 这意味着中央监督机构将有权干预地方事务。"

texts.en:
"Do you know what that means? Do not respond, officer, I am not finished."

You continue the dress-down, describing the various powers that the central League executive can hammer down upon members found to be involved in abetting terrorism - Mairaath's millions dead were fresh in the minds of the composers of the League's constitution, and the powers enumerated to stop a repeat of the event are far-reaching indeed.

It is, you reflect, a good thing you paid attention to League history.
texts.zh:
"你知道这意味着什么吗？别急着回答，长官，我还没说完。"

你继续斥责着，描述了联盟中央行政部门可以对被发现参与教唆恐怖主义的成员施加的各种处罚 —— Mairaath 的数百万死者在联盟的规则制定者们心中记忆犹新，而为阻止事件重演而被赋予的权力确实意义深远。

你庆幸到，还好你之前研究过联盟的历史。

texts.en:
Before long, you have the munisec officer silent and near-tears across from you in a booth while you browse local security reports on their datapad using their own login.

You find exactly what you need - Nile Virens, local Pather strongman. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers.

After transferring the information to your own TriPad you toss the officer's datapad across the table. He is too slow to catch it, and it clatters to the ground.
texts.zh:
没过多久，你们坐进了一个小隔间。你对面的地方安全部的官员正在努力憋住眼泪，而你，拿着这位官员的平板，用着这位官员的账号，浏览着本地安全报告。

你准确无误地找到了你要的东西 —— Nile Virens，本地左径分子中的铁腕人物。在所有重要的卢德人口中心，都有他经营的院落。

把信息传输到自己的 TriPad 之后，你隔着桌子把这个官员的数据平板丢了过去。他慢了一拍，没能接住，平板摔到地上咔哒作响。

texts.en:
The official datapad disappears and a different, somewhat more battered one appears in its place. A credits transfer request awaits your confirmation.

"You may pay your, ah, fine right here. I understand that you've expressed remorse for the breach of law, so I'll make sure this incident doesn't appear on your record."

He winks.
texts.zh:
官方的数据平板消失了，取而代之的是另一个更破旧的数据平板。一笔星币转账等待着你的确认。

"你可以在这缴纳你的，啊，罚款。我知道你已经对违法行为表示悔恨，所以我会确保这件事不会出现在官方记录中。"

他眨了眨眼。

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

texts.en:
As the transfer chimes complete, the officer makes a perfectly insincere smile.

"Stay safe, citizen," he says.
texts.zh:
转账提示响了之后，特工露出了一个一点不真诚的微笑。

"注意安全，公民。" 他说。

options.en: Hold on. I paid for information - I expect to get it.
options.zh: 等下。我为这情报付了钱的 —— 我可期望得到它。

texts.en:
Confusion, then a sneer grows on his face.

"Don't get smart with me, spacer - you don't want to catch me in a bad mood."
texts.zh:
他脸上浮现出一阵困惑，随后转为冷笑。

"别跟我耍小聪明，太空佬 —— 你不会想让我心情不好的。"

options.en: Shall we call up Dardan Kato and explain the bribe I just paid?
options.zh: 我们要和 Dardan Kato 联络并解释下我刚刚的贿赂吗？

options.en: Shall we call up the administrator and explain the bribe I just paid?
options.zh: 我们要和管理员联络并解释我刚刚的贿赂吗？

texts.en:
His sneer fades. You wouldn't be so stupid, his look says, would you? You give a little nod; yes, you would. You've done far stupider and walked away intact.

Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Runs the Path, such as it is, on Mazalot.

"You deserve each other," the officer grumbles as he makes his exit.
texts.zh:
他的冷笑消失了。你有那么蠢吗？不会吧？他仿佛在用表情这么问。你轻轻点头。没错，你就那么蠢。你还做过蠢得更离谱的事，而且能全身而退。

不久之后，你让一份关于本地左径铁腕人物 Nile Virens 的档案转到了你的数据平板上。包括相关人士信息、地址和一份零散不堪的简介。在所有主要的卢德聚居区都运营有定居点。那基本上就是在暗地里领导整个 Mazalot 的左径了。

"你们俩都是自找的。" 特工在离开时抱怨道。

texts.en: "3,000 credits and I will put you in contact with the Luddic Path" he says to confirm the substance of the deal, and holds out a datapad for your transfer.
texts.zh: "3,000 星币，我会帮你联系到 卢德左径。" 他确认了交易的内容，并从袖子下拿出一个数据平板让你转账。

options.zh: 不好意思，朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en:
You ask around about someone who might have connections with the Path, keeping your language indirect. You have developed a sense of wariness after the whole incident with the Mammonite on Chalcedon.

Spacers know that following local planetary rules and regulations is only really a game to be kept up, so you are only politely rebuffed and, in turn, can politely turn down unwanted counter-offers about some irrelevant opportunity or other.

Finally, you hit upon someone who exudes restrained competence. You slide over an "extra" drink you were given, to start the procedure off on the right foot.
texts.zh:
你四下打听可能与 卢德左径 有联系的人，同时留意着别说得太直截了当。你慢慢地觉察到在 Chalcedon 的那个 玛门之仆 出了那些事之后，周围多了一些警惕的意味。

宇宙民都知道遵守行星当地的规章制度实际上只是些不得不逢场作戏的东西，所以你只会被礼貌地拒绝。相对的，你也礼貌地拒绝了回过来的那些无关紧要的邀约。

最后，你终于碰到了一个似乎能给出正确答案的家伙。你把一份 "额外送的" 饮料滑过去凑近乎，让事情一下子就迈上了正轨。

options.en: I'm looking for someone. Having trouble finding the right... path.
options.zh: 我在找人。但有些循不着正确的... 行径。

texts.en:
He nods, and deliberately lifts your drink, holds it up toward you in a subtle toast, then takes a sip.

"You may not be as lost as you think," he says. "I'm in information technology. Less the tech, more the sales, you know? Distribution of... useful information."

He makes a show of examining the drink you gave him. "This is nice to wet your throat. But I got a mighty thirst."
texts.zh:
他点点头，故意端起你的酒，朝你微微一敬，然后喝了一口。

"你可能没有想象中那么迷茫。"他说，"我是搞信息技术的。不在于技术，更多在于销售，你知道吗？分发...有用的信息。"

他做了一个检查你给他的饮料的动作。"用来润喉不错。但我非常口渴"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

options.en: Just info? Let's call it 1,000 credits.
options.zh: 只要一些消息？那就 1,000 星币吧。

options.en: I'm in a hurry, how's 3,000 credits?
options.zh: 我有些急事，3,000 星币怎么样？
抱歉，我的朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en: "1,000 credits and I will put you in contact with the Luddic Path," he says to confirm the substance of the deal, and pokes a datapad from under his sleeve for your transfer confirmation.
texts.zh: "1,000 星币，我会帮你联系到 卢德左径 。" 他确认了交易的内容，并从袖子下拿出一个数据平板，让你确认转账。

options.zh: 不好意思，朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en: "3,000 credits and I will put you in contact with the Luddic Path" he says to confirm the substance of the deal, and holds out a datapad for your transfer.
texts.zh: "3,000 星币，我会帮你联系到 卢德左径。" 他确认了交易的内容，并从袖子下拿出一个数据平板让你转账。

options.zh: 不好意思，朋友。水龙头里没水了。 (离开)

texts.en:
You touch the datapad and its screen flashes to a badge of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security. The agent gives you a little smile.

"Captain $playerName, by the power of the Mazalot Unification Authority, you are charged with criminal conspiracy under the Interstellar Terrorism Statute of-"

He drones on in legalese, relishing the act.

You consider your options: you suspect reprisals for dodging out of this entrapment scheme will be token at best - it feels like a credit-rustling op to scam naive spacers more than any kind of serious investigation.
texts.zh:
你接过数据平板，屏幕上随即闪现出 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的徽章。伪装的特工向你微微一笑。

"$playerName 舰长，根据 Mazalot 统一政权授予的权力，你被指控违反星际恐怖主义法 ——"

他得意地拖着长腔，一边念着法律术语，似乎很享受这个过程。

你在考虑自己的选择：你怀疑，就算摆脱了这场钓鱼执法，当局的报复行动充其量也只会是象征性的 —— 这感觉更像是一场欺骗天真宇宙民的星币诈骗，而不是什么严肃的调查。

texts.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, and looks at you. You've already got your TriPad out, credentials displayed. He quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and yours. Hoping, perhaps, that these aren't what you claim they are.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the insincere smile off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. Gens Yaribay is a respected operator which the MUA, naturally, welcomes within the local commercial volume. If MuniSec can be of any assistance in your, ah, business..."
texts.zh:
特工在讲话的过程中突然停住，直勾勾地看着你。你已经拿出了 TriPad 并展示出身份验证信息。他迅速地敲了几下数据平板，拿它和你的 TriPad 反复对比。也许他希望那些信息并不如你所说的那样一致。

"舰长。" 特工挺了挺身子，把数据平板塞回去，撤掉了脸上那虚伪的笑容。"恐怕我们之间有些误会。Yaribay 氏族备受尊敬，MUA 自然也欢迎他们在当地进行商业活动。如果地方安全部能够，呃，在商业方面提供帮助..."

options.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
options.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

texts.en:
The agent freezes mid-speech, looks at you - yes, you mean it - then quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and you.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the smile wiped off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. The MUA, naturally, fully supports the League Fleet," his eyes meet yours, and he makes a comradely nod, "-and the commissioned privateers who bolster our forces."

"On behalf of Mazalot MuniSec, allow me to render any required assistance with, ah, Fleet operations..."
texts.zh:
这个特工话说到一半戛然而止，看向了你 —— 是的，你没在开玩笑 —— 然后在数据平板上飞快地敲了几下，目光在你和平板之间来回对照。

"这位舰长，" 数据平板被收到了一边，这个特工站的笔直，脸上抹去了笑容，"之前恐怕有一些误解。MUA 组织，理所当然地，全力以赴地，支持着联盟舰队，" 他与你目光交接，亲切地点头，"—— 以及让我们的部队如虎添翼的签约私掠者们。"

"请允许我代表 Mazalot 地方安全部，为，呃，舰队行动，提供一切必要的协助..."

options.en: Who runs the Path around here? I need information.
options.zh: 谁在指挥附近的左径分子？我需要他的信息。

texts.en:
Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Effectively runs the Path on Mazalot.

"You need to watch out for that one," the agent stows his datapad and stands. "Slippery customer, he is. Can't nail him on one thing or another, always some young Luddie will come to confess in his place." The agent looks at you with comradely bonhomie, "Glad they finally called in the big guns. You gonna..." he makes a finger pistol motion, and winks.

"Not that you could tell me, I suppose."
texts.zh:
不久之后，对方就将当地左径头目 Nile Virens 的档案转移到了你的数据平板上。联系方式、地址和不完整的生物信息。在所有的主要卢德教徒聚居地都有驻地。在 Mazalot 上有效地指挥左径活动。

"你需要提防那个人，" 特工收起数据平板并站了起来。"他确实是个狡猾的人。在哪一点上都没法定他的罪，总有些年轻的卢德佬会替他顶罪。" 特工用一种同志般和蔼的眼神看着你，"很高兴他们终于呼叫了大炮。你要..." 他比了一个枪的手势，眨了眨眼睛。

"我猜你也不会告诉我。"

options.en: Your assistance will be noted in the after action report.
options.zh: 你的帮助会记录在行动后的报告内。

texts.en:
"Yeah? Well good for Ludd." The agent holds up his datapad, which blinks a flash at you for a quick holo to register your 'crime'.

"Maybe you can pay your fine with all those tithes you Luddies collect from little old grannies. And it is," another couple taps, "5,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"哦？那卢德可真好。" 特工举起数据平板，随着一阵闪烁，他迅速地给你拍了一张全息影像，好用来登记你的 '罪行'。

"或许你可以掏出你们这些卢德佬从可怜的老奶奶们那里收来的什一税，来支付你的罚金。而这个数额是，" 他又在平板上敲了几下，"5,000 星币。"

texts.en: You have $player.creditsStrC available.
texts.zh: You have $player.creditsStrC available.

texts.en: The agent freezes, hunched over the datapad with the spurious 'fine' transaction request blinking. His eyes stare unblinking at you, expression grim. Deciding if you're serious.
texts.zh: 特工僵住了，弯腰盯着数据平板，上面闪烁着伪造的 '罚款' 交易请求。他的眼睛一眨不眨地看着你，表情严峻，判断你是否是认真的。

texts.en:
Heads turn. The party at a neighboring table does a double-take and decides now is a good time to pay the tab.

The agent fixes you with his eyes, and smirks coldly. "I see what you're trying. The Church doesn't run this polity, the League does."

He stares unblinking at you. Assessing.
texts.zh:
你瞬间化为目光焦点。邻桌聚会的人又仔细打量了一下，决定趁现在这个好时机赶紧付账走人。

特工的目光锁定了你，脸上挂着冰冷的假笑。"我知道你在试探些什么。教会不是这个国家的主事者，联盟才是。"

他目不转睛地凝视着你，揣摩不定。

texts.en: You stared down the Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus. A munisec officer from Mazalot? He's nothing. A bilge-roach before the Dragon of Orion.
texts.zh: 你傲视着 Hesperus 的行星教卫。区区 Mazalot 来的地方安全部官员？不值一提。在伟大的猎户座之龙面前，他不过是一只舱底的蟑螂罢了。

texts.en: Your gaze sears like plasma, it tears the munisec bully apart like a graviton beam cannon flashing across the blood-and-ash flecked volume of space battle; you've seen things he wouldn't believe. Unimaginable vastnesses, vacuum most terrible and cruel.
texts.zh: 你的目光像等离子体一样灼热，它撕裂了这个地方安全部的恶霸，就像引力子束在遍布血与灰的太空战场中闪耀；你看到了他不会相信的事情。难以想象的浩瀚，最可怕和残酷的真空。

texts.en:
He drops his eyes to his silly parking-warden's datapad. Bashfully, he tucks it into a pocket while mumbling something about a misunderstanding, and shuffles away.

You stand alone.
texts.zh:
他的目光落在了他愚蠢的泊位管理员数据平板上。他害羞地把平板塞进口袋，嘴里嘟囔着误会，拖着脚步走开了。

你独自站着。

texts.en:
His eyes stare with the dumb authority of a machine set to an aggression routine. There is no human connection, no empathy. You can only imagine this as the look given by a gamma AI stripped of its theory of mind in some dim Tri-Tachyon blacksite.

"The fine," he says, "Is 5,000 credits."
texts.zh:
他的眼神死板而权威，就像一台设定了攻击程序的机器。没有人与人之间的联系，没有同理心。在你的想像中，只有一个身处速子科技秘密空间站，被剥夺了情感模块的 Gamma 级 AI 才能有此等表情。

"罚款，" 他说，"5,000 星币。"

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

texts.en:
You pay the fine.

"Stay safe, citizen." The MUA agent produces a perfunctory forge-duplicated smile, "This place is crawling with terrorist sympathizers."

He leaves.
texts.zh:
你交了罚款。

"注意安全，公民。" MUA 特工露出敷衍、虚伪的微笑，"这个地方挤满了恐怖分子的同情者。"

他离开了。

texts.en:
The official datapad disappears and a different, somewhat more battered one appears in its place. A credits transfer request awaits your confirmation.

"You may pay your, ah, fine right here. I understand that you've expressed remorse for the breach of law, so I'll make sure this incident doesn't appear on your record."

He winks.
texts.zh:
官方的数据平板消失了，取而代之的是另一个更破旧的数据平板。一笔星币转账等待着你的确认。

"你可以在这缴纳你的，啊，罚款。我知道你已经对违法行为表示悔恨，所以我会确保这件事不会出现在官方记录中。"

他眨了眨眼。

options.en: Punch the MUA agent in the face and make a break for it
options.zh: 在 MUA 特工的脸上来一拳，然后逃跑

texts.en:
As the transfer chimes complete, the officer makes a perfectly insincere smile.

"Stay safe, citizen," he says.
texts.zh:
转账提示响了之后，特工露出了一个一点不真诚的微笑。

"注意安全，公民。" 他说。

options.en: Hold on. I paid for information - I expect to get it.
options.zh: 等下。我为这情报付了钱的 —— 我可期望得到它。

texts.en:
Confusion, then a sneer grows on his face.

"Don't get smart with me, spacer - you don't want to catch me in a bad mood."
texts.zh:
他脸上浮现出一阵困惑，随后转为冷笑。

"别跟我耍小聪明，太空佬 —— 你不会想让我心情不好的。"

texts.en:
His sneer fades. You wouldn't be so stupid, his look says, would you? You give a little nod; yes, you would. You've done far stupider and walked away intact.

Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Runs the Path, such as it is, on Mazalot.

"You deserve each other," the officer grumbles as he makes his exit.
texts.zh:
他的冷笑消失了。你有那么蠢吗？不会吧？他仿佛在用表情这么问。你轻轻点头。没错，你就那么蠢。你还做过蠢得更离谱的事，而且能全身而退。

不久之后，你让一份关于本地左径铁腕人物 Nile Virens 的档案转到了你的数据平板上。包括相关人士信息、地址和一份零散不堪的简介。在所有主要的卢德聚居区都运营有定居点。那基本上就是在暗地里领导整个 Mazalot 的左径了。

"你们俩都是自找的。" 特工在离开时抱怨道。

texts.en:
A solid blow sends the security officer toppling back into a table which obediently flips, spilling glassware and tipsy spacers across the bar.

The MuniSec undercovers that were watching you the whole time from the bar leap to their feet, drawing stun prods.

You manage to avoid them thanks to the shouting, chaos, and your bodyguards' admirable job of running interference without appearing to be associated with you.
texts.zh:
重重的一击使安保人员摔倒在桌子上，桌子乖乖地翻了过来，让玻璃器皿和醉鬼洒落在酒吧里。

一直监视着你的地方安全部便衣站了起来，抽出电击器。

你成功地避开了他们，这要归功于喊叫、混乱，以及你的保镖在没有暴露和你关系的前提下进行的令人钦佩的干扰。

texts.en:
As you slip out of the bar, leaving the sound of breaking glass and shouting behind, you reflect that the MuniSec goons were definitely running holo-rec, so it's not a clean getaway.

But it's also probably not worth the real authorities making too much a fuss about, either. You wouldn't be the first spacer to run from a brawl, not on Mazalot, not anywhere, and allowances must be made for the commerce your type brings to these worlds.

Someone will remember, however.
texts.zh:
你溜出酒吧，玻璃破碎和呐喊起哄的声音抛在身后。这时你忽然回想到那些地方安全部的蠢货们肯定都开着全息记录仪，因此这并不是一次完美的逃亡。

但这或许也不是什么值得当局大惊小怪的事。毕竟你又不是第一个干架之后跑路的太空佬，这种事无论在 Mazalot 还是在其他的什么地方都不可能没发生过。而考虑到你们这种人能带来的商业价值，一些忍让肯定还是会被做出的。

不过嘛，某个人肯定会记得的。

texts.en:
This cop is local munisec, and a corrupt bottom-feeder at that. You know that such a bully is easily bullied if they believe you're higher-ranking. And the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service is an elite among the League, filled with Gens-heirs.

"Officer." You affect the aristocratic accent of Kazeron and its self-assured authority, "Think very carefully before you respond."
texts.zh:
这条子隶属地方安全部，一个腐败的底层混混。你知道如果这样的恶霸相信你的地位更高，他们很容易屈服。而英仙座联盟舰队情报部是联盟中的精英，里面都是氏族子弟。

"警官。" 你带着 Kazeron 的贵族口音，还有自信和优越感，"回答前好好想想。"

texts.en:
"I didn't want to come to this Luddie-infested backwater of a failed terraforming experiment to hunt Pathers, but Intel smelled rot. Do you know what that means? - Don't answer. We have heard reports - disturbing reports - about the accounts of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security branch."

The officer is on his back heel, sweating. Nearby tables are carefully pretending not to listen to your tirade.

"'Riddled with Pather credits' is what I've heard. And as you well know per the League's Interstellar Terrorism Statute - which you so helpfully quoted for me - that means that central oversight is empowered to intervene in local affairs."
texts.zh:
"我本来也不想到这个地貌改造失败的穷乡僻壤，在到处滋生的卢德佬里面追猎左径分子，但情报中透露出一股不妙的气息。你知道那意味着什么吗？—— 不用回答。我收到一些令人不安的报告，与 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的账目有关。"

这个军官立正站直，汗水涔涔而下。附近几桌人小心翼翼地装作没听到你的长篇大论。

"关于左径分子资金来源的流言，已经充斥了我的耳朵。而正如你所熟知的那样，根据联盟的星际恐怖主义法 —— 就是你之前帮我引用的那个 —— 这意味着中央监督机构将有权干预地方事务。"

texts.en:
"Do you know what that means? Do not respond, officer, I am not finished."

You continue the dress-down, describing the various powers that the central League executive can hammer down upon members found to be involved in abetting terrorism - Mairaath's millions dead were fresh in the minds of the composers of the League's constitution, and the powers enumerated to stop a repeat of the event are far-reaching indeed.

It is, you reflect, a good thing you paid attention to League history.
texts.zh:
"你知道这意味着什么吗？别急着回答，长官，我还没说完。"

你继续斥责着，描述了联盟中央行政部门可以对被发现参与教唆恐怖主义的成员施加的各种处罚 —— Mairaath 的数百万死者在联盟的规则制定者们心中记忆犹新，而为阻止事件重演而被赋予的权力确实意义深远。

你庆幸到，还好你之前研究过联盟的历史。

texts.en:
Before long, you have the munisec officer silent and near-tears across from you in a booth while you browse local security reports on their datapad using their own login.

You find exactly what you need - Nile Virens, local Pather strongman. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers.

After transferring the information to your own TriPad you toss the officer's datapad across the table. He is too slow to catch it, and it clatters to the ground.
texts.zh:
没过多久，你们坐进了一个小隔间。你对面的地方安全部的官员正在努力憋住眼泪，而你，拿着这位官员的平板，用着这位官员的账号，浏览着本地安全报告。

你准确无误地找到了你要的东西 —— Nile Virens，本地左径分子中的铁腕人物。在所有重要的卢德人口中心，都有他经营的院落。

把信息传输到自己的 TriPad 之后，你隔着桌子把这个官员的数据平板丢了过去。他慢了一拍，没能接住，平板摔到地上咔哒作响。

texts.en: The agent's eyes light up at this, and their mouth opens to speak more - but you've already turned away.
texts.zh: 特工眼睛一亮，正准备开口说些什么 —— 但你已经转身离开了。

texts.en:
Your comms officer pings you unexpectedly.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. I received an unusual communication which- I thought it should be brought to your attention."
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官突然向你发出通知。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我收到了一份特别的通讯，我认为您应当关注它。"

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam. Someone who claims to work for a man named 'Virens' commed to invite you to a meeting. I did not... at first think to bring it to your attention until the details could be verified."

"Well, ah," they twitch nervously. "We verified the details."
texts.zh:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam。有个自称是 'Virens' 手底下的人发来了通讯，邀请您参加一个会议。我没有...立即向您汇报此事，我本想等到我们能够确认那些细节之后再讲。"

"呃，对，" 对方紧张地说。"我们核实了相关细节。"

texts.en:
And indeed, as your comms officer explains, it turns out that one Nile Virens figures prominently in Mazalot as the leader (alleged) of the local branch of the Luddic Path, though none of the mainstream media or data outlets state this apparently unspoken-by-agreement fact. Virens legally runs a number of charities; Pather fronts (allegedly), and owns properties in most of the significant Luddic-majority settlements on Mazalot.

It's not difficult to read between the lines. Just dangerous.

Unless you are someone who employs top-credit bodyguards and operates a private battlefleet.
texts.zh:
确实，正如你的通讯军官所说，Nile Virens 在 Mazalot 上扮演的一个重要角色其实是 卢德左径 当地分支的领导者 (据传)，尽管没有任何主流媒体或小道消息点明过这一不言而喻的事实。Virens 合法经营着数个慈善机构，其实都是掩护左径组织的前台 (据传)，且在 Mazalot 大多数重要的卢德聚集地中持有地产。

这很危险。听懂这个弦外之意应该不难。

除非能有个雇佣了顶级保镖，并坐拥一支私人作战舰队的家伙。

texts.en:
It's almost shocking that Virens hasn't been arrested already, but his status is a political minefield for the Mazalot Unification Authority. To crack down might instigate another uprising. To not crack down allows Pather influence to simmer just under the boiling point.

And now, Nile Virens has invited you for tea.

Your officers, of course, have rapidly assembled a tactical report on Virens' holdings for your review.
texts.zh:
Virens 至今未被捕，这令人感到难以置信。毕竟他的地位对 Mazalot 统一政权而言，犹如一颗政治地雷。对他采取强硬措施可能激起新的暴动，而不采取行动则会使左径分子的影响力在沸点之下持续酝酿。

而现在，Nile Virens 正邀请你共享下午茶。

自然，你的幕僚们已迅速编制了一份关于 Virens 势力范围的战术报告供你审查。

options.en: Take a shuttle down to meet with Nile Virens
options.zh: 乘坐穿梭机下去与 Nile Virens 会面

texts.en:
From the shuttle you admire the atmospheric display resulting from Mazalot's strong magnetic field; spectra flare and break like ocean waves.

Your shuttle is unaffected aside from extra cleanup processing required by the comms and nav systems.

You land on the outskirts of some Luddic-majority town in what passes for a spaceport: a field of baked gray dust. A long row of sheds might be traffic control, warehouses, or a barn for all you know.
texts.zh:
在穿梭机内，你欣赏着 Mazalot 强大磁场所造就的壮观大气景象；光谱波动犹如海浪般绚烂分裂。

你的穿梭机除了通讯和导航系统需要额外清理外，未受任何影响。

你降落在一个以卢德信众为人口主题的小镇外围，这里的太空港仅仅是一片灰色的尘土地带。一排排棚屋或许是交通管制中心、仓库，或者在你看来，它们甚至可能是个谷仓。

texts.en:
A pair of militants wearing dust masks meet you. They're armed, but not conspicuously so.

They lead you through a town of sun-baked brick and slowly corroding salvage. Bright paint and lush gardens manage, just, to stave off a sense of apocalyptic decay.

Soon, you find yourself before a large compound with doors of etched metal. The militants are met by another pair, similarly armed. The most senior among them lowers his mask.
texts.zh:
两名戴着防尘面具的武装人员迎接了你。他们配备着武器，但不太引人注目。

他们引导你穿越一个由日晒砖瓦和逐渐锈蚀的废料建成的小镇。明亮的彩绘和繁盛的花园勉强抵御着末世般的衰败感。

很快，你来到了一个拥有精致金属门的大型院落前。这两名武装人员被另外两名同样配备武器的人接应。其中位列最高的一人缓缓地摘下了他的面具。

texts.en: "$PlayerName. Blessed peace this day. Please, $playerSirOrMadam, follow me."
texts.zh: "$PlayerName。愿和平赐福今日。这边请，$playerSirOrMadam，跟我来吧。"

texts.en:
"$PlayerName. Blessed peace," he says, and hesitates.

"Please. Your weapon." He indicates your sidearm.
texts.zh:
"$PlayerName。愿和平赐福，" 他说着，稍作停顿。

"另外，您的武器。" 他示意你拿出你的随身武器。

options.en: Don't worry, I'm not here to shoot anyone.
options.zh: 放心，我没准备射爆谁的脑袋。

options.en: I will not surrender my sidearm.
options.zh: 我不会交出我的随身武器的。

options.en: You'll have to take it from my cold, dead hands.
options.zh: 那得等我死透之后，你才能从我手上拿走它。

texts.en:
The lead guard does a quick one-two knock on the doors and they swing open.

The air is cool, the walls hung with cloth woven in bright patterns; wooden furniture prevails. A clean, earthy scent hangs in the air. You are overcome by a sense of ancient wealth - entirely underwhelming compared to the palaces of Eventide or a Tri-Tachyon executive's chateau, but here, you can tell that every object, every surface, has been transformed by the hand and muscle of human beings alone.

You are led up stairs - wooden, creaking unsettlingly - to a room overlooking an interior courtyard garden. The silhouette of a man stirs at your presence.
texts.zh:
领头的守卫快速敲了两下门，门开了。

空气凉爽，墙壁上挂着织有鲜艳图案的布；满眼都是木制家具。空气中弥漫着清新的泥土香味。一种古老的财富感震慑了你 —— 虽然与 Eventide 的宫殿或速子科技高管的庄园相比起来平淡无奇，但你可以看出，这里的每个物体和每个平面，都仅由人类用的双手和肌肉所造就。

你被引上楼梯 —— 木制，噶吱作响 —— 来到一间能俯瞰内部庭院的房间。一个男人的轮廓因你的出现动了起来。

texts.en:
"Blessed peace upon you," the man says, turning toward you. "I am Nile Virens. I invite you to sit with me."

A finely-carved table is set with a tea set, simple in form and painted with delicate natural motifs.
texts.zh:
"愿和平赐福于你。" 男人转向你说道，"我是 Nile Virens。请与我同坐。"

精雕细琢的桌子上摆放着茶具，造型简洁，绘有精致的自然风景。

texts.en:
You are gaining a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is a fine blend.
texts.zh:
沸水倾入后，空气中弥漫的香气在不经意间就向你透露出了茶的品质。

这可是上好的拼配茶。

texts.en:
With all this dealing with Luddics, you realize that you're starting to develop a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is the good stuff.
texts.zh:
与卢德信徒打交道之后，你意识到，自己似乎开始能通过开水刚冲下时空气中弥漫的香气来判断茶叶的品质了。

这可是好东西。

texts.en:
You sit, and Virens pours two cups, then motions for you to choose your pick of the two.

After you do, he holds the cup up for a moment and inhales the steam.
texts.zh:
你坐了下来，Virens 倒了两杯茶，示意你从中拿一杯。

你拿了，他举起另一杯茶，缓缓吸入蒸汽。

options.en: Why did you invite me here?
I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
options.zh: 我在找一个名叫 Jethro Bornanew 的男人。

options.en: Why did you take my sidearm?
options.zh: 你为什么收走了我的随身武器？

options.en: You're a lot more polite than Sedge.
options.zh: 你比 Sedge 要有礼貌多了。

options.en: How does a man like you ally yourself with a man like Sedge?
options.zh: 你这样的人怎么会和 Sedge 那样的人走到一起去？

options.en: Sit and take a cup of tea

texts.en:
"If I didn't bring you in now, it seems you'd ask everyone in the system about Jethro Bornanew, about the Luddic Path, and ultimately, about me."

"You are blessedly persistent," he smiles indulgently. "Dangerously persistent, if left to your devices, I suspect. Others would ask why you're asking. The MUA would ask why you're asking. Too much of this asking, asking, asking. It upsets delicate things."

As he speaks, he reaches out and almost, but not quite, touches the fine teapot. He seems to realize what he is doing and pulls back.
texts.zh:
"如果现在我没带你进来，你好像就会问星系中的每个人关于 Jethro Bornanew 的事，还有卢德左径，最后，再问到我。"

"神赐予你毅力。" 他宽容地笑道，"我猜如果让你自行行动的话，这毅力会变得危险起来。其他人会问你为什么要问，MUA 也会问你为什么要问。太多的问题、问题、问题。这会增添许多琐事。"

他一边说话一边伸出手。在马上触碰到那只精致茶壶的时候，他似乎意识到自己的行为，随即把手收了回来。

texts.en:
"Yes," Virens pauses, studying you. "I know."

"I have met this man, Bornanew, and I know where he is." He leaves the statement hanging.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Virens 顿了顿，上下扫了你几眼，"我认识他。"

"我见过这个人，Bornanew，我还知道他在哪里。" 他的话到这里就戛然而止了。

options.en: Will you tell me where he is?
options.zh: 你能不能告诉我他的具体位置？

options.en: Let it hang; he knows what you want
options.zh: 那就停在这儿；他知道你想问什么的

texts.en:
"I may," says Virens.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew." He flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for any particular loyalty. For the general principle. My meeting with Bornanew was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
texts.zh:
"我是可以告诉你。" Virens 说道，

"但我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是出于忠诚，而是职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

texts.en:
"He did, however, tell me why he was sent here. And by who." Virens looks for your reaction.

"I would not wish to direct you to him if your intentions were... unkind."
texts.zh:
"然而他确实和我说过来这里的缘由。包括谁让他来的。" Virens 看了你一眼。

"如果你是抱着...恶意的话，我不打算透露他的行踪。"

options.en: Archcurate Jaspis wants him back. To serve her. To serve the Church.
options.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 想让他回去为她服务。为教会服务。

options.en: Whatever his mission was, it's over. The archcurate is... worried about him.
options.zh: 无论他的任务是什么，都不该继续了。大祭司很...担心他。

options.en: Well, I don't get paid if I don't return with him. Or his body.
options.zh: 我带不回他就拿不到钱。他的尸首也能凑合。

texts.en:
"I see," Virens says, looking out into the courtyard. Thinking, for a long minute. He turns back and deliberately sips some tea.

"I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Virens 这么说着，目光落在了庭院里。他思考了很长一段时间，然后转回了头，十分僵硬地抿了一口茶。

"我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

options.en: That wasn't so hard, was it.
options.zh: 是吧，告诉我也没那么难。

options.en: Why help the Church? Are you not of a... wayward sect?
options.zh: 为什么你要帮助教会？你所属的教派通常不是更...另辟蹊径吗？

options.en: How does this serve the Path, for me to find Bornanew for the Church?
options.zh: 我帮教会找到 Bornanew 对左径有什么好处？
这就完了？没什么关于 '卢德之道' 的高谈阔论？

options.en: Why would you, a Pather, help me with this?
options.zh: 为什么你，作为一个左径分子，会在这件事上帮我？

options.en: You have my thanks; may a path of peace lay before you.
options.zh: 非常感谢；愿你的道途通向和平。

options.en: Just like that? Is this some kind of trap?
options.zh: 这就结束了？这是个陷阱吗？

options.en: One more thing- I need to find Brother Cotton.
options.zh: 还有一件事 —— 我还在找 Cotton 修士。

options.en: Thank you. And for the tea.

texts.en:
"No. Often, the cowards way is not. I pray that I am no fool in this." Virens stands, his body tense, his manner clear in seeing you gone as soon as possible.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"确实，懦夫之道一般都不难走。希望我这次没做傻事。" Virens 僵硬地起身，几乎把逐客令刻在了脸上。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Your side arm is returned, and you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
texts.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们交还了你的随身武器，然后把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

texts.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Then you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
texts.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

texts.en:
"Wayward?" He gives a soft laugh. "You can be diplomatic when you wish it."

"The Church is not all one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that, I am not sure." His mouth moves toward an amused smile, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
"另辟蹊径？" 他轻笑一声，"你圆滑起来倒还挺像样的。"

"教会内部并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些坚持所谓正统的势力压制所有其他信徒，乃至整个星域吗？"

"我可不确定。" 他扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"I speak true, $playerBrotherOrSister, when I say that I do not know what Path has been set for us by Providence."

"But I do know that the Church is not all of one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that I am especially unsure." His mouth moves toward a smile of amusement, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
"我说实话，$playerBrotherOrSister，我不知道上天为我们铺设了怎样的道途。"

"但我知道教会并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些正统派克服所有信徒和其他星域的阻碍吗？"

"我可一点也不确定。" 他的嘴角扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"愿你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"I felt you would not wish to hear of 'the Path'. But if you wish, I will tell you briefly of the Path."

He looks down, frowning. "The Path is not all alike. In some places, the Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He looks up, changed; there is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "We were lost. And then the Word found us. Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow of the powerful. Not even the Church can contain it."

"THAT is the Path." He nearly shouts, standing. Then takes a deep breath, and a moment to smooth his fine clothing.
texts.zh:
"我不觉得你真的想了解 '卢德之道'。但是如果你想的话，我可以简单地向你介绍介绍。"

他皱起眉头，垂下脑袋。"每个人的卢德之道都并非一致，卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他抬起头，表情快速变化，那是一种你从未见过的，既狂热又哀伤的眼神。"我们曾经迷失。然后，'卢德之道' 找到了我们。在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

"那，就是卢德之道。" 他几乎是站着喊出来的，随即深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

texts.en:
"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that." He turns back to you - and pauses halfway to catch your eye - before facing the courtyard.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"左径并非铁板一块，太空佬，教会也不是。谨记。" 他转向你 —— 和你对视了一下 —— 然后重新回头看向了庭院。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en:
"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that." He turns back to look into the courtyard.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"左径并非铁板一块，太空佬，教会也不是。谨记。" 他重新回头看向了庭院。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en:
His lip curls in an ironic smile while his eyes narrow just slightly; some repressed anger, even rage.

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly. There is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He takes a deep breath, and smooths his fine clothing.
texts.zh:
他嘴唇卷起来，露出讽刺的微笑；微眯起的眼睛中透露着压抑着的愤懑与怒火。

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

texts.en:
He stands to see you off.

"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
texts.zh:
他站起来把你送走了。

"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

texts.en:
He shakes his head at the implied accusation. "It is not."

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly, rattling the ceramic. There is a sad fervor in his eyes you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, and in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He stands, and takes a deep breath. Then smooths his fine clothing. "Go in peace," he says.
texts.zh:
他对于你隐含的中伤摇了摇头。"绝非如此。"

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，手捏的茶杯咯咯作响。他的眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他站起来，深深地吸了一口气，理了理身上精致的衣服。"和平地回去吧。" 他说道。

texts.en:
Virens' expression cools noticeably.

"Do you," he says; not a question. "With that, I cannot help you."
texts.zh:
Virens 的面色明显阴沉下来。

"是吗。" 他说道；这不是个疑问句，"我没法帮你。"

options.en: Do you have a problem with Cotton?

options.zh: 你的意思是，'不会' 帮我。

options.en: Well, thank you anyway. And for the tea.
options.zh: 好吧，无论如何还是谢谢你了。还有你的茶。

texts.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"I will not speak of Cotton. Not here, not now."
texts.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"我不想谈起 Cotton。至少不是此时此刻。"

texts.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"If you would drink a bitter tea, then I 'will not'," he emphasizes your words, "stop you."
texts.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"如果你想尝点苦茶，那我也 '不会'。" 他故意强调了你先前的用词，"阻止你。"

texts.en: He stands to see you off, "The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
texts.zh: 他起身目送了你。"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

texts.en:
Virens pulls back, frowning.

"Am I to understand that as a threat, or merely a jest made in very poor taste?"
texts.zh:
Virens 皱着眉头躺上了椅背。

"你是在威胁我？还是说我可以认为这只是个糟糕透顶的玩笑？"

options.en: My apologies. It's just spacer humor.
options.zh: 抱歉，只是太空佬的黑色幽默而已。

options.en: It's a job. I'm simply being realistic.
options.zh: 就是个赏金任务。我比较实事求是而已。

options.en: I don't negotiate with terrorists. My fleet is in orbit.
options.zh: 我懒得和恐怖分子讨价还价。我的舰队就在轨道上。

options.en: I have a battalion of marines in orbit. Make this easy on yourself.
options.zh: 我有一整个营的陆战队大军在轨道上。劝你别自找麻烦。

texts.en: He gives you a look that contains not a hint of amusement.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，显然他一点也不觉得这有趣。

texts.en: He gives you a look. He seems more distant from you, somehow.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼。不知怎地，你能感觉出你们之间更有距离感了。

texts.en:
Virens leans back, rubbing his chin.

"Captain," he begins, "Whatever you make of my home, this settlement... Mazalot is a polity of the Persean League. Their fleets will hound you to the ends of the Persean Sector."

"I say this to make sure, very very sure, you know what you are threatening to do. So you will see why it is not necessary."
texts.zh:
Virens 向后靠了靠，揉着他的下巴。

"舰长啊。" 他出声道，"不管你觉得我的家园是个什么样的地方，这个聚落... Mazalot 依旧是 英仙座联盟 的政体之一。他们的舰队会追杀你到 英仙座星域 的每个角落。"

"我说这些只是想彻底，彻彻底底地确认，你真的知道你威胁要做的是什么事情。因为这样你便会明白这根本是没有必要的事情。"

texts.en: "Because I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
texts.zh: "因为我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

texts.en:
With a small, amused nod Virens acknowledges that you've left the gap in conversation for him, not you, to fill.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew, you see." Virens flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for him in particular, but for courtesy, shall we say. My meeting with him was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
texts.zh:
对于你把刚才话题的停顿交给他来衔接这个举动，Virens 显然被逗乐了，他朝你轻轻点了点头表示认可。

"我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任，你明白吧。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是对他特殊照顾，不如说是，职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

texts.en:
He gives you a funny look.

"Sedge. On Chalcedon." He raises his eyebrows, "In the back? Surely you will not begrudge my caution."
texts.zh:
他给你的表情像是听到了什么搞笑的事情一样。

"Sedge。在 Chalcedon 上。" 他扬起眉毛，"从身后下的手？想必你不会怪罪我行事谨慎吧。"

texts.en: Virens looks thoughtfully at his tea like something is wrong with it, something ineffable.
texts.zh: Virens 若有所思的看着他的茶，似乎有什么难以言喻的问题。

texts.en:
Virens meets your eyes, "Though you are my guest here, and perhaps because you are my guest, I feel that I must demand an answer from you."

"So I ask you this, $playerName. Why did you kill him?"
texts.zh:
Virens 注视着你的双眼，"即使你是我的客人，也许也正因为这样，我必须要求你给我一个说法。"

"所以我问你，$playerName，你为什么杀了他？"

options.en: He would have killed me without hesitation, given the chance.
options.zh: 如果有机会，他一定会毫不犹豫地杀了我。

options.en: I didn't like him. That's why.
He drank my tea. It was my. Tea.
options.zh: 他喝了我的茶。那可是 '我 的' 茶。

options.en: His anti-technological terrorism is a threat to the future of the Persean Sector.
options.zh: 他的反科技恐怖主义对英仙座星域的未来是个威胁。

options.en: He was a brute who ruled through terror.
options.zh: 他就是个实行恐怖统治的野蛮人。

options.en: Because he's a Pather. It's what all Pathers deserve.
options.zh: 因为他是个左径分子，这就是所有左径分子的下场。

options.en: His manner and actions pollute the purity of the Path.
options.zh: 他的态度与行为玷污了卢德之道的纯粹。

options.en: Consider a lie to answer with...

texts.en:
"I concede that he has, to my knowledge, killed many," Virens says. "And with little hesitation. By the other hand, he did speak with you; he seemed to me not a man to waste his time with talk when intent upon killing."

"To that point," he picks up his teacup. "The deed is done. Sedge is not mine to avenge, so put any worry of that from your mind."

"You see, I am a man who does hesitate. Thoughtless action," he shakes his head. "But there are times for killing. And, after hesitation - and thought - I see that it be done."

Virens smiles unreassuringly.
texts.zh:
"我承认，在我的印象里他确实杀了很多人。" Virens 说道，"且从不犹豫。但话又说回来，他和你有过一些面谈；而在我看来如果真的想杀你，他可不是那种会浪费时间动嘴皮子的人。"

"总之。" 他端起了他的茶杯，"事已至此，给 Sedge 报仇也不是我该干的事，你就别为此担心了。"

"要知道，我就是容易犹豫。这事真是欠考虑。" 他摇了摇头，"但当杀戮的时机到来之际，在犹豫和思考之后，我将势在必得。"

Virens 的微笑让你毛骨悚然。

"To that point," he picks up his teacup. "The deed is done. Sedge is not mine to avenge, so put any worry of that from your mind."

"You see, I am a man who does hesitate. Thoughtless action," he shakes his head. "But there are times for killing. And, after hesitation - and thought - I see that it be done."

Virens smiles unreassuringly.

"我承认，在我的印象里他确实杀了很多人。" Virens 说道，"且从不犹豫。但话又说回来，他和你有过一些面谈；而在我看来如果真的想杀你，他可不是那种会浪费时间动嘴皮子的人。"

"要知道，我就是容易犹豫。这事真是欠考虑。" 他摇了摇头，"但当杀戮的时机到来之际，在犹豫和思考之后，我将势在必得。"

Virens 的微笑让你毛骨悚然。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?
So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en: "The thought had crossed my mind," he admits. "But I think it would bring much trouble. And... I want to see what happens."
texts.zh: "我还真这么想过。" 他承认道，"但我觉得那样只会更麻烦。况且...我想看看接下来事情会怎么发展。"

options.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
options.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

texts.en: "I as well," he says.
texts.zh: "我也这么觉得。" 他回应道。

texts.en:
"It is easy to dislike a great many people in a great many circumstances," Virens says. "Sedge, perhaps, easier to dislike than most, I must admit."

"Still. Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
texts.zh:
"许多时候人们轻易地因为各种原因互相敌视。" Virens 说道，"我得说，或许 Sedge 是更容易被人厌恶的那类。"

"但，你也不应该轻描淡写地判他死刑。"

然而无须质疑的是，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

texts.en:
"It is easy to dislike a great many people in a great many circumstances," Virens says. "Sedge, perhaps, easier to dislike than most, I must admit."

"Still. Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

With these words, you would be certain he has made such administrations, did not his position imply already such was the case.
texts.zh:
"许多时候人们轻易地因为各种原因互相敌视。" Virens 说道，"我得说，或许 Sedge 是更容易被人厌恶的那类。"

"但，你也不应该轻描淡写地判他死刑。"

然而无须质疑的是，能坐在如今的位置上，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?
So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en: "You killed a man over a cup of tea?" Virens' composure cracks for a moment in sheer disbelief.
texts.zh: "你杀了个人就因为一杯茶？" 因为太过难以置信，Virens 那镇定自若的神色从他脸上消失了那么一小会儿。

texts.en:
"I understand that Sedge could be rude, yes, and even offensive. But," he shakes his head. "Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
texts.zh:
"我知道 Sedge 是个没礼貌的家伙，甚至可以说相当粗鲁。不过，" 他摇了摇头，"你也不应该随便让人去死。"

然而毋庸置疑，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en:
He stares straight at you. "You did not steal my tea."

"So," he trails off, giving a one-shoulder shrug, tea steady in his other hand. "No."

Just the hint of an unexpected smile lingers.
texts.zh:
他直勾勾地盯着你道："你又没偷我的茶。"

"所以。" 他顿了顿，用没端茶杯的那只手耸了耸肩，"不会。"

他的嘴角只挂着一丝出人意料的微笑。

options.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
options.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

texts.en:
"I see," Virens says coldly. "It would be consistent to level the same charge against myself, yes?"

He looks at you with expectant challenge.
texts.zh:
"原来如此。" Virens 的语气冷了下来，"照你的说法，我也会受到相同的指控，是吗？"

他挑衅地看着你。

texts.en:
"I see," Virens says coldly. "It would be consistent to level the same charge against myself, yes?"

He looks at you with expectant challenge.
texts.zh:
"原来如此。" Virens 的语气冷了下来，"照你的说法，我也会受到相同的指控，是吗？"

他挑衅地看着你。

texts.en: "Then I shall await your judgment in good spirit," he says. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的裁决了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

texts.en: "Then I shall await your wrath in good spirit," he says calmly. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的怒火了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

texts.en:
"Do I?" He looks away, brow wrinkling. "Then I feel perhaps I am failing at something."

He turns back to you, "Nonetheless, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh:
"我真的会吗？" 他皱着眉看向了别处，"看来我在某些方面做得还不够好。"

他重新面对你道："然而，我真正敬畏和期盼的只有神的裁决。"

texts.en:
"You are not wrong in that," Virens says.

"And he died as he lived: through a seemingly random act of wanton violence."

You detect more than a hint of criticism in these words.
texts.zh:
"这你倒说得没错。" Virens 说道。

"他死于一场看似随机的肆意暴力之中，颇有种以其人之道还治其人之身的感觉。"

你察觉到了他话语里有明显的指责意味。

你察觉到了他话语里有明显的指责意味。

options.en: He was a murderer. The world is better off without him.
options.zh: 他是个杀人犯。这个世界没了他才好。

options.en: How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?
options.zh: 左径分子烧杀抢掠，凭什么轮到你来指责我？

options.en: That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?
options.zh: 这句话从左径分子的嘴里吐出来可真是讽刺。还记得 Mairaath 吗？

options.en: He was a murderer. The world is better off without him.
options.zh: 他是个杀人犯。这个世界没了他才好。

options.en: How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?
options.zh: 左径分子烧杀抢掠，凭什么轮到你来指责我？

options.en: That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?
options.zh: 这句话从左径分子嘴里吐出真是滑稽。还记得 Mairaath 吗？

texts.en:
"Yes. But think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "You've made what was once an inconvenience an immortal, captain."
texts.zh:
"你说得没错。但想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新坐直了身体。"你把曾经的小麻烦变成了永垂不朽的传说，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "It may be that you've made a whole new generation of raiders and killers, captain."
texts.zh:
"想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新站直了身体。"也许你只手打造了一代全新的掠夺者和杀手，舰长。"

texts.en:
He sighs. "Mairaath, yes. We're told many things of Mairaath. But think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "It may be that you've made a whole new generation of raiders and killers, captain."
texts.zh:
他叹道："Mairaath，对。我们听闻了不少 Mairaath 上发生的故事。但想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新站直了身体。"也许你只手打造了一代全新的掠夺者和杀手，舰长。"

options.en: You can't simply dismiss Mairaath, and what the Path did there.
options.zh: 你不应该这么简单就把 Mairaath 和左径在那做过的事一笔带过。

texts.en:
"No," he says, "I cannot."

"But I will not rehash this old argument now. Remember, it is you who came to me, in my home, to ask me for a favor."
texts.zh:
他说道："我确实不应该。"

"但我现在不想翻这些旧账。别忘了，现在是你主动来我的地盘找我，让我帮个忙的。"

texts.en: "Ah." Virens leans back, examining you coolly. "Am I next?"
texts.zh: "啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。"那我就是下一个？"

texts.en: "Ah." Virens leans back, examining you coolly. "Am I next?"
texts.zh: "啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。"那我就是下一个？"

texts.en:
"Ah," Virens leans back, examining you coolly.

"It will take a great deal of blood indeed to wash all that is impure from the Path, and indeed from the Sector entirely."
texts.zh:
"啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。

"想把 卢德左径 中，乃至整个星域中所有的不洁全部洗净，可是要花不少血水啊。"

texts.en:
"Ah," Virens leans back, examining you coolly.

"It will take a great deal of blood indeed to wash all that is impure from the Path, and indeed from the Sector entirely."
texts.zh:
"啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。

"然而想把 卢德左径 乃至整个星域中所有的污秽全部洗净，毫无疑问是要不少血水啊。"

options.en: Not so much once a few are made example of.
options.zh: 杀鸡儆猴，就不会死那么多人了。

options.en: Not so much once a few are made example of.
options.zh: 杀鸡儆猴，就不会死那么多人了。

texts.en:
"Your faith burns bright. Perhaps too bright for me, a simple man, to face unblinking." Virens adjusts his posture, uncomfortable perhaps.

"Let us speak of other things."
texts.zh:
"你的信仰如此坚定耀眼，耀眼到让我这个凡夫俗子无法直视。" Virens 调整了一下他的坐姿，或许是因为不适。

"我们谈点别的吧。"

texts.en:
"Your faith burns bright. Perhaps too bright for me, a simple man, to face unblinking." Virens adjusts his posture, uncomfortable perhaps.

"Let us speak of other things."

"我们谈点别的吧。"

texts.en: You need Virens to cooperate. Perhaps a lie will help...
texts.zh: 你需要 Virens 的合作，也许谎言会起效...

options.en: He would have killed me without hesitation, given the chance. (lie)
options.zh: 如果有机会，他一定会毫不犹豫地杀了我。 (说谎)

options.en: I didn't like him. That's why. (lie)
options.zh: 我不喜欢他，就这样。 (说谎)

options.en: His anti-technological terrorism is a threat to the future of the Persean Sector. (lie)
options.zh: 他的反科技恐怖主义对英仙座星域的未来是个威胁。 (说谎)

options.en: He was a brute who ruled through terror. (lie)
options.zh: 他就是个实行恐怖统治的野蛮人。 (说谎)

options.en: Because he's a Pather. It's what all Pathers deserve. (lie)
options.zh: 因为他是个左径分子，这就是所有左径分子的下场。 (说谎)

options.en: His manner and actions pollute the purity of the Path. (lie)
options.zh: 他的态度与行为玷污了卢德之道的纯粹。 (说谎)

texts.en: Virens is a perceptive and cultured man. The truth will serve.
texts.zh: Virens 是个敏锐而有修养的人，实话实说才是上策。

texts.en:
Virens' mouth draws a thin line. "He is... was... not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."

Virens looks thoughtfully at his tea like something is wrong with it, something ineffable.
texts.zh:
Virens 的嘴勾勒出一道曲线。"他不...曾...不是一个有礼貌，或是令人愉快的人。但他很执着，非常的执着。"

Virens 若有所思的看着他的茶，似乎有什么难以言喻的问题。

texts.en: "Sedge shot the man who set up the meeting in front of you."
texts.zh: "Sedge 在你面前射杀了那个安排会面的人。"

texts.en: "I am told that Sedge became... agitated. He was quick to anger, and quick to demonstrate that anger."
texts.zh: "我被告知 Sedge 变得...非常焦躁不安。他变得非常易怒，并急切地想要发泄这股怒火。"

texts.en: "I knew Sedge to be crude, and to be cruel."
texts.zh: "我知道 Sedge 为人粗鲁，同时也很残忍。"

texts.en: He nods, and says "He is not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."
texts.zh: 他点头并说道："他不是一个有礼貌，或是令人愉快的人。但他很执着，非常的执着。"

texts.en:
"You use this word 'ally'. It is, I think, too strong a word for what was between he and I."

Virens switches his teacup to his other hand, "Nor shall I deny the association, not once or thrice. The Path can be a twisted thing, captain, and ever am I surprised by the company with whom I walk."

"I apologize for nothing but for providing you with an unsatisfactory answer." He pours more tea, "My wife always said I was a middling host."
texts.zh:
"我和他的关系用 '盟友' 来形容的话，未免有点太过了。"

Virens 换了一只手端茶杯。"但我也没有否认我们之间的联系，从来没有。圣道可能会充满曲折，舰长，就连我会也不时感叹，伴我同行的到底都是些什么人。"

"很抱歉，我没法给你一个满意的答复。" 他再倒了点茶，"我确实不擅长于待客之道，我的妻子也经常这么说。"

texts.en: Virens acknowledges your act with a nod, and raises his cup to you before sipping some tea.
texts.zh: Virens 点头认可了你的举动，向你举杯致意后喝了些茶。

texts.en:
A frown begins in his brow but fails to materialize on his mouth.

"I respect that you shall do as you wish, $playerSirOrMadam," he says, and pours a cup for himself. "My invitation stands, and you have my hospitality regardless."
texts.zh:
他眉头微皱，但这丝不悦最终没有表现在嘴角。

"我尊重你行自己所愿之事的权利，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他说道，一边为自己倒了杯茶，"我的邀请仍然有效，无论如何，你都将受到我的款待。"

texts.en:
The lead guard accepts it with both hands, giving a little bow, then tucks it into a holster on the front of his webbing.

A place of honor? Or at least a visible demonstration that he's going to keep a close eye on your gun.
texts.zh:
领头的守卫用双手将其接过，并礼貌地微微鞠躬，然后把它收进他胸前的挂网枪套中。

这是将其置于荣耀之地吗？或至少是一个明显的信号，表明他将会密切关注你的枪。

texts.en:
The guards glance nervously at one another. Someone mutters something at the edge of your hearing.

The leader gives a hiss and they shut up.

"Please, if you would," he says. "You are a guest of Brother Virens. He guarantees your safety on this world."
texts.zh:
守卫们紧张地相互交换着眼神。你隐约听到有人在窃窃私语。

领头的人发出一声低吼，守卫们立即安静下来。

"请，如果您同意，" 他说。"您是 Virens 修士的贵宾。在这颗星球上，他保证您的安全。"

texts.en:
The guards glance nervously at one another, muttering. The leader gives a hiss and they shut up.

"Please, if you would," he says. "You are a guest of Brother Virens. You will not be touched on this world."
texts.zh:
守卫们紧张地相互交换着眼神，一边窃窃私语着。领头的人发出一声低吼，守卫们立即安静下来。

"请，如果您同意，" 他说。"您是 Virens 修士的贵宾。在这颗星球上，他保证您的安全。"

texts.en:
The leader almost looks sad for a moment, then something shifts in his eyes and his expression is left dull but alert.

"Then you will not meet with Brother Virens," he says. "We shall return to your shuttle."

The other guards are tense.
texts.zh:
头领有一瞬间几乎是露出了悲伤的神情，然后他眼中有什么东西变了，他的表情也变得木然，但仍保持警觉。

"那么你就不会见到 Virens 修士了，" 他说。"我们会送你回穿梭机。"

其他守卫都紧张起来。

texts.en: Virens' militants escort you back through town. You see clearly now how the population avoids your route, and how you haven't, in fact, seen any MUA personnel. Anywhere.
texts.zh: Virens 的守卫护送着你穿过城镇。你可以清楚地看到人们是如何对你避之不及，并且你没有，确实没有，看到任何 MUA 人员。哪里都没有。

texts.en:
You return to your $shipOrFleet without having met Virens.

It seems that he will only meet you if you are totally defanged. Perhaps he does not believe that your marines could 'invite' him to meet you.
texts.zh:
你没有去见 Virens，而是回到你的$shipOrFleet。

看起来只有在你彻底 '无害' 的情况下他才会见你。也许他也不相信你的陆战队员能够 '邀请' 他见面。

texts.en:
From the shuttle you admire the atmospheric display resulting from Mazalot's strong magnetic field; spectra flare and break like ocean waves.

Your shuttle is unaffected aside from extra cleanup processing required by the comms and nav systems.

You land on the outskirts of some Luddic-majority town in what passes for a spaceport: a field of baked gray dust. A long row of sheds might be traffic control, warehouses, or a barn for all you know.
texts.zh:
在穿梭机内，你欣赏着 Mazalot 强大磁场所造就的壮观大气景象；光谱波动犹如海浪般绚烂分裂。

你的穿梭机除了通讯和导航系统需要额外清理外，未受任何影响。

你降落在一个以卢德信众为人口主题的小镇外围，这里的太空港仅仅是一片灰色的尘土地带。一排排棚屋或许是交通管制中心、仓库，或者在你看来，它们甚至可能是个谷仓。

texts.en:
A pair of militants wearing dust masks meet you. They're armed, but not conspicuously so.

They lead you through a town of sun-baked brick and slowly corroding salvage. Bright paint and lush gardens manage, just, to stave off a sense of apocalyptic decay.

Soon, you find yourself before a large compound with doors of etched metal. The militants are met by another pair, similarly armed. The most senior among them lowers his mask.
texts.zh:
两名戴着防尘面具的武装人员迎接了你。他们配备着武器，但不太引人注目。

他们引导你穿越一个由日晒砖瓦和逐渐锈蚀的废料建成的小镇。明亮的彩绘和繁盛的花园勉强抵御着末世般的衰败感。

很快，你来到了一个拥有精致金属门的大型院落前。这两名武装人员被另外两名同样配备武器的人接应。其中位列最高的一人缓缓地摘下了他的面具。

The lead guard accepts it with both hands, giving a little bow, then tucks it into a holster on the front of his webbing.

texts.en:
The lead guard does a quick one-two knock on the doors and they swing open.

The air is cool, the walls hung with cloth woven in bright patterns; wooden furniture prevails. A clean, earthy scent hangs in the air. You are overcome by a sense of ancient wealth - entirely underwhelming compared to the palaces of Eventide or a Tri-Tachyon executive's chateau, but here, you can tell that every object, every surface, has been transformed by the hand and muscle of human beings alone.

You are led up stairs - wooden, creaking unsettlingly - to a room overlooking an interior courtyard garden. The silhouette of a man stirs at your presence.
texts.zh:
领头的守卫快速敲了两下门，门开了。

空气凉爽，墙壁上挂着织有鲜艳图案的布；满眼都是木制家具。空气中弥漫着清新的泥土香味。一种古老的财富感震慑了你 —— 虽然与 Eventide 的宫殿或速子科技高管的庄园相比起来平淡无奇，但你可以看出，这里的每个物体和每个平面，都仅由人类用的双手和肌肉所造就。

你被引上楼梯 —— 木制，噶吱作响 —— 来到一间能俯瞰内部庭院的房间。一个男人的轮廓因你的出现动了起来。

texts.en:
"Blessed peace upon you," the man says, turning toward you. "I am Nile Virens. I invite you to sit with me."

A finely-carved table is set with a tea set, simple in form and painted with delicate natural motifs.
texts.zh:
"愿和平赐福于你。" 男人转向你说道，"我是 Nile Virens。请与我同坐。"

精雕细琢的桌子上摆放着茶具，造型简洁，绘有精致的自然风景。

texts.en:
You are gaining a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is a fine blend.
texts.zh:
沸水倾入后，空气中弥漫的香气在不经意间就向你透露出了茶的品质。

这可是上好的拼配茶。

texts.en:
With all this dealing with Luddics, you realize that you're starting to develop a sense for the quality of tea by the scent hanging in the air after boiling water is freshly poured.

This is the good stuff.
texts.zh:
与卢德信徒打交道之后，你意识到，自己似乎开始能通过开水刚冲下时空气中弥漫的香气来判断茶叶的品质了。

这可是好东西。

texts.en:
You sit, and Virens pours two cups, then motions for you to choose your pick of the two.

After you do, he holds the cup up for a moment and inhales the steam.
texts.zh:
你坐了下来，Virens 倒了两杯茶，示意你从中拿一杯。

你拿了，他举起另一杯茶，缓缓吸入蒸汽。

texts.en:
A frown begins in his brow but fails to materialize on his mouth.

"I respect that you shall do as you wish, $playerSirOrMadam," he says, and pours a cup for himself. "My invitation stands, and you have my hospitality regardless."
texts.zh:
他眉头微皱，但这丝不悦最终没有表现在嘴角。

"我尊重你行自己所愿之事的权利，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他说道，一边为自己倒了杯茶，"我的邀请仍然有效，无论如何，你都将受到我的款待。"

texts.en: Virens acknowledges your act with a nod, and raises his cup to you before sipping some tea.
texts.zh: Virens 点头认可了你的举动，向你举杯致意后喝了些茶。

texts.en:
"If I didn't bring you in now, it seems you'd ask everyone in the system about Jethro Bornanew, about the Luddic Path, and ultimately, about me."

"You are blessedly persistent," he smiles indulgently. "Dangerously persistent, if left to your devices, I suspect. Others would ask why you're asking. The MUA would ask why you're asking. Too much of this asking, asking, asking. It upsets delicate things."

As he speaks, he reaches out and almost, but not quite, touches the fine teapot. He seems to realize what he is doing and pulls back.
texts.zh:
"如果现在我没带你进来，你好像就会问星系中的每个人关于 Jethro Bornanew 的事，还有卢德左径，最后，再问到我。"

"神赐予你毅力。" 他宽容地笑道，"我猜如果让你自行行动的话，这毅力会变得危险起来。其他人会问你为什么要问，MUA 也会问你为什么要问。太多的问题、问题、问题。这会增添许多琐事。"

他一边说话一边伸出手。在马上触碰到那只精致茶壶的时候，他似乎意识到自己的行为，随即把手收了回来。

texts.en:
He gives you a funny look.

"Sedge. On Chalcedon." He raises his eyebrows, "In the back? Surely you will not begrudge my caution."
texts.zh:
他给你的表情像是听到了什么搞笑的事情一样。

"Sedge。在 Chalcedon 上。" 他扬起眉毛，"从身后下的手？想必你不会怪罪我行事谨慎吧。"

texts.en:
Virens' mouth draws a thin line. "He is... was... not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."

Virens looks thoughtfully at his tea like something is wrong with it, something ineffable.
texts.zh:
Virens 的嘴勾勒出一道曲线。"他不...曾...不是一个有礼貌，或是令人愉快的人。但他很执着，非常的执着。"

Virens 若有所思的看着他的茶，似乎有什么难以言喻的问题。

texts.en: "Sedge shot the man who set up the meeting in front of you."
texts.zh: "Sedge 在你面前射杀了那个安排会面的人。"

texts.en: "I am told that Sedge became... agitated. He was quick to anger, and quick to demonstrate that anger."
texts.zh: "我被告知 Sedge 变得...非常焦躁不安。他变得非常易怒，并急切地想要发泄这股怒火。"

texts.en: "I knew Sedge to be crude, and to be cruel."
texts.zh: "我知道 Sedge 为人粗鲁，同时也很残忍。"

texts.en: He nods, and says "He is not a polite man, nor pleasant. Driven, however. Quite driven."

texts.en:
Virens meets your eyes, "Though you are my guest here, and perhaps because you are my guest, I feel that I must demand an answer from you."

"So I ask you this, $playerName. Why did you kill him?"
texts.zh:
Virens 注视着你的双眼，"即使你是我的客人，也许也正因为这样，我必须要求你给我一个说法。"

"所以我问你，$playerName，你为什么杀了他？"

texts.en: Virens is a perceptive and cultured man. The truth will serve.
texts.zh: Virens 是个敏锐而有修养的人，实话实说才是上策。

texts.en: You need Virens to cooperate. Perhaps a lie will help...
texts.zh: 你需要 Virens 的合作，也许谎言会起效...

texts.en:
"I concede that he has, to my knowledge, killed many," Virens says. "And with little hesitation. By the other hand, he did speak with you; he seemed to me not a man to waste his time with talk when intent upon killing."

"To that point," he picks up his teacup. "The deed is done. Sedge is not mine to avenge, so put any worry of that from your mind."

"You see, I am a man who does hesitate. Thoughtless action," he shakes his head. "But there are times for killing. And, after hesitation - and thought - I see that it be done."

Virens smiles unreassuringly.
texts.zh:
"我承认，在我的印象里他确实杀了很多人。" Virens 说道，"且从不犹豫。但话又说回来，他和你有过一些面谈；而在我看来如果真的想杀你，他可不是那种会浪费时间动嘴皮子的人。"

"总之。" 他端起了他的茶杯，"事已至此，给 Sedge 报仇也不是我该干的事，你就别为此担心了。"

"要知道，我就是容易犹豫。这事真是欠考虑。" 他摇了摇头，"但当杀戮的时机到来之际，在犹豫和思考之后，我将势在必得。"

Virens 的微笑让你毛骨悚然。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en:
He stares straight at you. "You did not steal my tea."

"So," he trails off, giving a one-shoulder shrug, tea steady in his other hand. "No."

Just the hint of an unexpected smile lingers.
texts.zh:
他直勾勾地盯着你道："你又没偷我的茶。"

"所以。" 他顿了顿，用没端茶杯的那只手耸了耸肩，"不会。"

他的嘴角只挂着一丝出人意料的微笑。

options.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
options.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

texts.en: "The thought had crossed my mind," he admits. "But I think it would bring much trouble. And... I want to see what happens."
texts.zh: "我还真这么想过。" 他承认道，"但我觉得那样只会更麻烦。况且...我想看看接下来事情会怎么发展。"

options.en: I'm glad we cleared that up.
options.zh: 很高兴我们把这事说清楚了。

texts.en: "I as well," he says.
texts.zh: "我也这么觉得。" 他回应道。

texts.en: "You killed a man over a cup of tea?" Virens' composure cracks for a moment in sheer disbelief.
texts.zh: "你杀了个人就因为一杯茶？" 因为太过难以置信，Virens 那镇定自若的神色从他脸上消失了那么一小会儿。

texts.en:
"I understand that Sedge could be rude, yes, and even offensive. But," he shakes his head. "Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
texts.zh:
"我知道 Sedge 是个没礼貌的家伙，甚至可以说相当粗鲁。不过，" 他摇了摇头，"你也不应该随便让人去死。"

然而毋庸置疑，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en:
"It is easy to dislike a great many people in a great many circumstances," Virens says. "Sedge, perhaps, easier to dislike than most, I must admit."

"Still. Death is not a thing to administer lightly."

You are certain he has made such administrations himself.
texts.zh:
"许多时候人们轻易地因为各种原因互相敌视。" Virens 说道，"我得说，或许 Sedge 是更容易被人厌恶的那类。"

"但，你也不应该轻描淡写地判他死刑。"

然而无须质疑的是，他自己就是个做过这种事的人。

options.en: So are you thinking about killing me?

texts.en:
"I see," Virens says coldly. "It would be consistent to level the same charge against myself, yes?"

He looks at you with expectant challenge.
texts.zh:
"原来如此。" Virens 的语气冷了下来，"照你的说法，我也会受到相同的指控，是吗？"

他挑衅地看着你。

texts.en: "Then I shall await your judgment in good spirit," he says. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的裁决了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

texts.en: "Then I shall await your wrath in good spirit," he says calmly. "Though you must understand, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh: "那我可真得定心等待你的怒火了。" 他说道，"但你得明白，只有来自神的裁决，才是我真正敬畏并期待的。"

texts.en:
"Do I?" He looks away, brow wrinkling. "Then I feel perhaps I am failing at something."

He turns back to you, "Nonetheless, it is only God whose judgment for which I truly fear and hope."
texts.zh:
"我真的会吗？" 他皱着眉看向了别处，"看来我在某些方面做得还不够好。"

他重新面对你道："然而，我真正敬畏和期盼的只有神的裁决。"

texts.en:
"You are not wrong in that," Virens says.

"And he died as he lived: through a seemingly random act of wanton violence."

You detect more than a hint of criticism in these words.
texts.zh:
"这你倒说得没错。" Virens 说道。

"他死于一场看似随机的肆意暴力之中，颇有种以其人之道还治其人之身的感觉。"

你察觉到了他话语里有明显的指责意味。

options.en: He was a murderer. The world is better off without him.
options.zh: 他是个杀人犯。这个世界没了他才好。

options.en: How can you criticize me while Pathers raid and kill?
options.zh: 左径分子烧杀抢掠，凭什么轮到你来指责我？

options.en: That's rich coming from a Pather. Remember Mairaath?
options.zh: 这句话从左径分子的嘴里吐出来可真是讽刺。还记得 Mairaath 吗？

texts.en:
"Yes. But think of what you've created, back on Chalcedon."

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "You've made what was once an inconvenience an immortal, captain."
texts.zh:
"你说得没错。但想想你在 Chalcedon 上铸就了什么。"

Virens 凑到你耳边，"一个大英雄，光荣的烈士。" 他低语道，"被一个两面三刀的懦夫背叛。Sedge 现在与卢德并肩前进，而 Chalcedon 的子民也会追随他的步伐。"

他重新坐直了身体。"你把曾经的小麻烦变成了永垂不朽的传说，舰长。"

texts.en:

Virens leans forward, "A hero, blessed martyr," he whispers. "Shot in the back by a spacer coward. Sedge now walks beside Ludd, and the children of Chalcedon will walk in his footsteps."

He leans back again. "It may be that you've made a whole new generation of raiders and killers, captain."

texts.en: "So they shall," Virens agrees.
texts.zh: "确实如此。" Virens 赞同道。

options.zh: 你不应该这么简单就把 Mairaath 和左径在那做过的事一笔带过。

texts.en:
"No," he says, "I cannot."

"But I will not rehash this old argument now. Remember, it is you who came to me, in my home, to ask me for a favor."
texts.zh:
他说道："我确实不应该。"

"但我现在不想翻这些旧账。别忘了，现在是你主动来我的地盘找我，让我帮个忙的。"

texts.en: "Ah." Virens leans back, examining you coolly. "Am I next?"
texts.zh: "啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。"那我就是下一个？"

texts.en:
"Ah," Virens leans back, examining you coolly.

"It will take a great deal of blood indeed to wash all that is impure from the Path, and indeed from the Sector entirely."
texts.zh:
"啊。" Virens 向后靠了靠，一边冷冷地打量着你。

"想把 卢德左径 中，乃至整个星域中所有的不洁全部洗净，可是要花不少血水啊。"

options.en: Not so much once a few are made example of.
options.zh: 杀鸡儆猴，就不会死那么多人了。

texts.en:
"Your faith burns bright. Perhaps too bright for me, a simple man, to face unblinking." Virens adjusts his posture, uncomfortable perhaps.

"Let us speak of other things."
texts.zh:
"你的信仰如此坚定耀眼，耀眼到让我这个凡夫俗子无法直视。" Virens 调整了一下他的坐姿，或许是因为不适。

"我们谈点别的吧。"
