texts.en:
"You use this word 'ally'. It is, I think, too strong a word for what was between he and I."

Virens switches his teacup to his other hand, "Nor shall I deny the association, not once or thrice. The Path can be a twisted thing, captain, and ever am I surprised by the company with whom I walk."

"I apologize for nothing but for providing you with an unsatisfactory answer." He pours more tea, "My wife always said I was a middling host."
texts.zh:
"我和他的关系用 '盟友' 来形容的话，未免有点太过了。"

Virens 换了一只手端茶杯。"但我也没有否认我们之间的联系，从来没有。圣道可能会充满曲折，舰长，就连我会也不时感叹，伴我同行的到底都是些什么人。"

"很抱歉，我没法给你一个满意的答复。" 他再倒了点茶，"我确实不擅长于待客之道，我的妻子也经常这么说。"

texts.en:
"Yes," Virens pauses, studying you. "I know."

"I have met this man, Bornanew, and I know where he is." He leaves the statement hanging.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Virens 顿了顿，上下扫了你几眼，"我认识他。"

"我见过这个人，Bornanew，我还知道他在哪里。" 他的话到这里就戛然而止了。

options.en: Will you tell me where he is?
options.zh: 你能不能告诉我他的具体位置？

options.en: Let it hang; he knows what you want
options.zh: 那就停在这儿；他知道你想问什么的

texts.en:
With a small, amused nod Virens acknowledges that you've left the gap in conversation for him, not you, to fill.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew, you see." Virens flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for him in particular, but for courtesy, shall we say. My meeting with him was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
texts.zh:
对于你把刚才话题的停顿交给他来衔接这个举动，Virens 显然被逗乐了，他朝你轻轻点了点头表示认可。

"我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任，你明白吧。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是对他特殊照顾，不如说是，职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

texts.en:
"I may," says Virens.

"I feel that I have some responsibility to Bornanew." He flicks a nonexistent speck from his teacup. "Not for any particular loyalty. For the general principle. My meeting with Bornanew was brief, and we have had no business or acquaintance since."
texts.zh:
"我是可以告诉你。" Virens 说道，

"但我觉得我对 Bornanew 负有一定的责任。" Virens 弹掉了他杯子上不存在的茶渣，"当然不是出于忠诚，而是职业操守。我和他只有一面之缘，之后就再也没有事业或感情上的交集了。"

texts.en:
"He did, however, tell me why he was sent here. And by who." Virens looks for your reaction.

"I would not wish to direct you to him if your intentions were... unkind."
texts.zh:
"然而他确实和我说过来这里的缘由。包括谁让他来的。" Virens 看了你一眼。

"如果你是抱着...恶意的话，我不打算透露他的行踪。"

options.en: Archcurate Jaspis wants him back. To serve her. To serve the Church.
options.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 想让他回去为她服务。为教会服务。

options.en: Whatever his mission was, it's over. The archcurate is... worried about him.
options.zh: 无论他的任务是什么，都不该继续了。大祭司很...担心他。

options.en: Well, I don't get paid if I don't return with him. Or his body.
options.zh: 我带不回他就拿不到钱。他的尸首也能凑合。

texts.en:
Virens pulls back, frowning.

"Am I to understand that as a threat, or merely a jest made in very poor taste?"
texts.zh:
Virens 皱着眉头躺上了椅背。

"你是在威胁我？还是说我可以认为这只是个糟糕透顶的玩笑？"

texts.en: He gives you a look that contains not a hint of amusement.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼，显然他一点也不觉得这有趣。

texts.en: He gives you a look. He seems more distant from you, somehow.
texts.zh: 他看了你一眼。不知怎地，你能感觉出你们之间更有距离感了。

texts.en:
Virens leans back, rubbing his chin.

"Captain," he begins, "Whatever you make of my home, this settlement... Mazalot is a polity of the Persean League. Their fleets will hound you to the ends of the Persean Sector."

"I say this to make sure, very very sure, you know what you are threatening to do. So you will see why it is not necessary."
texts.zh:
Virens 向后靠了靠，揉着他的下巴。

"舰长啊。" 他出声道，"不管你觉得我的家园是个什么样的地方，这个聚落... Mazalot 依旧是 英仙座联盟 的政体之一。他们的舰队会追杀你到 英仙座星域 的每个角落。"

"我说这些只是想彻底，彻彻底底地确认，你真的知道你威胁要做的是什么事情。因为这样你便会明白这根本是没有必要的事情。"

texts.en: "Because I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
texts.zh: "因为我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

texts.en:
"I see," Virens says, looking out into the courtyard. Thinking, for a long minute. He turns back and deliberately sips some tea.

"I think you should speak with Bornanew yourself," he says. "I shall have my man give you the coordinates."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" Virens 这么说着，目光落在了庭院里。他思考了很长一段时间，然后转回了头，十分僵硬地抿了一口茶。

"我觉得你确实该和 Bornanew 亲自谈谈。" 他说道，"我这就让我的人给你坐标。"

texts.en:
"Wayward?" He gives a soft laugh. "You can be diplomatic when you wish it."

"The Church is not all one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that, I am not sure." His mouth moves toward an amused smile, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
"另辟蹊径？" 他轻笑一声，"你圆滑起来倒还挺像样的。"

"教会内部并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些坚持所谓正统的势力压制所有其他信徒，乃至整个星域吗？"

"我可不确定。" 他扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"祝你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"I speak true, $playerBrotherOrSister, when I say that I do not know what Path has been set for us by Providence."

"But I do know that the Church is not all of one thing. And do you think this man, this Jethro Bornanew, will help that part of the Church which seeks a dominion of orthodoxy to overcome all the Faithful, and the Sector besides?"

"Of that I am especially unsure." His mouth moves toward a smile of amusement, but doesn't quite get there. "Burn bright, captain."
texts.zh:
"我说实话，$playerBrotherOrSister，我不知道上天为我们铺设了怎样的道途。"

"但我知道教会并不是铁板一块。而你觉得这个家伙，这个 Jethro Bornanew，能帮教会里那些正统派克服所有信徒和其他星域的阻碍吗？"

"我可一点也不确定。" 他的嘴角扯出了一个被逗乐了的笑容，但最终没咧得那么开。"愿你航行无阻，舰长。"

texts.en:
"I felt you would not wish to hear of 'the Path'. But if you wish, I will tell you briefly of the Path."

He looks down, frowning. "The Path is not all alike. In some places, the Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He looks up, changed; there is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "We were lost. And then the Word found us. Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow of the powerful. Not even the Church can contain it."

"THAT is the Path." He nearly shouts, standing. Then takes a deep breath, and a moment to smooth his fine clothing.
texts.zh:
"我不觉得你真的想了解 '卢德之道'。但是如果你想的话，我可以简单地向你介绍介绍。"

他皱起眉头，垂下脑袋。"每个人的卢德之道都并非一致，卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他抬起头，表情快速变化，那是一种你从未见过的，既狂热又哀伤的眼神。"我们曾经迷失。然后，'卢德之道' 找到了我们。在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

"那，就是卢德之道。" 他几乎是站着喊出来的，随即深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

texts.en:
His lip curls in an ironic smile while his eyes narrow just slightly; some repressed anger, even rage.

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly. There is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He takes a deep breath, and smooths his fine clothing.
texts.zh:
他嘴唇卷起来，露出讽刺的微笑；微眯起的眼睛中透露着压抑着的愤懑与怒火。

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

texts.en:
He stands to see you off.

"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
texts.zh:
他站起来把你送走了。

"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

texts.en:
He shakes his head at the implied accusation. "It is not."

"You know little of the Path, spacer. The Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He sets his teacup down firmly, rattling the ceramic. There is a sad fervor in his eyes you did not see before. "Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, and in the shadow beneath the boot of power. Not even the Church can contain it."

He stands, and takes a deep breath. Then smooths his fine clothing. "Go in peace," he says.
texts.zh:
他对于你隐含的中伤摇了摇头。"绝非如此。"

"你对卢德之道知之甚少，太空佬。卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他坚定地放下茶杯，手捏的茶杯咯咯作响。他的眼中展现出一种你从未见过的狂热与哀伤。"在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

他站起来，深深地吸了一口气，理了理身上精致的衣服。"和平地回去吧。" 他说道。

texts.en:
Virens' expression cools noticeably.

"Do you," he says; not a question. "With that, I cannot help you."
texts.zh:
Virens 的面色明显阴沉下来。

"是吗。" 他说道；这不是个疑问句，"我没法帮你。"

options.en: Do you have a problem with Cotton?

options.zh: 你的意思是，'不会' 帮我。

options.en: Well, thank you anyway. And for the tea.
options.zh: 好吧，无论如何还是谢谢你了。还有你的茶。

texts.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"I will not speak of Cotton. Not here, not now."
texts.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"我不想谈起 Cotton。至少不是此时此刻。"

texts.en:
He stands, and smooths his fine clothing, letting out a deep breath.

"If you would drink a bitter tea, then I 'will not'," he emphasizes your words, "stop you."
texts.zh:
他站了起来，理了理身上精致的衣服，深深吸了口气。

"如果你想尝点苦茶，那我也 '不会'。" 他故意强调了你先前的用词，"阻止你。"

texts.en:
"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that." He turns back to you - and pauses halfway to catch your eye - before facing the courtyard.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"左径并非铁板一块，太空佬，教会也不是。谨记。" 他转向你 —— 和你对视了一下 —— 然后重新回头看向了庭院。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en:
"The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that." He turns back to look into the courtyard.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"左径并非铁板一块，太空佬，教会也不是。谨记。" 他重新回头看向了庭院。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en: He stands to see you off, "The Path is not all one thing, spacer, nor is the Church. Remember that."
texts.zh: 他起身目送了你。"左径并非铁板一块，宇宙民，教会也不是。谨记。"

texts.en:
"No. Often, the cowards way is not. I pray that I am no fool in this." Virens stands, his body tense, his manner clear in seeing you gone as soon as possible.

"My man Fearnot will see you out."
texts.zh:
"确实，懦夫之道一般都不难走。希望我这次没做傻事。" Virens 僵硬地起身，几乎把逐客令刻在了脸上。

"我的部下 Fearnot 会送你出去的。"

texts.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Your side arm is returned, and you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
texts.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们交还了你的随身武器，然后把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

texts.en:
Virens' lead guard brings you back to the entry hall, where a secretary meets you and uses a scratched datapad to provide you with coordinates to a location on the surface of Mazalot.

Then you are accompanied back to your shuttle; the population keeps a wary distance. They know who you met, and know better than to interfere.
texts.zh:
Virens 的警卫队长带着你回到了大厅。一位秘书凑了上来，用一块全是划痕的数据平板为你提供了 Mazalot 地表上的一个坐标。

他们把你送回了你的穿梭机；人群都不安地保持着距离。他们知道你去见了谁，也知道最好不要被卷进来。

options.en: Prepare a raid on Virens' compounds to extract Jethro Bornanew
options.zh: 准备劫掠 Virens 的藏身处以营救 Jethro Bornanew

texts.en:
You convene your senior officers to discuss an extraction scenario for Jethro Bornanew, presumably employed or taken hostage by Nile Virens.

It is impossible to completely avoid the MUA's defense network, although even cursory scans show that it is deployed to counter internal uprisings rather than external raids. Persean League casualties can be minimized, but certain sensor stations and defensive batteries will have to be disabled to open the way for a clean assault on Virens' bases.

The Pathers are another problem entirely: separate infiltration squads must simultaneously breach secure compounds located in densely populated settlements. Casual use of heavy weaponry among civilians would attract unwanted interference both in the immediate operation and your future activities. You must strike everywhere swiftly, unerringly, and with a light touch.
texts.zh:
你召集上级军官商议营救 Jethro Bornanew 的方案，目标此时应该是被 Nile Virens 雇佣或囚禁了。

想要完全避开 MUA 的防御系统是毫无可能的，尽管他们是为了应对内部暴动而非外部劫掠而建成。突袭过程中对英仙座联盟造成的损失可以降至最小，但是为了能直击 Virens 的据点，一些侦察站和防御炮台依旧需要处理掉。

左径分子则完全是另一个问题：潜入小队们必须同时进攻人口密集的聚落中戒备森严的几座建筑。在人群中随意使用重型武器不但会立刻引来阻碍，还会对你未来的活动造成影响。你必须迅捷，精准，还要谨慎地打击每一个地区。

texts.en: He uses the cuffs to shove one teacup toward you, and takes the other in his hands and lifts it, a splash escaping onto the table.
texts.zh: 他用手铐把一只茶杯推向你，然后用手捧起另一只茶杯，溅起的茶水落到了桌子上。

texts.en: Virens picks up his teacup. His grip is unsteady, and he splashes some tea onto his hand and the table.
texts.zh: Virens 拿起茶杯。他的手握不稳，茶水溅到了手上和桌子上。

texts.en: He blows on the tea and takes a sip.
texts.zh: 他吹了吹茶，然后抿了一口。

texts.en: He blows on the tea and takes a sip.
texts.zh: 他吹了吹茶，然后抿了一口。

options.en: Take a shuttle to Bornanew's coordinates
options.zh: 乘坐一架穿梭机前往 Bornanew 的坐标。

texts.en: You order a shuttle prepared for descent to the coordinates provided to you by Nile Virens.
texts.zh: 你下令让一架穿梭机准备前往 Nile Virens 给你的坐标。

options.en: Take the shuttle to the surface
Order a scan of Bornanew's coordinates
options.zh: 下令对 Bornanew 的坐标进行一次扫描。

options.zh: 带一队陆战队作为后援

options.zh: 重新考虑除了出发以外的其他选择

texts.en:
The spectra of charged particles interacting with Mazalot's atmosphere flare and break like ocean waves.

Your shuttle's descent is smooth, your pilot interfacing with the lackadaisical local traffic control and receiving only token objection to landing near a Luddic-majority settlement.

"Near" is a relative term, of course; you're well over the horizon from all but a half-dozen of the prefab hab units that have been dragged out here and modified by their inhabitants. Half of those appear to be abandoned, the surrounding fields rippled with dust.
texts.zh:
各种各样的带电粒子与 Mazalot 大气层的光焰相互交汇，犹如海浪般涌动。

你的穿梭机降落得很顺利。在和当地无精打采的交通管制取得联系后，驾驶员降落在卢德信众定居点附近的请求只受到了一些象征性的反对。

当然，"附近" 也只是个相对概念；毕竟在视线所及之处，除了那六个拖到这儿被居民改造过的预制居住单元之外就什么都没有了。有一半看起来已经无人居住，周围的田地里只有些烟尘在涌动。

texts.en: Your shuttle lands, kicking up a cloud that wafts outward in a diminishing wave over a desolation of erratic boulders and ashy-looking trees.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机掀起一阵下洗气流，缓缓降落在布满不规则巨石与灰蒙蒙的树的荒凉地带。

texts.en:
Before you is a modified prefab hab. A corroded, leaking irrigation system shudders unsteadily as it tends to an unhealthy-looking garden grid. The adjacent crop field is quite dead.

On the flight in, the shuttle sensors tagged a living human figure in the sheltered grove nearby.
texts.zh:
你面前是个改造过的预制居住舱。有个锈得到处漏水的灌溉系统正在打理一块看起来萎靡不振的菜园方格，由于不太稳固而有些颤颤巍巍的。旁边农田倒是都死透了。

在飞过来的途中，穿梭机的传感器曾标记了一个活人的信号，就在一旁茂密的小树林里。

texts.en:
You follow a path toward the grove. Protected from the parching winds by a low rise, it seems that the trees planted here collect almost enough moisture to survive.

A new run of ceramolith pipe follows the trail to the grove. Like someone wanted to water the trees.
texts.zh:
你沿着一条小径走向树林。这里的低地势抵御了干燥的风，树木似乎有足够的水分来生存。

一条崭新的陶瓷管线沿着小路直到树林里，就像有人在为树浇水一样。

texts.en:
You follow a path toward the grove. Sheltered from the dry winds by a low rise, it seems that the trees planted here collect almost enough moisture to survive. But not quite.

Your marines whisper tactical call-and-response in your ear. "$PlayerSirOrMadam," the squad leader addresses you personally, "Target ID confirmed; visual match with Bornanew. Appears unarmed."
texts.zh:
你沿着一条小径走向树林。这里的低地势抵御了干燥的风，树木似乎有一些水分来生存，但是并不够。

陆战队员的战术口令在你耳边轻轻地响起。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 本次行动指派的队长亲自向你报告，"目标身份已确认，视觉匹配特征与 Bornanew 相符。似乎并未携带武器。"

texts.en:
The shade of the grove is speckled by light filtering through thin leaves.

You find a large man in a long, dusty hooded coat, almost a robe. His back is to you.

There are a handful of Luddic grave-markers here; brightly painted with natural pigments. These look well maintained.

The man's head is bowed, his hands clasped in prayer.
texts.zh:
树丛间的阴影洒满了从细叶穿过的点点阳光。

你找到了一个高大的男人，他穿着一条满是灰尘的长连帽外套，看起来就像是件袍子一样。他正背对着你。

周围有几个卢德教徒的墓碑；都画上了亮丽的天然颜料。它们看起来被打理得很好。

男人低垂着脑袋，双手合十正在祈祷。

options.en: I'm taking you back to Gilead.
options.zh: 我是来带你回 Gilead 的。

options.en: What happened with infiltrating the Path? You had a mission.
options.zh: 你潜入左径的时候出了什么事？你可是有任务在身。

options.en: "Why does Jaspis want you back so badly?
options.zh: Jaspis 为什么这么着急叫你回去？

options.en: If you like, I can have found you dead here.
options.zh: 如果你乐意，我也可以是只找到了你的尸体。

options.en: Wait- what was that about the 'song of angels'?
options.zh: 等等 —— 什么是 '天使之歌'？

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Yes. I am Jethro Bornanew."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"是，我就是 Jethro Bornanew。"

texts.en: He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline. "You came a long way. Captain, I assume?"
texts.zh: 他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，舰长？"

texts.en:
He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline.

"You came a long way. And you brought warriors." He turns back to the graves, "I've counted two, so far."
texts.zh:
他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。

"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，而且你还带了士兵。" 他回过头重新看向坟墓，"至此为止，我数到了两个人。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "No," he says. He glances back at the graves. "This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"这个所剩无几的农场，是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

texts.en:
"No," he says, looking at the graves. "I never met them. Not when they were alive, I mean."

"This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
texts.zh:
"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"我从没见过他们，至少没在他们在世时见过。"

"这个所剩无几的农场，就是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. The Reverend Archcurate. Of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，那位受人尊敬的宗师大人。当然了。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"行吧。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. Jaspis, of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，Jaspis。当然了。"

texts.en:
You and Bornanew walk from the graves, from the dry grove.

"There's nothing here I need," Bornanew says as you pause before the dying farmstead. "I am prepared to leave."

The shuttle returns you to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你和 Bornanew 离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。

"我也没什么要拿的。" Bornanew 见你在垂死的农庄前停了一下，如此说道，"我准备好出发了。"

穿梭机把你带回了你的$shipOrFleet。

texts.en:
You walk with Bornanew from the graves, from the grove. The marine squad falls in like spirits of the desert summoned to material form.

"There's nothing here I need," Bornanew says as you pause before the dying farmstead. "I am prepared to leave."

The shuttle returns to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你和 Bornanew 离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。陆战小队也集合了，就像受到召唤显出真身的沙漠之灵一般。

"我也没什么要拿的。" Bornanew 见你在垂死的农庄前停了一下，如此说道，"我准备好出发了。"

穿梭机把你带回了你的$shipOrFleet。

texts.en: He gives you a strange look. "If you really want to, I suppose."
texts.zh: 他莫名其妙地看了你一眼。"如果你真的想这么叫的话，也行。"

options.en: Jeff it is. It's less... you know.
options.zh: 那就 Jeff。这样不怎么...啊，你懂的。

options.en: I'm not being serious. Your name is Jethro.
options.zh: 我开玩笑的，你就叫 Jethro。

texts.en: "Less Luddic, you mean," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
texts.zh: "你是想说更不卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

texts.en: "Less Luddic," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
texts.zh: "这样不怎么卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

texts.en:
"Ah," he smiles awkwardly.

"I apologize. This is all... not a shock, exactly. A rather large turn on the path that I have found to be my life, I suppose. It is a lot to reflect upon, now that it is happening."
texts.zh:
"啊，" 他尴尬地笑了笑。

"抱歉。这一切...确切地说，不怎么震惊。我想，这是我人生道路上的相当大的转折。有很多值得反思的地方。"

texts.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..." Bornanew shakes his head.
texts.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..." Bornanew 摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..."

Bornanew shakes his head.
texts.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..."

Bornanew 摇了摇头。

options.en: Sedge? Don't worry, I killed him.
options.zh: Sedge？别担心，他已经被我杀了。

texts.en:
"Yes," he looks surprised, "That was his name. I did not like the man. I did not like the things I would have to do to make him like me."

Bornanew looks away, "He seemed to be someone I might have been if I had lived a different life. Walked a different path."
texts.zh:
"对。" 他看起来有些惊讶，"他就是叫这个。我不喜欢那个人。也不喜欢为了让他喜欢我而不得不做的事。"

Bornanew 移开了目光。"他就像是另一个我，一个拥有不同人生，走上不同道路的我。"

options.zh: 别担心，Sedge 已经被我杀了。

options.en: The deed is done. Or not done, in your case. Let it go.
options.zh: 已经过去了。可能也不算吧，考虑到你的话。走吧。

options.en: But you're not him. That's why Jaspis wants you back.
options.zh: 但你不是他，所以 Jaspis 才想叫你回去。

options.en: You'll have to learn to be a lot less squeamish if you're to be a Knight.
options.zh: 若想成为骑士，你可不能这么软弱。

texts.en:
"You- what?" He looks you in the eyes, to confirm that you are telling the truth. He quickly discovers that you are.

"I have no words," he says, shaking his head.
texts.zh:
"你 —— 什么？" 他看向你的双眼，确认着你是不是在说真话。他很快发现，你确实是认真的。

"我不知道说什么好。" 他摇了摇头道。

options.en: Aren't you a Knight Initiate? How can you be so squeamish?
options.zh: 你不是个新晋骑士吗？怎么会这么软弱？

texts.en:
"I might not be when I get back," he admits.

"But you're right. It is probable that a Knight will be called upon to kill to defend the Faith. It is what I agreed to, what I swore I would learn."
texts.zh:
"等我回去时大概就不算了。" 他承认道。

"但你说得没错。骑士很可能被召唤去为了捍卫信仰而进行杀戮，这是我同意的事，也是我发誓要学会的事。"

options.en: Look, this one was on me. Don't worry about it.
options.zh: 听着，这件事算在我头上。别担心了。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en: He nods hesitantly, and says "Then I will speak no further on this matter."
texts.zh: 他犹豫地点点头，说道："那我就不说这个了。"

texts.en: He gives you a skeptical look, "That worries me all the more."
texts.zh: 他怀疑地看了你一眼，道："这让我更担心了。"

texts.en: "Your words are a cold comfort, captain."
texts.zh: "你的安慰于事无补，舰长。"

texts.en:
"I feel that I must," he says. "In one sense, his death is due to my choices, though I had no way of knowing it."

"It is true also that he was, by all accounts - and indeed in my judgment - an evil man. His faith twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
texts.zh:
"我觉得我做不到。" 他说，"从某方面来看，他的死也是因为我的选择造成的，就算我不可能提前得知会那样。"

"不过他也确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看这都是事实 —— 我个人也是这么觉得的。他的信仰扭曲而自私。他也因此不会后悔自己的...'行为'。"

options.en: You're worrying about it. I told you not to.
options.zh: 我和你说了纠结这事了，你还这样。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en:
"I cannot do that," he says.

"I do concede that he was, by all accounts and indeed my judgment, an evil man. His faith, it was twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
texts.zh:
"我做不到。" 他说道。

"我也承认他确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看都是这样 —— 我主观上也是这么觉得的。他扭曲自私的信仰导致他从不后悔自己的...'行为'。"

texts.en: "I cannot do that," he says.
texts.zh: "我做不到。" 他说道。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en:
"The Reverend Archcurate," he says automatically.

"Sorry," he adds quickly. "Habit. They really drill it into you in the Church. Archcurate Jaspis... told me I could call her Sophronia, as if I was family."

"She wants to change the path of the Faith, I believe. She believes I can help her do it."
texts.zh:
"宗师大人。" 他条件反射地说道。

"抱歉。" 他很快补充道，"习惯了，教会里真的会把这个烙进你的脑子。大祭司 Jaspis 说...我可以叫她 Sophronia，就像一家人一样。"

"我认为她想改变信仰之道。而她认为我可以帮她实现。"

options.en: People died for me to find you.
options.zh: 为了找到你，我让人丢了性命。

options.en: I shot a man to find you.
options.zh: 为了找到你，我射杀了一个人。

options.en: No one else seems to think much of you.
options.zh: 似乎其他人都没把你当回事。

texts.en:
"So was Ludd," he says, and laughs.

"Ah," he catches himself, and wipes his eyes. "Forgive me my blasphemy. I do not believe I am Ludd; I do not hear God's word in the songs of angels."
texts.zh:
"卢德也是。" 他说着大笑了起来。

"啊。" 他止住了自己的失态，擦了擦眼睛，"原谅我的不敬。我不觉得我会是卢德；我没在天使之歌中听到神言。"

texts.en: He sighs deeply. "Was it necessary?"
texts.zh: 他深深地叹了口气。"那是必要的吗？"

options.en: That's not important now. I have a mission to complete.
options.zh: 现在无所谓了。我还有任务要完成。

options.en: Yes. In conflicts between the powerful, that's how it works.
options.zh: 是的。权势之争向来如此。

texts.en: "Gilead," he says, staring at the graves.
texts.zh: "Gilead。" 他盯着坟墓说道。

texts.en: He looks at you uneasily, but says nothing.
texts.zh: 他有些不安地看着你，但并没有开口。

texts.en: "I see," he looks at you uneasily.
texts.zh: "我知道了。" 他不安地看着你。

texts.en:
He shrugs. "The Reverend Archcurate does. And that was enough to bring you here, for me."

He glances over at you, "I don't care to speculate about how many credits she's wasting on me."
texts.zh:
他耸了耸肩。"但宗师大人确实这么觉得，你都因此被派来找我了。"

他瞥了你一眼。"我都不愿去想她在我身上浪费了多少星币。"

texts.en:
"Yes," he says and glances at you. Expecting some news of Jaspis' health, maybe. He turns away again.

"Time comes for us all. I expect she sees that. She wants to leave behind a world... that's better, I think."
texts.zh:
"是啊。" 他说着瞥了你一眼。似乎是想听听你有没有关于 Jaspis 身体状况的消息。他又转过了头。

"岁月无情，我猜她自己也知道。所以她想留下一个更...好的世界，我想。"

texts.en: He grunts acknowledgement, looking down at the brightly painted graves.
texts.zh: 他赞同地哼了一声，一边低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

texts.en: He doesn't respond. Just looks down at the brightly painted graves.
texts.zh: 他没说什么，只是低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

texts.en:
"It is." He looks down at the graves. "It was."

"I've discovered that I'm a poor farmer, captain. It seems like everything withers at my touch."
texts.zh:
"是我的。" 他低头看向了坟墓。"以前是。"

"我发现我当农夫当得一塌糊涂，舰长。简直是种什么死什么。"

texts.en:
He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.

"No," he says. "I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh:
他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

"不用了。" 他说道，"我和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

texts.en: He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.
texts.zh: 他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

options.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
options.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

options.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
options.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

texts.en: "No," he says, then "Yes, I mean. I'm fine. Just, the answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh: "不，" 他说，然后又说，"是的，我是说。我很好。只是，我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead。这是我必须做的事。"

texts.en: "No," he says. "The answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh: "不。" 他说道，"我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

texts.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

options.en: Of course. I just need a body to substitute. (look pointedly at the graves)
options.zh: 当然了，我只要找具尸体代替你就成。 (意有所指地看一眼坟墓)

options.en: I'm afraid I cannot. The Archcurate gave me a mission and I intend to complete it.
options.zh: 恐怕不行。我打算认真完成大祭司给我交代的任务。

texts.en:
He looks, struck silent, at the light coming through the trees.

"Let someone else walk my path."

He turns to you. "I accept. Tell Jaspis... tell her... I should write something, maybe..."
texts.zh:
他抬起头，呆呆地看向树间洒落的阳光。

"就让其他人代我行我的道途吧。"

他回头看向你。"就这么办吧。告诉 Jaspis...告诉她...我或许该写点什么..."

options.en: No. You must live for yourself now.
options.zh: 不用。你应该为自己而活。

options.en: You should. It will help. She was... emotional.
options.zh: 写吧。可以起到一些作用。她... 很情绪化。

texts.en:
"But..." he falls silent.

In a long minute, he appears to accept your words.
texts.zh:
"但..." 他的声音低了下去。

过了许久，他似乎是同意了你的话。

texts.en: "This is it then," he turns and looks at you once more.
texts.zh: "那就到此为止了。" 他转过身，重新看向你。

options.en: It is. Burn bright, burn long. (leave)
options.zh: 是的。愿你的火光长明。 (离开)

options.en: It is. Blessed be your path. (leave)
options.zh: 是的。愿你的道途蒙福。 (离开)

options.en: It is. Keep your head down. (leave)
options.zh: 是的。愿你谦卑俯首。 (离开)

texts.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove, and return to your shuttle, and it returns you to your $shipOrFleet.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
texts.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林，回到了你的穿梭机，而后者带你回了你的$shipOrFleet。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在是自由之身了。从他的誓言中解脱，从阴谋诡计中解脱；他将自由地选择他接下来的人生，无论是什么在等着他。

texts.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove. Your marine squad falls in like spirits of the desert summoned to material form.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
texts.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。陆战小队也集合了，就像受到召唤显出真身的沙漠之灵一般。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在自由了。自由于他的誓言，自由于阴谋诡计；自由地选择他的下一世怎么活，无论是什么在等着他。

texts.en:
Finding a body to substitute for Bornanew is not difficult. One that appears to have died a violent death, but at least a quick death?

Shot in the back by a Pather seems likely, but too dramatic. An accident, then; even easier. A thruster malfunction at the docks. Over in a split second, and no one really to blame except slipshod safety/control measures. One of those unhappy little events that Providence provides to bring an unexpected end to the path of life... and which burns away obvious identifying features.

The Reverend Archcurate will accept a closed-casket burial, you think.
texts.zh:
找具尸体来代替 Bornanew 倒也不难。比如一具看起来痛快地死于非命的尸体？

一具被左径分子从背后射杀的尸体倒是挺可信，但太张扬了。伪装成意外会更加简单，比如船坞或者是喷气机故障。这样的事故只需要一瞬间，完全可以把这口黑锅扣在马虎的安保措施头上。这正是上天意想终结一条生命时会用到的小事故...也刚好能烧尽所有能够清晰辨明受害人身份的特征。

你觉得宗师大人也不会太在意棺材里躺的究竟是谁。

texts.en:
He sighs, covering his face with his hands. "I can't do this. I'm sorry."

"I have a duty. I made a promise. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，用手捂住了脸。"我做不到。对不起。"

"我有我的职责。我发过誓的。我必须这么做。"

texts.en:
"No," he says with a sudden ferocity.

He catches himself, then begins again, more calmly,
"And no, forget about all of that. I'm coming with you to Gilead. I have to."
texts.zh:
"不行。" 他忽然恶狠狠地喊了一句。

他止住了自己的失态，然后重新用更冷静的语气说道。
"不，啊，忘记刚才那些事吧。我会和你去 Gilead，我必须去。"

texts.en: "Of course," he says quietly. "I have a duty; I made a promise."
texts.zh: "当然了。" 他轻声道，"是我的职责；我发过誓的。"

texts.en:
He lets a breath out, and then almost casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Forgive me," he clears his throat. "Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
他呼了口气，然后看似随意地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"原谅我。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

texts.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

texts.en:
"Oh, um." He looks at you to see if you're really asking this, now. You are.

"There are... writings around Ludd. From the early disciplines, recorded later. They tend to be heavily, ah, corrected toward the Church's rulings in accordance with Ludd's wishes. Or what is known of them. Others, unofficial copies, have been created by con-artists and heretics to prove their own schemes and cults. These, the Knights purge. Some are kept as examples. For teaching; heretic-finding."

He shakes his head, "Anyway. The song of angels."
texts.zh:
"哦，呃。" 他观察着你，似乎想确认你是否真的要问这个问题。你坚持要问。

"这些是...有关于卢德的著作，都来自于早期的学派，被后人整理而成。按照教会的裁决和卢德的意愿，这些书都被大量，嗯，'纠错'。或者按照什么他们所知的东西。其他非正式的抄本都是由骗子与异端创建的，为了佐证他们的阴谋与派系。这些都会被骑士团净化，少部分保留下来作为案例，用于警示或是辨别异端。"

他摇了摇头，"无论如何，那是天使的歌谣。"

texts.en: "To put it crudely, in some accounts it is said that God spoke to the Prophet Ludd through... through singing only Ludd could hear."
texts.zh: "简单而言，有的记载说神与先知卢德的交流是通过...通过只有卢德本人才能听到的歌。"

options.zh: 这是卢德受神眷顾的证明。

options.en: It sounds like a neurological issue.
options.zh: 听起来像是种神经系统的毛病。

options.en: There was a time I heard... distant music. Like a choir.
options.zh: 以前我也会听到...遥远的旋律。像是唱诗班。

options.en: I have heard... distant music. Like a choir. Wasn't in telemetry.
options.zh: 我也听到过...遥远的旋律。像是唱诗班。不是遥测信息。

options.en: It's been said that Brother Livewell Cotton hears music. 'A choir of angels', those were the words.
options.zh: 据说 Livewell Cotton 修士也能听到旋律。'天使的合唱'，原话是这么说的。

options.en: Brother Livewell Cotton told me he has heard music. A 'choir of angels', he said.
options.zh: Livewell Cotton 修士也和我说他曾听到过旋律。他说那是 '天使的合唱'。

texts.en: "To be so blessed must be a burden beyond all knowing," Bornanew says grimly.
texts.zh: "如此受神眷顾必是无人能知的重担。" Bornanew 阴沉地说道。

texts.en:
"It could," Bornanew says, and looks to you. "Where between madness and the divine stands a prophet?"

"-On uneasy ground," he finishes; quoting something with a hint of a smile.
texts.zh:
"说不准呢。" Bornanew 说着，一边看向了你。"在疯狂与神性之间，先知将自立于何处？"

"—— 迎难而上。" 他自问自答，引述的同时不由得露出了一丝微笑。

texts.en: "It is not the time for theology," Bornanew says agreeably.
texts.zh: "现在确实不是谈神学的时候。" Bornanew 同意道。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow at you.
texts.zh: 他朝你挑了挑眉。

options.en: I heard the music when we encountered a strange ship. It used exotic technologies unknown to even the Domain.
options.zh: 我听过那种旋律，那时我们遇到了某艘怪异的舰船。它使用了甚至对 人之领 来说都未知的奇异技术。

options.en: I heard the music when we scanned the Gates, the Domain Gates, using a new method.
options.zh: 当我用一种新的方法扫描 人之领 的星门时，我听到了旋律。

options.en: That ship, the Ziggurat, is in orbit. In my fleet.
options.zh: 那艘船，'通灵塔'，就在轨道上。在我的舰队之中。

options.en: What am I supposed to do with a 'fearful omen'?
options.zh: 我该如何应对这 '可怕的预兆'？

options.en: Walk the Path of Light? That doesn't help.
options.zh: 遵从光之道途？那无济于事。

options.en: I will try to walk the path of light. When the time comes.
options.zh: 当时机成熟的时候，我将尽力遵从光明之道。

options.en: 'Path of light'? Brother Cotton told me the same thing.
options.zh: '光之道途'？Cotton 修士也跟我说过同样的东西。

options.en: Let us speak of other things.
Never mind. It's not important now.

texts.en: "That sounds like a fearful omen," Bornanew says earnestly.
texts.zh: "听起来像是个可怕的预兆。" Bornanew 认真地说道。

texts.en: "The doctrine of the Church tells us the Gates are a product of technological sin. I'm sure you know this," Bornanew says, watching you carefully. "Ludd's words, as far as we know them, do not put it quite so simply."
texts.zh: "教会的教条声称星门是科技原罪的产物，你肯定也知道的。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。"而据我们所知，卢德的原话却并没有如此简单。"

options.en: I have traversed the Gates. A lesser crossing, but I have the technology.
options.zh: 我曾穿过星门。可达范围不怎么广，但我有那个技术。

options.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
options.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

options.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
options.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

options.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
options.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

options.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
options.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

texts.en: "Then I beg Providence save us," Bornanew almost whispers. "I know not what door you have opened."
texts.zh: "愿上天保佑我们，" Bornanew 的话语声微不可闻。"我不敢想象你打开了怎样的一扇门。"

texts.en: "I admit, captain, that I cannot but look upon this gift with suspicion when the bones of the Domain lie moldering around us."
texts.zh: "人之领 的枯骨依旧洒遍这片星空，舰长，所以我不得不对这一馈赠保留怀疑的态度。"

texts.en: "One must be careful around great and terrible works such as the Gates. Even your science suggests that observation may change both subject and observer."
texts.zh: "对待星门这伟大又恐怖的杰作必须要小心。即使是你们的科学也提出了对事物的观察有可能同时改变观测者和被观测者。"

texts.en: "Just as well, then," Bornanew says, as if you've both just agreed to not discuss something. "I suspect the great factions will do little to avoid them."
texts.zh: "那就无所谓吧。" Bornanew 说道，你们似乎达成了不再谈一些事的共识，"我怀疑那些主要势力并不会那么做。"

texts.en: "Just as well, then. But I suspect few of the great factions share your intent."
texts.zh: "那就无所谓吧。但我怀疑没有几个主要势力和你想法相同。"

texts.en: Almost unconsciously he looks up to the sky, and says "Ludd's grace preserve us."
texts.zh: 他下意识地抬头仰望天空，并说着 "愿卢德保佑我们。"

texts.en:
He lets out a sigh.

"Reason as well as life are gifts of the Creator. We are tested by confrontation with divine mystery. We must decide if we follow the highest path, or merely the most convenient."

He speaks more quietly, "It is a test. When the time comes, will you walk the path of light?"
texts.zh:
他叹了口气。

"理性与生命都是造物主的礼物。直面神性之谜乃是神给与我们的考验。我们必须决定是追随最高尚的道途，还是最轻松的道途。"

他用更低的声音继续道。"这是一场试炼。到时候，你是否会行光之道途？"

texts.en: "I apologize," he says. "After you came all this way, I have only the words of a novice to offer you. No great secrets or wisdom."
texts.zh: "抱歉。" 他说道，"在你不远万里来到这里之后，我只能说一些见习修士也能复述的话语，没有什么大奥妙或是大智慧。"

texts.en: "I pray for your strength," he says.
texts.zh: "我会为你的坚毅祈祷。" 他回应道。

texts.en: "Truly?" Bornanew shakes his head, "Now it is I who is tested by a fearful omen."
texts.zh: "真的吗？" Bornanew 摇了摇头，"现在是我被这可怕的预兆考验。"

texts.en: "Of course. It is not now the time for theology," Bornanew says, watching you carefully.
texts.zh: "确实，现在不是谈神学的时候。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。

texts.en: "He would not be the first to make that claim," Bornanew says. "Nor the last, I am sure. God save us if Cotton were a prophet."
texts.zh: "敢这么说的，他绝不是第一个，" Bornanew 说道。"我敢肯定，也绝不会是最后一个。要是 Cotton 真能是个先知的话，愿神保佑我们。"

texts.en:
Your sensors officer and analysis team perform a thorough scan of the coordinates given to you by Nile Virens.

The location is a lightly populated, poorly developed rural zone on the far fringe of one of the more unremarkable Luddic-majority settlements. The land is nearly barren and bereft of valuable mineral deposits.

Orbital imaging shows a small, struggling farmstead close to the coordinates given. An individual human appears to be present, though it would require observation over a greater time period to fully establish an accurate count of inhabitants. There are also what appear to be a collection of burial sites near the farmstead.

"At least," your sensors officer reports, "that's what it appears to be. Weapons, people; many things can be hidden. Especially with the interference caused by this magnetic field..."
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官与分析小组对 Nile Virens 提供的坐标进行了彻底地扫描。

目标地点位于一个不起眼的卢德聚集地边缘，是一个人口稀少而未被开化的农业区。这是片不毛之地，几乎没有有价值的矿物资源。

轨道扫描显示坐标附近有一个破败的小农场。扫描图像中似乎有一个人，但是需要更长时间的扫描来确定是否有更多居民。在农场附近似乎有一些埋葬的痕迹。

"至少，" 你的传感器技官报告道，"看起来就是这样。武器、人员，许多东西都能被藏在这，尤其是在磁场干扰的情况下。"

texts.en:
You order a half-dozen of your most experienced marines to don surface warfare stealth-op gear.

Their outer suits shimmer and rustle, and six sleek black marines in light armor transform before you into a dusty haze, like a fiery, killing wind of divine vengeance out of some ancient Luddic myth.

You have to but whisper the code-phrase and they will perform a rapid assault to secure your position from most forms of military equipment available on Mazalot.
texts.zh:
你叫来六名经验最丰富的陆战队员，并给他们穿上地面作战用潜行战斗服。

在他们的外层战斗服一阵闪烁作响后，六名身着漆黑轻甲的陆战队员在你的眼前化作了一团烟雾，正如古老的卢德传说中那冒着火光的神杀之风。

你只需低声说出暗语，他们就会发动快速突袭，利用 Mazalot 上大部分可用的军事装备来确保你所在位置的安全。

texts.en: You order a shuttle prepared for descent to the coordinates provided to you by Nile Virens.
texts.zh: 你下令让一架穿梭机准备前往 Nile Virens 给你的坐标。

options.en: Take the shuttle to the surface
Order a scan of Bornanew's coordinates
options.zh: 下令对 Bornanew 的坐标进行一次扫描。

options.en: Bring a squad of marines as backup
options.zh: 带一队陆战队作为后援

options.en: Scrub the launch and consider your options
options.zh: 重新考虑除了出发以外的其他选择

Their outer suits shimmer and rustle, and six sleek black marines in light armor transform before you into a dusty haze, like a fiery, killing wind of divine vengeance out of some ancient Luddic myth.

texts.en:
The spectra of charged particles interacting with Mazalot's atmosphere flare and break like ocean waves.

Your shuttle's descent is smooth, your pilot interfacing with the lackadaisical local traffic control and receiving only token objection to landing near a Luddic-majority settlement.

"Near" is a relative term, of course; you're well over the horizon from all but a half-dozen of the prefab hab units that have been dragged out here and modified by their inhabitants. Half of those appear to be abandoned, the surrounding fields rippled with dust.
texts.zh:
各种各样的带电粒子与 Mazalot 大气层的光焰相互交汇，犹如海浪般涌动。

你的穿梭机降落得很顺利。在和当地无精打采的交通管制取得联系后，驾驶员降落在卢德信众定居点附近的请求只受到了一些象征性的反对。

当然，"附近" 也只是个相对概念；毕竟在视线所及之处，除了那六个拖到这儿被居民改造过的预制居住单元之外就什么都没有了。有一半看起来已经无人居住，周围的田地里只有些烟尘在涌动。

texts.en: Your shuttle lands, kicking up a cloud that wafts outward in a diminishing wave over a desolation of erratic boulders and ashy-looking trees.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机掀起一阵下洗气流，缓缓降落在布满不规则巨石与灰蒙蒙的树的荒凉地带。

texts.en: Your shuttle lands, and in a blur your marine squad fans out into the surrounding plain, a desolation of erratic boulders and ashy-looking trees.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机降落在布满不规则巨石与灰蒙蒙的树的荒凉地带。在雾气中，你的陆战队员迅速向四周的平地散开。

texts.en:
Before you is a modified prefab hab. A corroded, leaking irrigation system shudders unsteadily as it tends to an unhealthy-looking garden grid. The adjacent crop field is quite dead.

On the flight in, the shuttle sensors tagged a living human figure in the sheltered grove nearby.
texts.zh:
你面前是个改造过的预制居住舱。有个锈得到处漏水的灌溉系统正在打理一块看起来萎靡不振的菜园方格，由于不太稳固而有些颤颤巍巍的。旁边农田倒是都死透了。

在飞过来的途中，穿梭机的传感器曾标记了一个活人的信号，就在一旁茂密的小树林里。

texts.en:
You follow a path toward the grove. Protected from the parching winds by a low rise, it seems that the trees planted here collect almost enough moisture to survive.

A new run of ceramolith pipe follows the trail to the grove. Like someone wanted to water the trees.
texts.zh:
你沿着一条小径走向树林。这里的低地势抵御了干燥的风，树木似乎有足够的水分来生存。

一条崭新的陶瓷管线沿着小路直到树林里，就像有人在为树浇水一样。

texts.en:
You follow a path toward the grove. Sheltered from the dry winds by a low rise, it seems that the trees planted here collect almost enough moisture to survive. But not quite.

Your marines whisper tactical call-and-response in your ear. "$PlayerSirOrMadam," the squad leader addresses you personally, "Target ID confirmed; visual match with Bornanew. Appears unarmed."
texts.zh:
你沿着一条小径走向树林。这里的低地势抵御了干燥的风，树木似乎有一些水分来生存，但是并不够。

陆战队员的战术口令在你耳边轻轻地响起。"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 本次行动指派的队长亲自向你报告，"目标身份已确认，视觉匹配特征与 Bornanew 相符。似乎并未携带武器。"

texts.en:
The shade of the grove is speckled by light filtering through thin leaves.

You find a large man in a long, dusty hooded coat, almost a robe. His back is to you.

There are a handful of Luddic grave-markers here; brightly painted with natural pigments. These look well maintained.

The man's head is bowed, his hands clasped in prayer.
texts.zh:
树丛间的阴影洒满了从细叶穿过的点点阳光。

你找到了一个高大的男人，他穿着一条满是灰尘的长连帽外套，看起来就像是件袍子一样。他正背对着你。

周围有几个卢德教徒的墓碑；都画上了亮丽的天然颜料。它们看起来被打理得很好。

男人低垂着脑袋，双手合十正在祈祷。

texts.zh: "听起来像是个可怕的预兆。" Bornanew 认真地说道。

texts.en: Almost unconsciously he looks up to the sky, and says "Ludd's grace preserve us."
texts.zh: 他下意识地抬头仰望天空，并说着 "愿卢德保佑我们。"

texts.en:
He lets out a sigh.

"Reason as well as life are gifts of the Creator. We are tested by confrontation with divine mystery. We must decide if we follow the highest path, or merely the most convenient."

He speaks more quietly, "It is a test. When the time comes, will you walk the path of light?"
texts.zh:
他叹了口气。

"理性与生命都是造物主的礼物。直面神性之谜乃是神给与我们的考验。我们必须决定是追随最高尚的道途，还是最轻松的道途。"

他用更低的声音继续道。"这是一场试炼。到时候，你是否会行光之道途？"

texts.en: "The doctrine of the Church tells us the Gates are a product of technological sin. I'm sure you know this," Bornanew says, watching you carefully. "Ludd's words, as far as we know them, do not put it quite so simply."
texts.zh: "教会的教条声称星门是科技原罪的产物，你肯定也知道的。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。"而据我们所知，卢德的原话却并没有如此简单。"

options.en: I have traversed the Gates. A lesser crossing, but I have the technology.
options.zh: 我曾穿过星门。可达范围不怎么广，但我有那个技术。

options.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
options.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

options.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
options.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

texts.en: "Then I beg Providence save us," Bornanew almost whispers. "I know not what door you have opened."
texts.zh: "愿上天保佑我们，" Bornanew 的话语声微不可闻。"我不敢想象你打开了怎样的一扇门。"

options.en: The Gates are a gift, Bornanew. We should use them.
options.zh: 星门是一种馈赠，Bornanew。我们应该利用它们。

options.en: The Gates are dangerous. They must be studied carefully.
options.zh: 星门很危险，研究它们时要慎之又慎。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them.
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。

options.en: Just as well, because I intend to avoid them. (lie)
options.zh: 也无所谓了，因为我打算离它们远点。 (说谎)

texts.en: "I admit, captain, that I cannot but look upon this gift with suspicion when the bones of the Domain lie moldering around us."
texts.zh: "人之领 的枯骨依旧洒遍这片星空，舰长，所以我不得不对这一馈赠保留怀疑的态度。"

texts.en: "One must be careful around great and terrible works such as the Gates. Even your science suggests that observation may change both subject and observer."
texts.zh: "对待星门这伟大又恐怖的杰作必须要小心。即使是你们的科学也提出了对事物的观察有可能同时改变观测者和被观测者。"

texts.en: "Just as well, then. But I suspect few of the great factions share your intent."
texts.zh: "那就无所谓吧。但我怀疑没有几个主要势力和你想法相同。"

texts.en: "Just as well, then," Bornanew says, as if you've both just agreed to not discuss something. "I suspect the great factions will do little to avoid them."
texts.zh: "那就无所谓吧。" Bornanew 说道，你们似乎达成了不再谈一些事的共识，"我怀疑那些主要势力并不会那么做。"

texts.en: "Of course. It is not now the time for theology," Bornanew says, watching you carefully.
texts.zh: "确实，现在不是谈神学的时候。" Bornanew 谨慎地看着你道。

texts.en: "He would not be the first to make that claim," Bornanew says. "Nor the last, I am sure. God save us if Cotton were a prophet."
texts.zh: "敢这么说的，他绝不是第一个，" Bornanew 说道。"我敢肯定，也绝不会是最后一个。要是 Cotton 真能是个先知的话，愿神保佑我们。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Yes. I am Jethro Bornanew."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"是，我就是 Jethro Bornanew。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "No," he says. He glances back at the graves. "This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"这个所剩无几的农场，是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

texts.en:
"No," he says, looking at the graves. "I never met them. Not when they were alive, I mean."

"This farm - what's left of it - they built it. So I was told."
texts.zh:
"不是。" 他说着看了那些坟墓一眼，"我从没见过他们，至少没在他们在世时见过。"

"这个所剩无几的农场，就是他们搭的。至少我知道的是这样。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. The Reverend Archcurate. Of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，那位受人尊敬的宗师大人。当然了。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you. "Of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你。"行吧。"

texts.en: He unclasps his hands and turns to you, a hint of concern on his face. "I see. Jaspis, of course."
texts.zh: 他分开双手转向了你，脸上带着一丝忧虑。"我知道了，Jaspis。当然了。"

texts.en: He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline. "You came a long way. Captain, I assume?"
texts.zh: 他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，舰长？"

texts.en:
He looks over your uniform, then past you toward the ridgeline.

"You came a long way. And you brought warriors." He turns back to the graves, "I've counted two, so far."
texts.zh:
他的视线扫过你的制服，然后穿过你望向了山脊线。

"我猜你是大老远过来的吧，而且你还带了士兵。" 他回过头重新看向坟墓，"至此为止，我数到了两个人。"

texts.en:
"It is." He looks down at the graves. "It was."

"I've discovered that I'm a poor farmer, captain. It seems like everything withers at my touch."
texts.zh:
"是我的。" 他低头看向了坟墓。"以前是。"

"我发现我当农夫当得一塌糊涂，舰长。简直是种什么死什么。"

texts.en: He gives you a strange look. "If you really want to, I suppose."
texts.zh: 他莫名其妙地看了你一眼。"如果你真的想这么叫的话，也行。"

options.en: Jeff it is. It's less... you know.
options.zh: 那就 Jeff。这样不怎么...啊，你懂的。

options.en: I'm not being serious. Your name is Jethro.
options.zh: 我开玩笑的，你就叫 Jethro。

texts.en: "Less Luddic, you mean," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
texts.zh: "你是想说更不卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

texts.en: "Less Luddic," he says with a smirk. "I understand."
texts.zh: "这样不怎么卢德化。" 他咧嘴一笑道，"我懂。"

texts.en:
"Ah," he smiles awkwardly.

"I apologize. This is all... not a shock, exactly. A rather large turn on the path that I have found to be my life, I suppose. It is a lot to reflect upon, now that it is happening."
texts.zh:
"啊，" 他尴尬地笑了笑。

"抱歉。这一切...确切地说，不怎么震惊。我想，这是我人生道路上的相当大的转折。有很多值得反思的地方。"

texts.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..." Bornanew shakes his head.
texts.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..." Bornanew 摇了摇头。

options.en: Sedge? Don't worry, I killed him.
options.zh: Sedge？别担心，他已经被我杀了。

texts.en:
"I failed," he says.

After a moment, he speaks again, "And I confess, I wanted to fail. After meeting the recruiter on Chalcedon..."

Bornanew shakes his head.
texts.zh:
"我失败了。" 他说道。

过了一会，他又补充道："而且老实说，我是故意失败的。在见到 Chalcedon 的那个招募人后..."

Bornanew 摇了摇头。

texts.en:
"Yes," he looks surprised, "That was his name. I did not like the man. I did not like the things I would have to do to make him like me."

Bornanew looks away, "He seemed to be someone I might have been if I had lived a different life. Walked a different path."
texts.zh:
"对。" 他看起来有些惊讶，"他就是叫这个。我不喜欢那个人。也不喜欢为了让他喜欢我而不得不做的事。"

Bornanew 移开了目光。"他就像是另一个我，一个拥有不同人生，走上不同道路的我。"

options.zh: 别担心，Sedge 已经被我杀了。

options.en: The deed is done. Or not done, in your case. Let it go.
options.zh: 已经过去了。可能也不算吧，考虑到你的话。走吧。

options.en: But you're not him. That's why Jaspis wants you back.
options.zh: 但你不是他，所以 Jaspis 才想叫你回去。

options.en: You'll have to learn to be a lot less squeamish if you're to be a Knight.
options.zh: 若想成为骑士，你可不能这么软弱。

texts.en:
"You- what?" He looks you in the eyes, to confirm that you are telling the truth. He quickly discovers that you are.

"I have no words," he says, shaking his head.
texts.zh:
"你 —— 什么？" 他看向你的双眼，确认着你是不是在说真话。他很快发现，你确实是认真的。

"我不知道说什么好。" 他摇了摇头道。

options.en: Aren't you a Knight Initiate? How can you be so squeamish?
options.zh: 你不是个新晋骑士吗？怎么会这么软弱？

texts.en:
"I might not be when I get back," he admits.

"But you're right. It is probable that a Knight will be called upon to kill to defend the Faith. It is what I agreed to, what I swore I would learn."
texts.zh:
"等我回去时大概就不算了。" 他承认道。

"但你说得没错。骑士很可能被召唤去为了捍卫信仰而进行杀戮，这是我同意的事，也是我发誓要学会的事。"

options.en: Look, this one was on me. Don't worry about it.
options.zh: 听着，这件事算在我头上。别担心了。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en:
"I feel that I must," he says. "In one sense, his death is due to my choices, though I had no way of knowing it."

"It is true also that he was, by all accounts - and indeed in my judgment - an evil man. His faith twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
texts.zh:
"我觉得我做不到。" 他说，"从某方面来看，他的死也是因为我的选择造成的，就算我不可能提前得知会那样。"

"不过他也确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看这都是事实 —— 我个人也是这么觉得的。他的信仰扭曲而自私。他也因此不会后悔自己的...'行为'。"

options.en: You're worrying about it. I told you not to.
options.zh: 我和你说了纠结这事了，你还这样。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en:
"I cannot do that," he says.

"I do concede that he was, by all accounts and indeed my judgment, an evil man. His faith, it was twisted in upon itself. It shielded him from remorse for his... actions."
texts.zh:
"我做不到。" 他说道。

"我也承认他确实是个恶人，不管从哪个方面来看都是这样 —— 我主观上也是这么觉得的。他扭曲自私的信仰导致他从不后悔自己的...'行为'。"

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en: "I cannot do that," he says.
texts.zh: "我做不到。" 他说道。

options.en: See? This is why you're the man for whatever Jaspis is up to.
options.zh: 看到了吗？这就是为什么你是 Jaspis 所需要的人选。

texts.en: He nods hesitantly, and says "Then I will speak no further on this matter."
texts.zh: 他犹豫地点点头，说道："那我就不说这个了。"

texts.en: He gives you a skeptical look, "That worries me all the more."
texts.zh: 他怀疑地看了你一眼，道："这让我更担心了。"

texts.en: "Your words are a cold comfort, captain."
texts.zh: "你的安慰于事无补，舰长。"

texts.en:
"The Reverend Archcurate," he says automatically.

"Sorry," he adds quickly. "Habit. They really drill it into you in the Church. Archcurate Jaspis... told me I could call her Sophronia, as if I was family."

"She wants to change the path of the Faith, I believe. She believes I can help her do it."
texts.zh:
"宗师大人。" 他条件反射地说道。

"抱歉。" 他很快补充道，"习惯了，教会里真的会把这个烙进你的脑子。大祭司 Jaspis 说...我可以叫她 Sophronia，就像一家人一样。"

"我认为她想改变信仰之道。而她认为我可以帮她实现。"

texts.en:
"So was Ludd," he says, and laughs.

"Ah," he catches himself, and wipes his eyes. "Forgive me my blasphemy. I do not believe I am Ludd; I do not hear God's word in the songs of angels."
texts.zh:
"卢德也是。" 他说着大笑了起来。

"啊。" 他止住了自己的失态，擦了擦眼睛，"原谅我的不敬。我不觉得我会是卢德；我没在天使之歌中听到神言。"

texts.en: He sighs deeply. "Was it necessary?"
texts.zh: 他深深地叹了口气。"那是必要的吗？"

options.en: That's not important now. I have a mission to complete.
options.zh: 现在无所谓了。我还有任务要完成。

options.en: Yes. In conflicts between the powerful, that's how it works.
options.zh: 是的。权势之争向来如此。

texts.en: "Gilead," he says, staring at the graves.
texts.zh: "Gilead。" 他盯着坟墓说道。

texts.en: He looks at you uneasily, but says nothing.
texts.zh: 他有些不安地看着你，但并没有开口。

texts.en: "I see," he looks at you uneasily.
texts.zh: "我知道了。" 他不安地看着你。

texts.en:
He shrugs. "The Reverend Archcurate does. And that was enough to bring you here, for me."

He glances over at you, "I don't care to speculate about how many credits she's wasting on me."
texts.zh:
他耸了耸肩。"但宗师大人确实这么觉得，你都因此被派来找我了。"

他瞥了你一眼。"我都不愿去想她在我身上浪费了多少星币。"

texts.en:
"Yes," he says and glances at you. Expecting some news of Jaspis' health, maybe. He turns away again.

"Time comes for us all. I expect she sees that. She wants to leave behind a world... that's better, I think."
texts.zh:
"是啊。" 他说着瞥了你一眼。似乎是想听听你有没有关于 Jaspis 身体状况的消息。他又转过了头。

"岁月无情，我猜她自己也知道。所以她想留下一个更...好的世界，我想。"

texts.en: He grunts acknowledgement, looking down at the brightly painted graves.
texts.zh: 他赞同地哼了一声，一边低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

texts.en: He doesn't respond. Just looks down at the brightly painted graves.
texts.zh: 他没说什么，只是低头看着色彩鲜艳的坟墓。

texts.en:
He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.

"No," he says. "I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh:
他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

"不用了。" 他说道，"我和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

options.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
options.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

texts.en: "No," he says, then "Yes, I mean. I'm fine. Just, the answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh: "不，" 他说，然后又说，"是的，我是说。我很好。只是，我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead。这是我必须做的事。"

texts.en: "No," he says. "The answer is no. I'm coming with you to Gilead. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh: "不。" 他说道，"我不想变成尸体。我会和你去 Gilead，这是我该做的。"

texts.en: He quickly turns to stare at you with a strange intensity. "I-," he begins, and his words catch in his throat. He breathes heavily for a moment, almost unsteady on his feet.
texts.zh: 他飞快地转过身，并带着一种奇怪的热切死死地盯着你。"我 ——" 他开口道，但是声音卡在了喉咙里。他用力喘了几口气，几乎站不稳脚跟。

options.en: Don't die for real on me, now.
options.zh: 你可别真死在我面前了。

texts.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

texts.en:
He lets a breath out, and then almost casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Forgive me," he clears his throat. "Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
他呼了口气，然后看似随意地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"原谅我。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

texts.en:
After a moment, he lets a breath out, and then almost - but not quite - casually wipes a sleeve across his face. His eyes are red, you see.

"Yes. Yes, I am well. Is your offer serious? You would do this thing for me?"
texts.zh:
过了一会儿，他呼了口气，然后看似随便地用袖口抹了把脸。你发现他双眼通红。

"对。是的，我很好。" 他清了清嗓子，"但你说的是真的？你愿意对我那么做？"

options.en: Of course. I just need a body to substitute. (look pointedly at the graves)
options.zh: 当然了，我只要找具尸体代替你就成。 (意有所指地看一眼坟墓)

options.en: I'm afraid I cannot. The Archcurate gave me a mission and I intend to complete it.
options.zh: 恐怕不行。我打算认真完成大祭司给我交代的任务。

texts.en:
"No," he says with a sudden ferocity.

He catches himself, then begins again, more calmly,
"And no, forget about all of that. I'm coming with you to Gilead. I have to."
texts.zh:
"不行。" 他忽然恶狠狠地喊了一句。

他止住了自己的失态，然后重新用更冷静的语气说道。
"不，啊，忘记刚才那些事吧。我会和你去 Gilead，我必须去。"

texts.en: "Of course," he says quietly. "I have a duty; I made a promise."
texts.zh: "当然了。" 他轻声道，"是我的职责；我发过誓的。"

texts.en:
He looks, struck silent, at the light coming through the trees.

"Let someone else walk my path."

He turns to you. "I accept. Tell Jaspis... tell her... I should write something, maybe..."
texts.zh:
他抬起头，呆呆地看向树间洒落的阳光。

"就让其他人代我行我的道途吧。"

他回头看向你。"就这么办吧。告诉 Jaspis...告诉她...我或许该写点什么..."

options.en: No. You must live for yourself now.
options.zh: 不用。你应该为自己而活。

options.en: You should. It will help. She was... emotional.
options.zh: 写吧。可以起到一些作用。她... 很情绪化。

texts.en:
He sighs, covering his face with his hands. "I can't do this. I'm sorry."

"I have a duty. I made a promise. It's what I have to do."
texts.zh:
他叹了口气，用手捂住了脸。"我做不到。对不起。"

"我有我的职责。我发过誓的。我必须这么做。"

texts.en:
"But..." he falls silent.

In a long minute, he appears to accept your words.
texts.zh:
"但..." 他的声音低了下去。

过了许久，他似乎是同意了你的话。

texts.en: "This is it then," he turns and looks at you once more.
texts.zh: "那就到此为止了。" 他转过身，重新看向你。

options.en: It is. Burn bright, burn long. (leave)
options.zh: 是的。愿你的火光长明。 (离开)

options.en: It is. Blessed be your path. (leave)
options.zh: 是的。愿你的道途蒙福。 (离开)

options.en: It is. Keep your head down. (leave)

texts.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove, and return to your shuttle, and it returns you to your $shipOrFleet.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
texts.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林，回到了你的穿梭机，而后者带你回了你的$shipOrFleet。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在是自由之身了。从他的誓言中解脱，从阴谋诡计中解脱；他将自由地选择他接下来的人生，无论是什么在等着他。

texts.en:
You walk from the graves, from the dry grove. Your marine squad falls in like spirits of the desert summoned to material form.

Jethro Bornanew - the man who was once called Jethro Bornanew - is a free man now. Free of his oath, free of schemes; free to live his next life, whatever it may be.
texts.zh:
你离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。陆战小队也集合了，就像受到召唤显出真身的沙漠之灵一般。

Jethro Bornanew —— 或者说那个曾经叫 Jethro Bornanew 的人 —— 现在自由了。自由于他的誓言，自由于阴谋诡计；自由地选择他的下一世怎么活，无论是什么在等着他。

texts.en:
Finding a body to substitute for Bornanew is not difficult. One that appears to have died a violent death, but at least a quick death?

Shot in the back by a Pather seems likely, but too dramatic. An accident, then; even easier. A thruster malfunction at the docks. Over in a split second, and no one really to blame except slipshod safety/control measures. One of those unhappy little events that Providence provides to bring an unexpected end to the path of life... and which burns away obvious identifying features.

The Reverend Archcurate will accept a closed-casket burial, you think.
texts.zh:
找具尸体来代替 Bornanew 倒也不难。比如一具看起来痛快地死于非命的尸体？

一具被左径分子从背后射杀的尸体倒是挺可信，但太张扬了。伪装成意外会更加简单，比如船坞或者是喷气机故障。这样的事故只需要一瞬间，完全可以把这口黑锅扣在马虎的安保措施头上。这正是上天意想终结一条生命时会用到的小事故...也刚好能烧尽所有能够清晰辨明受害人身份的特征。

你觉得宗师大人也不会太在意棺材里躺的究竟是谁。

texts.en:
You and Bornanew walk from the graves, from the dry grove.

"There's nothing here I need," Bornanew says as you pause before the dying farmstead. "I am prepared to leave."

The shuttle returns you to your $shipOrFleet.
texts.zh:
你和 Bornanew 离开了墓地，走出了干燥的树林。

"我也没什么要拿的。" Bornanew 见你在垂死的农庄前停了一下，如此说道，"我准备好出发了。"

穿梭机把你带回了你的$shipOrFleet。

options.en: Take a shuttle with Bornanew to the surface
options.zh: 和 Bornanew 一起坐穿梭机前往地表

texts.en:
Your shuttle is given an unusually expedient flight path to the complex housing Jaspis' office.

Bornanew watches the green world of Gilead grow below you.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机被允许使用一条比以往通畅许多的航空通道，直达 Jaspis 办公室所在的建筑。

Bornanew 看着苍绿色的 Gilead 在你们脚下展开。

options.zh: 和 Mazalot 不一样，是吧？

texts.en:
You are met on the landing pad by a solemn Luddic Knight and attending Knight Initiate. The Knight's frown deepens noticeably as they take in Bornanew.

Knight Ailanthus leads you to Archcurate Jaspis' office in otherwise judgmental silence. Bornanew takes this treatment in stride, enjoying the gardens and fresh air.
texts.zh:
在停机坪上等着你们的是一位严肃的卢德骑士，还有随同的新晋骑士。在领走 Bornanew 时，那位骑士的眉头明显皱得更深了。

骑士 Ailanthus 带着你们走向 Jaspis 大祭司的办公室。在评判性的沉默中，Bornanew 只是大步流星地走着，享受着花园和新鲜空气。

texts.en:
As you enter Jaspis' office, Knight Ailanthus inhales to announce you - and the Archcurate interrupts.

"Jethro, here you are!" she says, "Providence provides!" Knight Ailanthus lets out a cough, and Jaspis responds by waving them away.

"As well, I must attest, by way of the efforts of the good captain whose footsteps I hear also," she says, smiling, "For lest we forget, the Path of the righteous will not walk upon itself, is that not so?"
texts.zh:
正当你们走进 Jaspis 的办公室，骑士 Ailanthus 吸了一口气准备宣布你们的到来时 —— 大祭司打断了他。

"Jethro，你来了！" 她说道，"上天恩赐！" 骑士 Ailanthus 咳了一声，Jaspis 的回应只是挥挥手让他下去。

"而我也不得不说，你能无恙也是拜现在踏步来此的舰长所赐。" 她微笑着说道，"休让我们忘记，正义之道终需有人开拓，不是吗？"

texts.en:
Bornanew takes Jaspis' small, frail hand in his own.

"Yes, of course. Please, Mother Sophronia, you must not get too excited. It is just me, and I have caused you much distress."

"Yes and truly, " she says, shaking Bornanew off. "And for it you've already decided to undergo some senseless display of penance, I doubt not. An unseemly habit learnt from the Knights."

"Captain," she turns toward you. "You must grow tired of this, so I shall be succinct: you have my deepest gratitude. My secretary shall see that you receive your payment."

She aims herself at the doorway, "Degory, attend!"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 握住了 Jaspis 脆弱纤小的手。

"是的，是的。教母 Sophronia，请你毋须这么激动。只是我而已，我给你造成了这么多的苦恼。"

"正是如此。" 她说着甩开了 Bornanew。"而且我毫不怀疑你还准备做一些无意义的表面忏悔工作。真是个从骑士团那儿学来的不体面的习惯。"

"舰长。" 她转向了你，"你一定听烦了，所以我就简洁些：我向你致以最深切的谢意。我的秘书会确保你拿到报酬的。"

她朝着门口道："Degory，过来！"

texts.en:
As you leave with Degory, you hear Jaspis address Bornanew.

"The balance of power is changed; both I and the Faith's future have need of you. But..."

"Why 'Jeff'?" she asks.

You don't hear his reply.
texts.zh:
你和 Degory 一起离开时，你听到 Jaspis 对 Bornanew 说。

"力量的平衡改变了；我和信仰的未来都会需要你。只是..."

"怎么叫你 'Jeff'？" 她问道。

你没听到他的回复。

texts.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together and nods his head.

Blind to his response, Jaspis begins to address him, "The balance of power is changed; both I and the Faith's future have need of you..."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 收起了他的双手，然后点了点头。

Jaspis 并不能看见他的回应，她开始对他说道："力量的平衡改变了；我和信仰的未来都会需要你..."

texts.en:
The soft-spoken secretary, Degory, produces an incongruous datapad from her robes and conducts the transfer of the Archcurate's payment to your accounts. She then summons the grim-faced Knight Ailanthus to escort you to your waiting shuttle.

Your return to orbit is uneventful.
texts.zh:
说话轻声细语的秘书 Degory 从她的袍子里拿出了一个和她的形象完全不搭调的数据平板，把 大祭司 给你的报酬转入了你的账户。然后她叫来了冷着脸的骑士 Ailanthus，由他送你去正在等你的穿梭机。

返回轨道的过程一切顺利。

texts.en:
He smiles, acknowledging the absurdity of your statement.

"Mazalot wasn't all bad. There was a sort of freedom there that can't be found on Gilead, though much danger as well."

He turns back to the view, "I did miss the green."
texts.zh:
他微笑着，承认你陈述中的荒谬之处。

"Mazalot 也没那么坏。那里有一种在 Gilead 找不到的自由，尽管同样伴随着许多危险。"

他转回去看向窗外，"我确实怀念这里的绿意。"

texts.en:
He smiles politely.

"Apprehensive, I confess. I believe I shall be punished by the Knights, though the Reverend Archurate may try to shield me. I shall ask her not to. An oath is an oath."

"I suspect there will be much silent contemplation and scrubbing of floors." He looks thoughtful, "They do like that sort of thing. I don't mind it."

He turns back to the face of Gilead.
texts.zh:
他礼貌的微笑道：

"老实说还是有点怕的。我相信骑士团会惩罚我，而宗师大人会试着帮我说话。我会让她别那么做的。誓言就是誓言。"

"我猜会有不少静坐，还要擦地板。" 他思索道，"他们挺喜欢用这类事情惩罚人的。我倒不是很在意。"

他重新回头看向了 Gilead。
