texts.en:
As your officers perform routine approach procedures, Comms signals for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam, there is an incoming link using a Knights of Ludd signifier. A... Jethro Bornanew wishes to speak with you. Just a novice of the Knights, it looks like."
texts.zh:
当你的军官们执行常规接近程序时，通讯设备发出了信号来吸引你的注意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，有人发来了使用卢德骑士团身份标识的通讯链接。一个叫...Jethro Bornanew 的人希望与你通话。看起来只是骑士团的一位新晋骑士。"

options.en: A call from Jeff? Of course, put him through.
options.zh: Jeff 打来的？当然，接通就好。
接受 Bornanew 的通讯链接

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName. I do not forget your assistance." He makes a crooked smile.

The link is poor-quality; his voice is hollowed, lacking the warmth you remember.

"I would ask, beg if I must, for your service once more."
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，我没有忘记你的帮助。" 他露出了一个歪斜的笑容。

链接信号质量很差；他的声音空洞，少了你记忆中的那份温暖。

"我想请求，如果必须的话我会乞求，求你能再帮助我一次。"

texts.en:
"What I ask, it is a part of the penance I must serve." He raises a hand, as if to stop your objections, "I do also believe it will also serve a spiritual and intrinsic good."

"And," he clears his throat, "for your assistance, a substantial reward of credits has been authorized by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis."

"The service..." He releases a breath. "An object considered holy by some in the mother Church has appeared in the possession of a wealthy collector."
texts.zh:
"我的请求，是我必须进行的苦修的一部分。" 他抬起手，仿佛要阻止你的反对，"我也相信，这同样能带来精神上和本质上的益处。"

"并且，"他清了清嗓子，" 为了酬谢你的协助，Jaspis 宗师大人已经批准了一笔可观的星币奖励。"

"要帮的忙..." 他呼出一口气。"一件被教会母亲中的某些人视为圣物的物品，出现在了一位富有收藏家的手中。"

options.en: Did this collector not make a large enough tithe?
options.zh: 这位收藏家交的什一税不够多吗？

texts.en:
"No," he says, looking up. "That would have been simple. This object, this 'relic', is by all appearances still untouched on Tartessus, in the archives of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus."

"The curates of the archive were in some panic at word that they had lost a holy relic. They checked very, very carefully. I too have personally confirmed that it remains in their keeping."
texts.zh:
"不，" 他说着，抬起了头。"那样反而还简单了。但这件物品，这件 '圣物'，怎么看都还原封不动地保存在 Tartessus，在 Exodus 神圣大教堂的档案室里。"

"档案室的祭司们听说他们弄丢了一件圣物，一度陷入恐慌。他们非常、非常仔细地检查过了。我也亲自确认过，圣物保管在他们那里。"

options.en: So it's a fake. No problem.
options.zh: 所以那是个赝品。没啥大麻烦。

options.en: And this is embarrassing to the Church?

texts.en:
"But it could be," $global.jethroName says hesitantly. "It raises... questions."

"And those may become a problem. It is a complex situation and potentially dangerous."
texts.zh:
"其实可能有，" $global.jethroName 迟疑地说。"它引出了...一些问题。"

"而这些问题可能会变成麻烦。情况很复杂，而且有潜在危险。"

texts.en:
"If you choose to assist me," he says, "then I shall share with you what, ah, 'intel' I have managed to piece together."

He looks almost embarrassed for a moment, then forces himself proceed. "Credits, yes. I have also been instructed to offer a payment of 50,000 credits when - if - you join my investigation, and an additional 50,000 credits upon completion of my quest."

"If it is possible." He sighs, "And that I cannot promise."
texts.zh:
"如果你选择协助我，" 他说，"那么我将与你分享我设法拼凑出来的，呃，'情报'。"

他看起来尴尬了一阵，然后强迫自己说下去。"对，星币。我还得到指示，当 —— 假设如此 —— 你加入我的调查，那么我会提供 50,000 星币的报酬，任务完成后再追加 50,000 星币。"

"如果能完成的话。" 他叹了口气，"这一点我无法保证。"

options.en: Remind me, there was mention of payment...
options.zh: 我想起来，你好像提到了报酬的事...

options.en: Before I agree, I need to know of potential factional conflicts.
options.zh: 在答应之前，我需要了解一下可能存在的势力纠纷。

options.en: Now that I've agreed, I need to know of any potential factional conflicts.
options.zh: 既然我已经答应了，我得了解一下可能存在的势力纠纷。

options.en: It sounds like you don't consider this object to be a legitimate holy relic.
options.zh: 听起来你并不认为这圣物是真的。

options.en: Just how much penance are they going to make you do?
options.zh: 他们到底要让你做多少赎罪的事？
和我说说关于你赎罪任务的事。

options.en: I accept. I shall assist you in your, uh, quest.
options.zh: 我接下了。我会在你，嗯，执行任务时协助你。

options.en: Arrange a shuttle for Bornanew and close the comms
options.zh: 为 Bornanew 安排一架穿梭机并关闭通讯

options.en: I will take my time to consider your request, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 我会花时间考虑你的请求，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I will take more time to consider your request, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 我会再花点时间来考虑你的请求，$global.jethroName。

options.en: Make some excuse and close the comms.

texts.en:
"Of course," he says, opening a battered notebook. "The Church anticipates expenses. Well," he grimaces, "Reverend Archcurate Jaspis does."

"Yes, 50,000 upfront, and another 50,000 credits upon satisfactory resolution. It is hoped that the false artifact might be removed from consideration, one way or another."

He gives you a questioning look. "Without causing an interfactional incident, that is."
texts.zh:
"当然，" 他说着，翻开了一本破旧的笔记本。"教会 会预支费用。好吧，" 他皱眉，"是 Jaspis 宗师大人会预支费用。"

"对，先付 50,000，问题解决后再付 50,000 星币。不管通过何种方式，我们希望这件虚假圣物能被排除出人们的视线之外。"

他用探询的目光看着你。"也就是说，不能引发势力间的冲突。"

texts.en:
"A reasonable concern." Bornanew rubs his chin. "First and without doubt, a notable member of a Persean League gens is involved."

"The rest are deduction and speculation." He starts counting off fingers, "The Cathedral of Holy Exodus has much to lose if corruption is revealed in their house; I suspect an insider or an infiltrator."

Next finger, "Within the greater Church, there is a loosely organized sect who, ah, back the theological legitimacy of relics. They would doubtless have forceful opinions on the subject of a duplicate relic, and that in secular hands."
texts.zh:
"是个合理的担忧。" Bornanew 摸着下巴。"首先，毫无疑问，有一位 英仙座联盟 旗下氏族中的名人牵涉其中。"

"其余的都是推断和猜测。" 他掰着手指头数道，"如果 Exodus 神圣大教堂内部被揭露存在腐败行为，那他们将损失惨重；而我怀疑是泄密者或间谍。"

他伸出下一根手指，"在更广义的 教会 内部，有一个组织松散的教派，他们，嗯，坚定支持圣物的神学合法性质。面对一件圣物复制品，更别提还是落入世俗之手的复制品，他们无疑会有强烈意见。"

texts.en:
Another finger, "The Luddic Path has much to gain from discord within the Church, and they have proximity to... the problem."

Next finger, "Though it is possible that the criminal underworld has found a means of profit here, possibly Kanta's organization. The pirate queen has an especial taste for desecration, though has demonstrated no particular hatred for the Church beyond her habitual misanthropy." He lets his hands fall.

"Beyond that, I grasp for tenuous threads, captain."
texts.zh:
他又伸出一根手指，"卢德左径 能从教会内部的纷争中拿到很多好处，而且他们与这次...问题关系密切。"

接着是下一根手指，"尽管有可能是作恶多端的黑道集团发现这一行有利可图，或许是 Kanta 那一派。那个海盗女王有着亵渎圣物的特殊癖好，但在一贯的厌世行径以外，她没有表现得特别憎恨教会。" 他垂下了双手。

"除了这些，我就只剩一些微不足道的线索了，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Um. It is so obvious?" Bornanew almost looks guilty. Almost.

"The Reverend Archcurate did say that my feelings on the subject are... not easily veiled."

"This investigation requires discretion." He brings his hands together. "I shall be mindful of my disposition."
texts.zh:
"唔，有那么明显吗？" Bornanew 看起来几乎有些内疚，几乎。

"宗师大人确实说过，我对这个物件的看法...不太容易掩饰。"

"这次调查需要谨慎行事。" 他双手合十。"我会注意自己的态度。"

texts.en:
"This is only the beginning, I am certain," he says with resigned humor. "Violation of Knightly vows is no small falsity, and I am uncertain even that I am truly meant to 'solve' this task set before me."

He pauses, then speaks more quietly, "I fear that my failure might be intended to chasten Jaspis. The Reverend Archcurate, I mean." He looks upward, and lets out a sigh. "She has put altogether too much faith in me."
texts.zh:
"我敢肯定，这只是个开始，" 他带着无可奈何的幽默说。"违反骑士的誓言可不是小错，而且我甚至不确定我是否真的被指望 '解决' 摆在面前的这个任务。"

他停顿了一下，然后更小声地说道，"我担心我的失败可能会被迁就于 Jaspis。我是说，那位宗师大人。" 他向上看了一眼，叹了口气。"她实在太过信任我了。"

texts.en:
"It is... trying," he says. "I am not, I am sure, meant to 'solve' this quest set before me to my violation of Knightly vows. Remorse, contrition... those I give freely, and wholly."

He speaks more quietly, "I speculate that my failure and disgrace is being arranged to humble the influence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis." He shakes his head, "She has put altogether too much faith into me."
texts.zh:
"这...很考验人，" 他说道，"我确信，我并没有被指望去 '解决' 这个因我违背骑士誓言而被摆在我面前的任务。至于懊悔与忏罪...我甘愿献上，毫无保留。"

他的声音更低了，"我推测，这些正被安排到我身上的失败和耻辱，就是为了削弱 Jaspis 宗师大人的影响力。"他摇了摇头，"她实在太过信任我了。"

texts.en:
Bornanew looks almost surprised at your words. He does not pray, or thank Providence. He simply looks directly at you through the waver of the comm-link.

"Thank you, captain. Against all odds, you've cast a light upon my path toward redemption."

Perhaps apologetic for the moment of earnestness, he quickly adds, "I am prepared to leave when you are ready for me. I shall await word of your shuttle."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 似乎对你的话感到惊讶。他没有祈祷，也没有感谢上天。他只是透过通讯链接的网纹直视着你。

"谢谢你，舰长。在困难重重之时，你为我的救赎之路投下了光芒。"

也许是为这片刻的真诚感到有些不好意思，他很快补充道，"我已经可以出发了，就看你什么时候准备好让我登船。我会等着你安排的穿梭机的消息。"

texts.en: Traffic control is mercifully efficient when arranging transport for a Knight of Ludd.
texts.zh: 在为一位卢德骑士安排通行路线时，交通管制的效率高得令人欣慰。

texts.en:
Before long, Novice Bornanew steps aboard your flagship carrying only a small satchel of his possessions.

Your TriPad pings acknowledgement of a funds transfer from the Church of Galactic Redemption.
texts.zh:
没过多久，见习修士 Bornanew 登上了你的旗舰，只带着一个小挎包，里面装着他的随身物品。

你的 TriPad 发出提示音，确认收到了来自 银河救赎教会 的转账。

options.en: I've ordered an officer's stateroom cleared for you.
options.zh: 我已经下令为你清理了一间军官舱室。

options.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew.
options.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。

options.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew. Penance is penance.
options.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。苦修就是苦修。

texts.en: "Such extravagance is not necessary for a mere novice, captain," he says uncomfortably.
texts.zh: "对区区一个见习修士来说，没必要这么铺张，舰长，" 他不安地说道。

options.en: A private workspace will allow you to best perform your duties.
options.zh: 私人的工作空间能让你更好地履行职责。

options.en: Nonsense. You're my guest and I'll treat you as such.
options.zh: 别胡说了。你是我的客人，而我也自会以礼相待。

options.en: If you wish, you will be given a crew-berth.
options.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以给你安排一个普通船员的床位。

texts.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "You are right, of course."
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"当然，你说得对。"

texts.en: You have Bornanew's luggage taken to his quarters by a couple crew who clearly expected heavier lifting, then have him meet you in a debriefing room to plan your next move.
texts.zh: 你让几个船员把 Bornanew 的行李送到他的住处，他们显然没想到行李这么轻。然后，你让 Bornanew 到任务简报室与你会面，计划下一步行动。

texts.en:
Novice Bornanew speaks from the head of the table on which he has placed a paper notebook. He seems disinclined to use the shared workspace of the holo visualization suite; you're not even sure he brought a datapad.

"...collector who now possesses this duplicate relic is a man by the name Menes Yaribay, a minor member of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron," he looks to you for a sign of recognition.
texts.zh:
见习修士 Bornanew 在桌首发言，面前放着一本纸质笔记本。他似乎不太愿意使用全息可视化套件的共享工作区；你甚至不确定他有没有带数据平板。

"...现在拥有这件复制圣物的收藏家名叫{Menes Yaribay}，是 Kazeron 上 Yaribay 氏族的一个小角色，" 说到这，他用眼神询问了一下你是否认识这个人。

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud and have, on at least one occasion, used those credentials to call a favor on account of Gens Yaribay's prestige.

Hopefully he didn't find out.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面，而且你利用凭证和 Yaribay 氏族的声望来至少谋取过一次私利。

希望他没有发现。

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud. During that meeting, you handed over the key required for an encrypted channel between Horus Yaribay and Baikal Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。在那次会面中，你交出了 Horus Yaribay 和 Baikal Daud 建立加密通讯所需的密钥。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

texts.en: You know of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron, one of the three dominant ruling family-corporations. Theirs is most inclined toward rapprochement with the Hegemony, focusing less on heavy military industry and more on interfactional ventures.
texts.zh: 你知道 Yaribay 氏族，那是 Kazeron 三大统治级的家族企业之一。他们最倾向于与 霸主 和解，对军事重工业的投入较少，而更多地聚焦于势力间的合资企业。

options.en: Explain, but leave out the abuse of credentials part
options.zh: 进行说明，但略去滥用凭证的部分

options.en: Yes, I've heard of the Yaribays.
options.zh: 是的，我听说过 Yaribay 氏族。

texts.en: "This is providential," he says, nodding. "Your previous dealings with Horus Yaribay could open an easier path to resolving the Church's problem."
texts.zh: "这是天意，" 他点着头说。"你之前和 Horus Yaribay 的交集，或许能为解决教会的问题开辟一条更简单的道路。"

texts.en:
"The question, then, is how Horus Yaribay, the nominal gens leader, views Menes Yaribay's recent interest in religious artifacts."

Bornanew flips through his paper book, not really taking the time to read the dense notes therein. He runs a finger across lists of names.

"Not long ago Menes Yaribay was assigned the office of demarch, in essence the executive administrator, of Olinadu in the Kumari Kandam system. It is not a prestigious post. Olinadu is a small mining colony and the system is rife with Luddic Path activity. It is a dangerous, corrupt place."

Bornanew eye's return to you. "This is why I need your help."
texts.zh:
"那么，问题就在于，名义上的氏族领袖 Horus Yaribay 如何看待 Menes Yaribay 最近对宗教圣物的兴趣。"

Bornanew 翻着他的纸质本子，但并没有花太长时间去读里面密密麻麻的笔记。他的手指划过一列列名字。

"不久前，Menes Yaribay 被指派到 Kumari Kandam 星系的 Olinadu 担任统领，实际上就是行政总管。这不算是个显赫的职位。Olinadu 是一个小型矿业殖民地，而且那个星系里 卢德左径 活动猖獗。是个危险、腐败的地方。"

Bornanew 的目光回到你身上。"这就是我需要你帮助的原因。"

options.en: You've done your research. Tell me about Menes Yaribay himself.
options.zh: 你做了不少研究。跟我说说 Menes Yaribay 这个人吧。

options.en: How did a Kazeron aristocrat get put in charge of Olinadu?
options.zh: 一个 Kazeron 的贵族怎么会被派去管理 Olinadu？

options.en: Tell me more about the relic at the center of this. What is it?
options.zh: 再多跟我说说事件中心的那个圣物。它到底是什么？

options.en: Wait, why's the real glove on Tartessus if Ludd removed it on Gilead?
options.zh: 等等，如果卢德是在 Gilead 摘下的手套，那为什么真品会在 Tartessus？

options.en: What's the plan? Ask Menes nicely for the glove?
options.zh: 计划是什么？客客气气地找 Menes 要手套？

options.en: Kumari Kandam? You were on Chalcedon. With the Path.
options.zh: Kumari Kandam？你之前在 Chalcedon。和左径的人在一起。

texts.en:
"Certain tawdry media outlets in the outer League worlds and beyond report rumor and gossip about affairs, social vendettas, and... how shall I put this... decadent festivities undertaken by Menes. More so in his younger years, at least." Bornanew turns pages in his notebook, not reading, but recalling as he goes through the motions with his hands.

"His enthusiasm for such pursuits has waned from the cycles of his youth, and his interests have shifted. At heart, I suspect Menes is still a man who wishes for all to hear his name, and for all who hear it to be very impressed."
texts.zh:
"联盟外围世界和其他地方的某些低俗媒体，报道过关于 Menes 的风流韵事、社交仇杀以及...我该怎么说呢...放纵派对的谣言和八卦。至少在他年轻的时候更是如此。" Bornanew 翻动笔记本，他没在阅读，而是伴随翻书的动作进行着回忆。

"他对这类追求的热情，已经随着青春的流逝而减退，他的兴趣也发生了转移。我猜，Menes 骨子里依然希望所有人都听到他的名字，并且让听到的人都对他印象深刻。"

texts.en:
"Unfortunately for his ambition, he is a natural dilettante in all pursuits. He avoids challenge, seeking instead flattery and the appearance of success which may be purchased with credits." Bornanew reports this without obvious outward judgment, as if discussing the results of a gravimetric survey.

"To his gens, Menes has given only scandal and debt. I suspect he was placed in the Olinadu administration to limit his ability to further damage their reputation."

Bornanew smiles grimly now. "It is some irony that he has potentially stumbled into more trouble than ever."
texts.zh:
"可惜他的野心终究无法实现，因为他在所有的追求上都半途而废。他不愿直面挑战，而偏爱用星币买来的成功表象和奉承之语。" Bornanew 的讲述并未掺杂明显的个人评判，就好像在讨论重力勘测的结果。

"而对于他的氏族，Menes 只带来了丑闻和债务。我怀疑，氏族之所以要把他安排进 Olinadu 的行政部门，就是为了防止他进一步损害氏族的声誉。"

说到这，Bornanew 露出了可怕的笑容。"说来有些讽刺，他现在可能陷入了前所未有的大麻烦。"

texts.en:
"Gens Yaribay has a controlling interest in the military corporation which exercises the monopoly of violence for the polity of Olinadu. The Pathers are an ever-present threat, so those who don't cooperate... well, that is the stick which compels. The carrot, on the other hand, is a stream of investment credits facilitated by Gens Yaribay brokers."

"The locals cooperate with this arrangement, and agreed to vote Menes Yaribay to an executive position, perhaps understanding that he'd play the role as a figurehead rather than a serious administrator. Olinadu receives investment and safety while, from all accounts, Menes Yaribay simply wants to be liked."

"Compared to the alternatives," says Bornanew, "he is an ideal overlord."
texts.zh:
"Yaribay 氏族在一家军事公司中拥有控股权，而这军事公司垄断着 Olinadu 政体中暴力手段的行使权。在左径分子的长久威胁下，对于那些不合作的人...嗯，这就是强迫的大棒。而胡萝卜，则是由 Yaribay 氏族经纪人促成的一系列星币投资。"

"当地人配合这项安排，并同意投票选举 Menes Yaribay 担任行政职位，也许他们明白他会扮演一个傀儡，而不是严肃的管理者。Olinadu 获得了投资和安全，而从各方面来看，Menes Yaribay 只是想被人喜欢。"

"与其他选择相比，" Bornanew 说道，"他是一个理想的统治者。"

texts.en:
"Yes, the... artifact." Bornanew looks down, clasping his hands together, then taking them apart and setting them deliberately on the table.

"Ludd's right-hand glove," an abashed smile appears.

"A standard work-glove of Domain manufacture. Light vac-suit compatible. The story is that Ludd removed it to touch the ground of Gilead."
texts.zh:
"好，那件... 遗物。" Bornanew 低下头，双手紧握然后松开，接着小心翼翼地把手放到桌子上。

"卢德的右手手套，" 他露出了尴尬的微笑。

"一件人之领制造的标准工作手套。兼容轻型真空服。据故事中记载，卢德摘下它是为了触摸 Gilead 的土地。"

options.en: And you don't think it's real? The original, I mean.
options.zh: 而你不认为它是真的？我是说，原本的那个。

options.en: Seems like a lot to get worked up about.
options.zh: 听起来这摊子事确实够让人头疼。

options.en: What's Ludd going to do with two right-hand gloves?
options.zh: 卢德要两只右手手套干嘛？

texts.en:
"It's a real glove," he says, "That much is true."

"It's just a work glove, one of many designs prevalent through the immediate pre- and post-Collapse Persean Sector."
texts.zh:
"那是真的手套，" 他说，"这一点毋庸置疑。"

"它不过是只工作手套，在 大崩塌前后 的英仙座星域流行的众多设计之一。"

texts.en: "My objection is that the glove, even if it is the glove, is not important. What is important is Ludd's message, Ludd's sacrifice; it is the act of a divine moral force touching the soul of humanity with supreme grace."
texts.zh: "我的反对意见是，这只手套，即使它真的是那只手套，也并不重要。重要的是卢德所留的信息，卢德付出的牺牲；那是神圣的道德之力以无上恩典触动人类灵魂的过程。"

texts.en:
"What is a glove to the light of Revelation?" The words come out forcefully.

"Even if it were Ludd's glove - and that we can't, and should not, be sure of - would God love you more for possessing it? Touching, looking upon, and worshipping it?"

His brow furrows. "Then some would try to extract DNA from the glove. Clone Ludd, they say, to re-open a connection to God." He shakes his head furiously, "As if you could fool God with the twin of the prophet's body!"

"Or the glove that body might have worn."
texts.zh:
"在启示之光面前，一只手套算得了什么？" 他的话语掷地有声。

"就算那是卢德的手套 —— 我们没法确认，也不应该去确认 —— 神难道会更爱你吗？就因为你拥有了它？或是触摸了它，注视着它，崇拜着它？"

他眉头紧锁。"然后有些人就会试图从手套中提取 DNA。他们会说，这是为了克隆卢德，来重新建立与神的联系。" 他愤怒地摇着头，"好像你能用先知身体的复制品来欺骗神一样！"

"或者哪怕用先知可能戴过的那个手套。"

texts.en:
"It's the fool's logic of 'magic' of the lowest kind, the heretical notion that humanity might manipulate the Divine to our own ends. Creation turned on its head!"

You've never seen Bornanew like this, his voice like a river; his physical size giving power to his words. Seeing you see this, he realizes it himself.

"I apologize for my outburst, captain," he says, looking down.
texts.zh:
"这是最劣等 '魔法' 的那套愚蠢逻辑，是人类为了私心或许能操弄神物的异端邪说。造物秩序都被颠倒了！"

你从未见过 Bornanew 的这副模样，他的声音如洪流；魁梧的体格为他的话语赋予了力量。看到你发现这一点，他自己也反应了过来。

"我为我的失态道歉，舰长，" 他说着，目光下移。

options.en: Let's try to focus on the matter, ah, at hand.
options.zh: 我们还是，呃，专注于手头上的事情吧。

options.en: No need to apologize. I can't help but agree.
options.zh: 不必道歉。我完全同意你的看法。

options.en: But magic isn't real. So what harm is focusing on a glove, fake relic or not?
options.zh: 但魔法不是真的。所以关注一只手套，无论它是不是假的圣物，又有什么害处呢？

texts.en: He nods, suppressing a smile, looking down at his notebook. He puts his hands together again.
texts.zh: 他点点头，压住了自己的微笑，一边低头看着笔记本。接着又把双手合拢。

texts.en: He meets your gaze. "I shall interpret your words as forgiveness. It is nonetheless unseemly for a Knight to let uncontrolled passion rule their actions."
texts.zh: 他与你对视。"我将把你的话理解为原谅。尽管如此，让不受控制的激情支配自己的行为，对一位骑士来说很不得体。"

texts.en:
"Of course, of course." He rubs his chin, calmer now.

"The problem is not that it might work, but that such self-trickery will lead the Faithful astray from the Word. And if we don't follow the Word, then what use have we for revelation? Are we to simply discard God's gifts?"

He sits, looking into the distance somewhere. "Ludd chose the revealed path not because it was easy, and not because it was without suffering. Ludd chose because it was Good."
texts.zh:
"当然，当然。" 他摸着下巴，变得平静多了。

"问题不在于魔法是否能奏效，而在于这种自欺欺人的行为会让信徒们偏离圣言。如果我们不遵循圣言，那启示对我们又有什么用呢？我们难道要就此抛弃神的恩赐吗？"

他坐下来，望着远方的某个地方。" 卢德选择了那条被启示的道路，不是因为它轻松，也不是因为它没有痛苦。卢德选择它，是因为那是善的。"

texts.en:
He glances at you with a fleeting grimace of self-reflection.

"With further apology for the ramble through theology, captain; the matter of the false relic should be our focus."
texts.zh:
他瞥了你一眼，脸上闪过自我反省的苦笑。

"再次为这段神学漫谈道歉，舰长；假圣物的事情才应该是我们的重点。"

texts.en: "I think," he begins, "it is a matter of seeking a physical connection with the sacred."
texts.zh: "我想，" 他开始道，"这是个寻求与神圣事物建立物理联系的问题。"

texts.en: Bornanew laughs. "Yes, exactly."
texts.zh: Bornanew 笑了。"对，没错。"

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a look.

"It's a tedious story. And unimportant."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了你一眼。

"那是个冗长的故事。而且不重要。"

texts.en:
Bornanew closes his book of notes.

"It has been made clear to me that the Church would like this problem, this false idol, to quietly disappear," he says. "It can only tear open old rifts within the Church which would weaken the resolve of the Faithful. It would turn walker against walker in troubling times which promise naught but more trouble."

"I am prepared to ask nicely, but I do not believe Menes will agree to give someone like myself his glove."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

"我已经清楚地了解到，教会希望这个麻烦，这个虚假圣物，能悄无声息地消失，" 他说。"它只会在教会内撕开旧伤，削弱信徒们的信念。在动荡的时期，它会让循道者们自相残杀，而这只会带来更多麻烦。"

"我准备好了客客气气地去请求，但我不觉得 Menes 会愿意把他的手套交给像我这样的人。"

options.en: But you think he might listen to someone like me.
options.zh: 但你觉得他可能会听从像我这样的人。

options.en: We could offer to buy it.
options.zh: 我们可以提出要买下它。

options.en: I could talk to Horus Yaribay. He leads his gens, presumably.
options.zh: 我可以和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。他应该是他们氏族的领袖。

texts.en: "Yes," he says with the hint of a smile.
texts.zh: "是的，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en:
"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
texts.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
texts.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

options.en: Just one problem- the League wants me shot on sight.
options.zh: 还有个问题 —— 联盟的人见到我就会开火。

texts.en: "Your repute. As you well know," he says rather definitively. "And so will Menes."
texts.zh: "你的声望。你自己很清楚，" 他相当肯定地说。"Menes 也会有所了解的。"

texts.en:
Bornanew opens his notebook.

He stands for a moment, eyes closed. "It is not ideal," he says.

"You will have to approach Olinadu with your transponder off. But I believe Menes will consider your official outsider status... interesting. Adventurous. It might even provide a sense of 'roguish charm'."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 打开了他的笔记本。

他站了一会儿，闭着眼睛。"情况很不理想，" 他说。

"你得关闭应答器才能接近 Olinadu。但我相信 Menes 会认为你的局外人身份...很有趣。富有冒险精神。甚至可能有一种 '流氓魅力'。"

texts.en: He meets your look. "I know," he says with a hint of smile.
texts.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我知道，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en: Bornanew shuts his notebook again.
texts.zh: Bornanew 再次合上了他的笔记本。

options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

texts.en: He meets your look. "You have my faith," he says with a hint of smile.
texts.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我相信你，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en:
He gives you a look. "My speculation on behalf of his character, captain."

Bornanew shuts his notebook somewhat more forcefully than the first time.
texts.zh:
他看了你一眼。"这是我对他人格的推测，舰长。"

Bornanew 合上笔记本的动作比上一次更用力了些。

options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

texts.en: "You could." Bornanew emphasizes 'you'. "The Church refuses to acknowledge the false relic."
texts.zh: "你可以这么做。" Bornanew 强调了 '你' 这个字。"教会拒绝承认这件假圣物。"

texts.en: "It is... yes, that is possible," he says begrudgingly. "I would like to know more before we act, however. I pray this may prove simpler than could be hoped."
texts.zh: "这...对，可能可以，" 他不情愿地说，"不管怎样，在行动之前，我想了解更多细节。我祈祷这件事能比预想的更简单。"

texts.en: "Interesting." Bornanew rubs his chin. "If you believe Horus will be receptive to you bearing this... news. I wonder if it may be as simple as that."
texts.zh: "有意思。" Bornanew 摸着下巴。"如果你认为 Horus 会愿意听你带来的这个...消息。我在想事情是不是真的那么简单。"

texts.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "You followed my path, and spoke with the man Sedge. He told you where I went from there, Mazalot, where you found me."
texts.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"你跟随着我的足迹，和那个叫 Sedge 的人谈过。他告诉你我离开之后去了哪，Mazalot，也就是你找到我的地方。"

texts.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady as he speaks. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "And you killed the man Sedge," he says. "The Path will have no love for you there, but I trust that you will be prepared for... that."
texts.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他开口时很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"而你杀了那个 Sedge，" 他说。"那里的左径分子不会想看到你的，但我相信你已经为...那种情况做好了准备。"

texts.en:
Bornanew looks concerned as you describe your dealings. "Your conscience, your soul, is between you and- well, I am not your judge or confessor."

"From a practical standpoint, I would advise caution in asking too much of Horus of Gens Yaribay, to his face or behind it. He may know but choose not to act on your transgression."
texts.zh:
在你描述你的所作所为时，Bornanew 显得很担忧。"你的良心，你的灵魂，是你和 —— 好吧，我不是你的审判官或告解神父。"

"从务实的角度来说，我建议你谨慎一些，无论是在当面还是背后，都不要对 Yaribay 氏族的 Horus 索取太多。他可能知道你的越轨行为，但选择不采取行动。"

texts.en: A brief look of concern crosses Bornanew's face, and he pauses as if composing an awkward question. He puts his hand back down on the table, seeming to dismiss the notion, and responds in a different tone.
texts.zh: Bornanew 脸上的担忧一闪而过，他停顿了一下，好像在为一个尴尬的问题组织语言。然后他把手放回桌上，似乎打消了这个念头，换了一种语气回应。

texts.en: He nods and proceeds.
texts.zh: 他点点头，继续说着。

texts.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "My apologies, I did not intend to spurn your hospitality. It is a virtue."
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"抱歉，我无意拒绝你的款待。这是一种美德。"

texts.en: "If you would, please," Bornanew says with a nod that isn't quite a bow. "It would be most appropriate for my service of penance."
texts.zh: "如果可以的话，拜托了，" Bornanew 点头说道，姿态还算不上鞠躬，"那最适合我履行赎罪的职责。"

texts.en: "You have my thanks, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
texts.zh: "感谢你，舰长，"他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

texts.en: "Of course, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
texts.zh: "当然了，舰长，" 他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

texts.en:
Bornanew puts his hands together, and lowers his head for a moment.

"I thank you for that, captain. In the meantime, I will do what research and inquiries I can with the resources I am provided."

"If you wish to assist my quest, then come to Gilead. The Knights have provided me an entry in the comms directory in order to further my penance."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 将双手合十，低头片刻。

"谢谢你，舰长。在此期间，我会利用已有的资源，尽我所能进行研究和调查。"

"如果你打算帮我完成任务，那就来 Gilead 吧。骑士团向我提供了通讯目录的进入许可，让我能继续进行我的赎罪。"

texts.en:
"It could be," $global.jethroName says. "This collector has not been silent about his new acquisition."

"Naturally, the Church does not approve. At the same time, mere disapproval is no reason to cause a diplomatic incident, to say nothing of... well, it is a complex situation. And potentially dangerous."
texts.zh:
"有可能，" $global.jethroName 说。"这位收藏家没对他的新藏品保持低调。"

"很自然地，教会 对此很不赞成。但同时，仅仅不赞成，并不能成为引发外交事件的理由，更不用说...总之，情况很复杂。而且有潜在危险。"

texts.en: "Ah," he gives a weary smile. "The collector is quite secular, and has no relationship with the Church."
texts.zh: "啊，" 他疲惫地笑了笑。"这位收藏家相当世俗，和教会没有任何关联。"

texts.en:
"You're proving useful to Provost Baird - an admirable figure generally - yet one who stubbornly ties herself to the Hegemony bureaucracy."

"If it weren't for Kallichore's blundering..." Her eyes grow distant - more distant - for a moment, then return to their usual unblinking detachment.

"Here at Tri-Tachyon, we put the highest value in unrestrained R&D. Especially its dividends." She smiles coyly. "So, I think, do you."
texts.zh:
"你对 Baird 院长 —— 一位总体而言值得敬佩的人物 —— 很有助益，可惜她固执地将自己捆绑在霸主的官僚体系上。"

"若非 Kallichore 的愚蠢行径..." 她的目光变得遥远 —— 更加遥远 —— 片刻后又恢复惯常的漠然。

"在 速子科技，我们最看重的就是不受束缚的研发。特别是其红利。" 她狡黠一笑，"我想，你也这么认为。"

texts.en:
"You've proven useful to Provost Baird. And your accomplishment with the Gates..."

She puts her hands together, not quite a single clap for all you've done. Her politely mechanical smile contains some bitterness, you sense.

"I admire Baird, truly I do. Her ability to overcome Hegemony stone-walling, and herding those academics with their notions... sadly, though, it appears as though her grip was too tight. Pity to lose top talent."

The bitterness, you see, has left Glamor-Rotanev's smile to be replaced with something more carnivorous.

"Our R&D is cutting-edge, eminently practical, and there's very little risk of runaways. Our results might match your ambitions, I think."
texts.zh:
"你已向 Baird 院长证明了自己。而你在星门方面的成就..."

她双手合十，却未能为你所做的一切拍响掌声。你察觉到她那礼貌机械的微笑中带着一丝苦涩。

"我敬佩 Baird，真心实意。她突破 霸主 阻挠的能力，以及她驾驭那些学者们的理念...可惜，似乎她抓得太紧了。损失顶尖人才总是遗憾。"

你看见那抹苦涩已从 Glamor-Rotanev 的微笑中褪去，取而代之的是某种更食肉性的神色。

"我们的研发是最前沿的，极为务实，且失控风险极低。我想，我们的成果或许能匹配你的抱负。"

texts.en:
"We see you've taken up an interest with the Luddi- pardon me, with the Church of Galactic Redemption. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so otherwise practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到你开始关注卢德 —— 抱歉，是 银河救赎教会 的事务。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more and better than that. I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Do you?"
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。"

她精准地扬起眉毛，"你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more than that. Better than that. And I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors. That silly little battleship he gave you? A child's toy compared to what I offer."

She brushes one hand off with the other.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。至于给你的那艘愚蠢的小战舰？与我提供的相比，那不过是孩童的玩具。"

她用一只手拂开另一只手。

texts.en:
"Old reports noted your service to Mr. Macario - sorry, 'The Chief High Inspector' - and took has taken you for one of his pawns. But you've managed both to unseat him and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Nonetheless, you and I both know you're more and better than service to that blinkered tin-pot dictatorship. I believe your potential could be worth more than those little bribes and medals they distribute."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Don't you agree?"
texts.zh:
"旧档案里记着你替 Macario 先生办过事——抱歉，是'最高检察长'先生——便把你当他的一枚棋子。可你不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话虽如此，你我心里都清楚，替那个目光短浅的小独裁政权当差，未免埋没了你。我看你的本事，值的可不止他们发的那点贿赂和勋章。"

她精确地挑了挑眉。"你说是不是？"

texts.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Achilles, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. It soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."
texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Achilles——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话哄得住贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"

texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Hector——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"话说回来，Hector？当真？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章，还有那些几乎不加遮掩的谋杀。"

texts.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Hector, I believe it's name is - you've managed both to unseat him from his position and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Still. Hector? Really? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and barely-concealed murders."
texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Hector——不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话说回来，Hector？当真？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章，还有那些几乎不加遮掩的谋杀。"

texts.en:
"I must applaud your patriotism - the Hegemony, the restoration of the Domain!

She makes as if to clap, daintily, but stops her hands before they meet. Then turns her expression toward something far more cynical.

"You may earn the favor of that stubborn 'Old Man Daud'. But is that enough? Surely you tire of that paltry government stipend, the endless regulation? It must stifle your ambition. You must yearn for a truly dynamic enterprise. One in which someone like yourself can change the Sector..."
texts.zh:
"我必须为你的爱国情怀喝彩 —— 为了 霸主，为了 人之领 的复兴！"

她优雅地摆出鼓掌的架势，却在双手相触前停下。随即换上一副远为讥诮的表情。

"你或许能赢得那位固执的 'Daud 老爷子' 的青睐，但这足够吗？你定然已经厌倦那微薄的政府津贴和无尽的规章吧？那必定扼杀了你的雄心。你必然渴望真正充满活力的事业，一个能让你这样的人改变这片星域的事业..."

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you, but not so much that they've invited you to share power as a member," she says.

"Why play the mercenary for below-market rates? You're better than that, I think."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，但并未邀请你作为成员共享权力，" 她说道。

"为何要以低于市场的价格扮演雇佣兵？我想，你值得更好的待遇。"

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you," she looks down, and aside, placing a hand on the empty expanse of her enormous desk.

"But not enough to invite you to become a full member of the League, despite your colonial enterprise." She makes a small sound, halfways between pity and disappointment.

"Consider what you will gain from being a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，" 她垂目侧视，将手放在自己那空阔的巨大桌面上。

"但尽管你有殖民事业，但他们仍未邀请你成为联盟的正式成员。" 她发出轻微的声响，介于怜悯与失望之间。

"不妨想想成为合作伙伴而非从属者后，你将获得什么。"

texts.en:
"You're a member of the League. A junior member, however. Perhaps not in name, but... tell me, do the gens respect you as a peer?"

"Or are you just another vassal to their little empire? Consider your future, captain, and how you might truly achieve greatness."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你是联盟的一员，尽管只是下级成员。或许名义上不是，但...告诉我，氏族势力可曾将你视为平辈？"

"抑或你只是他们那小小帝国的又一个附庸？考量你的未来吧，舰长，思考你该如何真正地成就伟业。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me the truth, are you content to be a mere lackey of our mutual friend Reynard Hannan? He drains you like a leech from atop his so-called League. Let me give you a taste of real business, of real credits."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"说实话，你甘于当我们共同朋友 Reynard Hannan 的区区仆从吗？他高踞在所谓的联盟顶端，如蚂蟥般榨取你的价值。不妨让我带你体验真正的生意，真正的星币。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me, how is Rayan Arroyo? I've always admired his entrepreneurial spirit, but." She forms a little smile that might have been apologetic if it weren't so condescending.

"He doesn't have the killer instinct required for senior leadership. Isn't that funny? But we do need people like him."

"And we need people like you. Go-getters, achievers; builders and destroyers. And what we need, we at Tri-Tachyon pay for. Only the best."
texts.zh:
"告诉我，Rayan Arroyo 近况如何？我一直欣赏他的企业家精神，但是..." 她露出一个本该是歉意的微笑，却透着居高临下的意味。

"他缺乏高层领导所需的杀手本能。这很有趣，不是吗？但我们的确需要像他这样的人。"

"我们也需要你这样的人。行动派，实干家；建设者与毁灭者。而我们 速子科技 对于需要的事物，向来只聘用最顶尖的人才。"

texts.en:
"You cut a deal with the Company after some... assertive negotiations. To our mutual benefit. I applaud your audacity."

Her teeth glisten.

"Such fierce initiative is exactly what Tri-Tachyon needs."
texts.zh:
"经过一番...强势谈判后，你与公司达成了协议。这对我们双方都有利，我赞赏你的胆识。"

她的牙齿闪闪发光。

"如此凌厉的进取心正是 速子科技 所需要的。"

texts.en:
"You've had a taste of working for the Company. A mundane commission, mercenary fare. Boilerplate. Busywork. We'd have automated all that sort of thing long ago, of course, if not for-"

She pulls her gaze back down. "I digress. You're capable of much more. Think of this as the next step."
texts.zh:
"你已浅尝过为公司效力的滋味。无聊的差事，雇佣兵的薪酬。千篇一律。无谓的忙碌。若非某些原因，我们早该将这类工作全面自动化了 ——"

她将视线收回，"好吧，我有些离题了。我相信你有能力成就更多，远不止于此。请将此视为迈向更高层级的阶梯。"

texts.en:
"You're not only an explorer, you're a builder - founding a new colony!"

"It is bold of you to strike out despite the anti-innovation measures sure to fall upon you from the major factions," she says. "I suspect you'll benefit from an injection of capital. For the builder must also ensure that their prosperity cannot be simply seized by the small-minded takers."
texts.zh:
"你不仅是探索者，更是建设者 —— 你正在建立新的殖民地！"

"在各大势力必将施加反创新措施的背景下，你的开拓之举堪称勇毅，" 她说道，"我认为资本的注入将助你一臂之力。因为建设者必须确保自己的繁荣果实不会被眼界狭隘的掠夺者轻易夺取。"

texts.en: "I believe that's enough of that, captain," she says stonily.
texts.zh: "我想这个话题可以到此为止了，舰长，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en:
Her expression is blank for a moment.

"On second thought, I feel no need to justify myself," she says stonily.
texts.zh:
她的表情凝固了片刻。

"转念一想，我觉得我无需自证，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
texts.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
texts.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"

texts.en:
"There are unimaginable possibilities out there." She raises an arm, hand extended, fingers like rays into the far, dark corners of the cavernous office.

You sense the lights dim slightly - a dramatic effect triggered by her cybernetic implants, no doubt.
texts.zh:
"那里蕴藏着无法想象的可能性。" 她抬起手臂，伸出手掌，手指如光芒般射向这间巨型办公室深处幽暗的角落。

你察觉到灯光变得略微黯淡 —— 无疑是她的赛博植入体触发的浮夸效果。

texts.en:
"I take the very long shots. There are things," she stresses the word oddly, "Such things out there, captain. Technologies and phenomena the Human Domain hid away, and from. They locked such wonders and treasures up in red-tape concocted by fearful, jealous little minds. They suffocated these opportunities, blinded themselves to unimaginable possibilities."

"The returns from exploitation would be... astronomical. Or perhaps," her eyes glint in the filtered starlight, "They may prove to be of value well beyond that of mere stars."
texts.zh:
"我专攻那些极低概率的机会。那里存在着，" 她异常地重读这个词，"那样的事物，舰长。人之领 曾隐藏 —— 并逃避 —— 的技术与现象。他们用怯懦而狭隘的头脑炮制的官僚程序，将这些奇迹与珍宝禁锢起来。他们扼杀了这些机遇，对无法想象的可能性视而不见。"

"开发这些事物带来的回报将是...天文数字。或者，" 她的眼眸在过滤的星光下闪烁着，"它们可能被证明拥有远超星辰的价值。"

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology are of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

options.en: I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you.
options.zh: 我在深渊里遇到了一些佣兵，他们似乎对和你的交易颇为后悔。

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology is of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

texts.en: "It is," she smiles, teeth jewel-like. "And I'll ensure that you receive your share."
texts.zh: "是的，" 她微笑着，牙齿如珠宝般闪烁，"我会确保你获得应得的份额。"

texts.en: "The Perseus-Orion Abyss is a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, present company excepted. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "英仙座-猎户座深渊 是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en: "You know of the Perseus-Orion Abyss; a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, excepting present company. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "你听说过 英仙座-猎户座深渊 吗？真是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You went there, and there you found the Onslaught Mk.I... and the 'Threat'."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"I very much desire to have a look at the Mk.I."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你去过那里，并在那里发现了 攻势 Mk.I...以及 '威胁'。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"我非常希望能亲自看看 Mk.I。"

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You know of the 'Threat'." She looks away. "A typically non-descriptive name passed to us from some primitive government committee, I'm sure."

"You found Academician Cornelius Elek's enigma, the Onslaught Mk.I... among other things."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"This is what I want."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你也知道 '威胁'。" 她移开视线，"我敢肯定，这又是某个简陋的政府委员会所传达给我们的一个毫无描述性的名字。"

"你找到了 Cornelius Elek 院士的谜题，攻势 Mk.I...以及其他东西。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"这正是我想要的。"

options.en: You know a lot about what I've been doing.
options.zh: 你很了解我做过的事情。

options.en: You've been prompting Elek. How'd you know where to make him look?
options.zh: 你一直在诱导 Elek，你怎么知道该让他往哪里探索？

options.en: ...You want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
options.zh: ...你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I？

options.en: How will I know when I find it?
options.zh: 我怎么知道自己找到了它？

options.en: I've seen them. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss.
options.zh: 我见过它们。那潜伏在深渊深处的，古老的自动化作战舰队。

options.en: I've encountered... entities in the Abyss. Non-material, high energy. Hostile.
options.zh: 我在深渊中遭遇过...一些实体，它们没有物质形态，能量极高，且敌对。

options.en: I've seen ancient warfleets deep in the abyss. And... non-material hostile entities.
options.zh: 我见过深渊深处古老的作战舰队。还有... 非物质态的敌对实体。

options.en: I've never encountered such a thing. (lie)
options.zh: 我从未遭遇过这种东西。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"Crews talk, TriPads listen. There is little I cannot know if I so wish," she says, injecting a tone of boredom into her words.

"Accept it. Now let's speak of business."
texts.zh:
"船员会闲聊，TriPad 会监听。只要我意愿，便鲜有不能知晓之事，" 她的话语中掺入一丝厌倦的腔调。

"接受现实吧。现在让我们谈谈正事。"

texts.en:
"Old records," she says curtly.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. Their lack of self-motivation is self-evident."
texts.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

texts.en:
She laughs with a buzz like a malfunctioning agrav plate.

"Oh, no. That'd be far too provocative to..." She gives a little flick of the hand, indicating enemies too irrelevant to bother acknowledging in speech.

The Hegemony, maybe.

"However," she fixes upon you. "I would gladly pay for the opportunity to have my people take a close look at it. And take a few samples, very small, nothing damaging."
texts.zh:
她的笑声像故障的反重力板般震颤作响。

"哦，不。那未免过于挑衅..." 她轻轻摆手，示意某些敌人不值一提，甚至不配被言语提及。

那或许是指 霸主。

"不过，" 她的目光锁定于你，"我很乐意为我的团队争取近距离研究的机会，并提取少量样本 —— 极其微小，绝无损害。"

options.en: You can't detect them, can you. That's what you want.
options.zh: 你无法探测到它们，对吧。这就是你想要的。

texts.en:
She blinks. "Detect them?"

Her voice is emotionless.
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼。"探测它们？"

她的声音没有任何情绪。

options.en: The Threat. They're all but invisible to you.
options.zh: '威胁'，它们对你而言几乎不可见。

texts.en:
Her face arranges itself into a shape suggesting dismissive amusement.

"What an interesting theory, captain. Whatever my motives, will you agree to my proposal? A simple look, a few scans. A few samples."
texts.zh:
她的脸上显露出一种轻蔑的趣味。

"多么有趣的理论，舰长。无论我的动机如何，你是否同意我的提议？只需要简单的观察，几次扫描，以及少许样本。"

texts.en:
A long pause. Her eyes flicker, accessing. Calculating.

"This is possible." She speaks with an emotion suddenly present - quiet displeasure, presumably at your maneuvering.

"You ask for much, captain."
texts.zh:
通讯陷入了漫长的沉默。她眼眸闪烁，表明她正在访问数据，计算权衡。

"这是可行的。" 她的语气突然有了一些情绪 —— 一种平静的不悦，大概由于你的迂回策略。

"你要价不菲，舰长。"

options.en: Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions can afford a mere million credits. I accept.
options.zh: 速子科技 的特殊采购部总监还是出得起一百万星币的。我接受。

texts.en:
"Done," she says, her voice as empty as the Abyss.

Almost instantly, your TriPad pings with several alerts - credits transfer, but also notification from your tactical officer concerning an approaching Tri-Tachyon portside-tender, swarming with engineering drones, and your comms, forwarding certain docking requests directly to the Onslaught Mk.I.

"Take a moment to ensure your affairs are in order, captain," Glamor-Rotanev says.

You'd think she enjoys overwhelming your officers with the speed of her response.
texts.zh:
"成交，" 她的声音像深渊一样空洞。

几乎同时，你的 TriPad 接连弹出数条通知 —— 星币到账，而你的战术军官也发来警示：一艘 满载工程无人机的 速子科技 泊位服务艇正逐步靠近，同时通讯系统也开始将某些对接请求直接转发至 攻势 Mk.I。

"请花些时间确认事务已安排妥当，舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 说道。

你不禁怀疑她很享受用这种迅捷的回应让你的部下疲于应付的快感。

texts.en:
Director Glamor-Rotanev takes a moment to turn and appear to look out over her spectacular view of the Xanadu Geodivision.

You're certain she's watching her teams as they board the Onslaught Mk.I through what are no doubt top-of-the-line cybernetic implants and neural integrations.

And, doubtless, watching your comms. Because just as you are finished, she turns back, resettling her facial muscles with a twitch.
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 总监稍作停顿，随即便转身望向窗外 Xanadu 地质区划那壮丽的景色。

你确信她正通过顶级的赛博植入体与神经集成系统，监控着她的团队登上 攻势 Mk.I 的过程。

并且，毫无疑问，她也正在监视着你的通讯。因为就在你刚刚结束事务时，她便转回身，面部肌肉抽动着重新调整着表情。

texts.en:
"I am satisfied, $playerName."

It's not that her tone is warm, more that it lacks a certain otherwise ubiquitous contempt perceivable only now by its absence.

Presumably temporary, of course.
texts.zh:
"我很满意，$playerName。"

并非是她的语气变得温暖，而是缺少了某种无处不在的轻蔑 —— 这种轻蔑此刻因缺席而格外明显。

当然，这大概只是暂时的。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says. Her words come more rapidly. "You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived."

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道，语速明显加快，"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。"

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

texts.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
texts.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

texts.en:
"'Was there another...'" she says, repeating your words.

"Dozens! Some returned with nothing, others not at all. I won't conceal the fact from you. Maybe you'll find them, though don't feel compelled to render assistance on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. These were independent contractors who accepted and assumed the risk. Then failed."

"If anything," she says quietly, "we have grounds to sue them if they ever manage to get back to the Core Worlds."
texts.zh:
"'还有另一支...' 她重复你的话。

"还有几十支！他们有的空手而归，有的杳无音信，我不会对你隐瞒事实。或许你会遇到他们，但不必代表 三一速子科技公司 施以援手。这些都是接受并承担了风险的独立承包商，然后失败了。"

"甚至可以说，" 她低声道，"如果他们能侥幸返回核心世界，我们完全有理由起诉他们。"

texts.en:
"Return with something useful," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"带回有价值的东西，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

texts.en:
"Bring me more... samples. From the Abyss," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"再给我多带些...样本。从深渊里带，" 她说着背过身去，望向窗外——Eochu Bres 的贫民窟里，群峰与闪亮的生态巨城像水晶一样拔地而起。

"我会让你也闪闪发光。"

options.zh: 我需要燃料。大量的燃料。还有运载燃料的油轮。

options.en: I believe we've come to an arrangement.

texts.en:
"Done." She speaks without turning.

texts.zh:
"成交。" 她头也不回地说道。

texts.en:
She looks at you over her shoulder.

"You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I will trust in your boundless initiative," $personLastName says.
texts.zh:
她侧过头看向你。

"你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。我将仰赖你无限的进取心，" $personLastName 说道。

texts.en:
"Can't let you starve on the road to glory, can we." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
texts.zh:
"总不能让你在通往荣耀的路上挨饿吧。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

texts.zh: "你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。在这件事上我将仰赖你的进取心，" $personLastName 说道，一边不耐烦地轻轻摇晃着鞋跟。

texts.en:
* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements while rewarding success.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
texts.zh:
* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

"Anything else?"

texts.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.

她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

"Fine," she says, the spite cold in her voice.

"You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived." She is quite collected, suddenly, as she speaks.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."

"很好，" 她说道，声音里的恶意冰冷而刺骨。

"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。" 在陈述时，她突然变得异常冷静。

"We assume it'll engage in some sort of hostile action against you or your $shipOrFleet," she says indifferently. "Only this won't be pirate, Pather, or tariff patrol."

"Nor," she fixes you with a cool look, "Some remnant AI warfleet. Those, those we know about."

"Disappointing conversationalists," she mutters. "Superintelligence with no mind for business. Simply unbelievable..."
texts.zh:
"我们推测它会对你或你的$shipOrFleet采取某种敌对行动，" 她漠然说道，"但这并非是海盗、左径分子，或关税巡逻队。"

"令人失望的对话对象，" 她低语道，"具有超常的智能却毫无商业头脑，简直难以置信..."

"You're telling the truth," she says, outwardly cool.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."

texts.en:
She blinks and her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And they narrow slightly.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注，眼睛也微微眯起。

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

options.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
"It is true, however, that the Abyss is hostile to our hyperspace technology. That is precisely why the secrets it holds may be all the more profitably disruptive."

She turns to look you full-on, once more. "I want you to go there. I have data... there is something to find. Very old. Very dangerous. Very valuable. Bring me scans, samples. You will be paid handsomely for tangible specimens."
texts.zh:
"但深渊确实对我们的超空间技术充满敌意。而这恰恰意味着其中隐藏的秘密可能带来更具颠覆性的利润。"

她再度转过身来直视着你，"我要你去往那里。我掌握着数据...那里存在值得探查的事物，非常古老，极度危险，也价值连城。为我带回扫描数据，采集样本。对于实体标本，你将获得丰厚的酬劳。"

options.en: You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?
options.zh: 你还没具体说明我要寻找什么。是要打捞物品吗？

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisifed. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

options.en: Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?
options.zh: 这与余辉的 AI 战争舰队有关吗？

options.en: Yes, but you haven't said what.
options.zh: 是的，但你还没具体说明要找什么。

texts.en:
"Those old things?" She gives her head an abbreviated shake.

"No, we have people for that. Although," she fixes you with a look, "they've made quite a mess of it, haven't they? The wasted possibilities... but no, we're looking for something older... different."
texts.zh:
"那些旧东西？" 她简短地摇了摇头。

"不，我们有专人负责那些。不过，" 她凝视着你，"它们确实搞得一团糟，不是吗？那些被浪费的可能性...但我们寻找的是更古老的...不同的东西。"

texts.en: Sensing the insufficiency of her pep-talk, she begins anew: "What it is, is old. Early Domain. Pre-Persean Frontier, but we have reason to believe some part of it is out... here. Whether it followed us or we followed it. Whatever it is, wherever there is."
texts.zh: 察觉到自己的鼓舞之辞不够有力，她重新开口道："重点是，它很古老。早于 人之领 时期，在英仙座边境形成之前，但我们有理由相信它的某些部分就在...这里。不知是它尾随而来，还是我们追寻至此。无论它是什么，无论它在何处。"

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisfied. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

texts.en:
"No, nothing like that." She emits a joyless laugh, like a machine, then pauses suddenly.

"Although if you did happen to find alien technology... provide me with exclusive access and I would ensure you credits enough to purchase your own solar system. Or," she waves a hand in an unconscious arc, "Build yourself a new one out of dross, if that's what you enjoy."
texts.zh:
"不，不是那种东西。" 她发出机器般毫无欢愉的笑声，随即突然停顿。

"不过，如果你真的偶然发现了外星技术...那就向我提供独家接触权限，我会确保你获得足以买下一整个恒星系的财富。或者，" 她无意识地挥手划了个弧线，"如果你喜欢，用废料给自己造个新的也行。"

texts.en: "There's no need. Our strategic indicators forecast a reasonably likely chance of your survival if your outlook is unbiased by speculation, so take heart." She trails off.
texts.zh: "没必要。我们的战略指标预测，如果你不受主观臆断影响，那么你的存活概率将相当可观，所以振作些。" 她的声音渐渐低了下去。

texts.en: "Then I think we shall work well together," she says.
texts.zh: "那么我想我们会合作得很愉快，" 她说道。

texts.en: "Yes. Does that frighten you?" she asks.
texts.zh: "是的。这让你感到恐惧吗？" 她问道。

options.en: Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there.
options.zh: 是的。如果不对那里的存在心怀敬畏，那我才真是愚蠢。

options.en: Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation.
options.zh: 是的。正因如此，我需要获得充分的补偿。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your pretense of bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你佯装的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

texts.en:
"I see," she says after a moment.

"I trust that you shall ensure your executive judgment is merely tempered, not impaired, by such sentiment."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她停顿片刻后说道。

"我相信你会确保这种情绪仅仅只会调节，而非削弱你的决策判断力。"

texts.en: "Of course," she says, allowing a trace of amusement to enter her voice.
texts.zh: "当然，" 她说道，话音里渗入了一丝玩味。

texts.en:
Her head gives a small twitch.

"Regret, you say."
texts.zh:
她的头部微微抽动了一下。

"后悔，你是说。"

options.en: They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment.
options.zh: 他们表达的措辞可激烈得多。

options.en: They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself.
options.zh: 他们的结局很糟，我想让自己避免那种下场。

texts.en:
"I see," she says.

"You found them. In the Abyss. And returned." The Director pauses a moment. "This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她说道。

"你找到了他们，在深渊里，并且回来了。" 总监停顿片刻，"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.

texts.en: She makes no outward reaction to your implication, simply proceeding as if you'd said nothing at all.
texts.zh: 她对你的暗示毫无表露，只是继续着，仿佛你未曾开口一般。

texts.en:
"Evidently, you already have," she says.

"This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"显然，你已经做到了，" 她说道。

"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, eyes black.

"I shall make my proposal shortly. First, allow me to elaborate on a shape for our partnership."
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，双眼漆黑。

"我将很快提出我的方案。首先，请允许我进一步阐述我们合作关系的框架。"

options.en: I don't see how that's your business.
I don't think about it. Like you said, I'm practical.
options.zh: 我不会考虑这个。如你所说，我很务实。

options.en: I do. I stand for the Church and the Church with me.
options.zh: 是的。我支持教会，教会也支持我。

options.en: I do believe, but not as does the Church. I follow Ludd's Word.
options.zh: 我确实信仰，但并非依循教会的信条。我追随卢德的圣言。

options.en: Not as such. My interest is humanitarian.
options.zh: 并非如此。我的关注是出于人道主义。

options.en: No, my interest is purely mercenary.
options.zh: 不，我的关注纯粹出于雇佣关系。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better.
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better. (lie)
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。 (说谎)

texts.en:
If her look could become any colder without freezing the local atmo, it would.

"An interest in your business is my business if we are to do business. I shall repeat the point for emphasis: it is important that I know where we stand." Her hands, neatly folded, gently draw apart and close. Not clenched into fists, but...

"Do you believe?"
texts.zh:
她的眼神愈发冰冷，而且只要空气还尚未结冰，她就不介意让自己的目光再冰冷几分。

"如果你我还有所关联，那么和你有关的事情就等同于和我有关。我必须重申要点以进行强调：明确我们的立场是至关重要的。" 她交叠的双手缓缓分开又合拢。并未攥成拳，但...

"你相信那些东西吗？"

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

texts.en: "How admirable," she says with no attempt to inject sincerity into her words. It is a dismissal; she pauses for but a moment then proceeds.
texts.zh: "真令人钦佩，" 她的言语毫无真诚之意。这已经是逐客令；她仅停顿片刻便继续开口。

texts.en:
"How unexpected," she says, curious.

"I suppose one must concede that the Church is not without some wealth and not without need for services unclouded by... fanatic enthusiasm. I suppose you've found something of a niche market for yourself. However limited."
texts.zh:
"真是出人意料，" 她说道，语气好奇。

"看来我必须承认，教会并非没有财力，也并非不需要那些不受...狂热信仰影响的纯粹服务。你似乎为自己找到了某个利基市场，尽管相当有限。"

texts.en: A cool smile. "Of course. I just wanted to hear you say it." She pauses for a moment, then proceeds.
texts.zh: 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"当然。我只是想听你亲口说出来。" 她停顿片刻，而后继续开口。

texts.en:
"Of course." A cool smile. "I wanted to hear you say it."

Her eyes seem suddenly more engaged - focused and examining you intently, distantly. Like you're a lab experiment pinned to a dissection table.
texts.zh:
"当然。" 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"我只是想听你亲口说出来。"

她的目光突然变得锐利 —— 专注而疏离地审视着你，仿佛你是钉在解剖台上的实验样本。

texts.en:
"Your interest in matters of the Luddics has been noted. Even working with, perhaps for, an archcurate. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so evidently practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"你对卢德事务的关注已被记录在案，甚至正在与某位大祭司一同工作，或者可能是受雇于他。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, spacer, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"Condemn not the ignorant for they know not their error, as the book says, but Grace of the Path, protect me - and you - from inquiries best not made lest a terrible swift hammer full upon us." $HeOrShe smiles nervously.

"Let us speak of other things," $heOrShe says. "The weather! Unpleasant lately, no?"
texts.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，宇宙民，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"无知者无罪，如教典所言，但卢德之道的光辉啊，请保佑我 —— 还有你 —— 不为多嘴多问而获罚。" $HeOrShe紧张地微笑道。

"我们聊点别的吧。" $HeOrShe说道，"天气！最近真糟啊，对吧？"

texts.en:
$personLastName raises an eyebrow. "Begging sweet Ludd's forgiveness, my fellow $playerBrotherOrSister, but if I did know such a good man, I would be wary of letting his name escape my lips too easily."

"But we're all pilgrims of the faith here, are we not?" $HeOrShe lets the hint of a smile appear, enjoying the chance to tease at hidden knowledge. "A pilgrim like you should visit a more worldly shrine. Come down port-side. There is a teahouse where the outworlders and Mammonites gather. There you will find your answer."

The spacer bar, in other words. As much as a teahouse-speakeasy can pass for a decent bar in this place.
texts.zh:
$personLastName 扬起了眉毛。"愿亲爱的卢德恕我无罪，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，但我真要认识那么一个好人，我是不会轻易吐出他的名字的。"

"但我们都是信仰的朝圣者，是吧？" $HeOrShe露出了一丝微笑，似乎很享受这个话里藏话的机会，"像你这样的朝圣者应该去看看凡尘中的圣地。从左舷下来。这儿有一个外来人员和玛门之仆聚集的茶馆。你会在那里找到想要的答案的。"

换言之，就是那家太空佬酒吧。在这种地方，一家有点地下副业的茶馆已算得上是个条件不错的酒吧了。

options.en: Let him know that I'll meet... him... there.
options.zh: 告诉他我会去那里...见...他。

options.en: Perhaps our paths should not cross just yet.
options.zh: 也许我们的道还不该相交。

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you captain."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"就是这样了。祝福你，舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Then it shall be. Blessings upon you, $playerBrotherOrSister."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那就这么定了，祝佑你，$playerBrotherOrSister。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, not meeting your eye. "Perhaps your path will take you far from here. Captain."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe点了点头，没有直视你的眼睛。"也许你的道途将带你远离这里。舰长。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, meeting your eyes. "Perhaps, $playerBrotherOrSister, your Path does not yet meet with that of the good man."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe盯着你的眼睛点了点头。"那么也许，$playerBrotherOrSister，你的道途还不会和那个好人相遇。"
